CornerBarrage2E.gac.name: Corner Barrage
CornerBarrage2E.gac.text:
Play this move only if you have hit two moves in a row and only in the ring.

If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

Poison.gac.name: Poison
Poison.gac.text:
nWo Trademark

Whenever a Superstar connects with a move, if they have already connected with two in a row, that Superstar loses 1 Attitude. (Heel Page.)

RingVeteran.gac.name: Ring Veteran
RingVeteran.gac.text:
Draw four pages.

Each player may play this twice per match.

fields.Page_Played:
(if ((eq #page #this)
     (block 
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (WASetValue #initiator PlayedRingVeteran (add (WAGetValue #initiator PlayedRingVeteran) 1))
     )
    )
    (True True)
)
fields.AI_PlayPage: (WASetValue #this AIScore 100)

TrishStratusEX3.gac.name: Trish Stratus
TrishStratusEX3.gac.text:
Diva Superstar
Special: 100%
Choose a Method. When your opponent plays or connects with a move of that Method that costs 6 or more, you get "Crowd Support". Use this ability once.

DropKickEX3.gac.name: Drop Kick
DropKickEX3.gac.text:
Counters in close moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat.

Strike Combo: Your opponent ditches two random pages from hand.

ElbowOnTheRingApron2E.gac.name: Elbow On The Ring Apron
ElbowOnTheRingApron2E.gac.text:
Play only when your opponent is on the mat at ringside.

This move does +1 damage (up to +7) for each turn you have been at Ringside.

StoneColdStunner.gac.name: Stone Cold Stunner
StoneColdStunner.gac.text:
Stone Cold Finisher

Counters behind opponent moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat. This move does +1 damage for each Attitude or Warning you have (whichever is greater, up to +12).  If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

Pose.gac.name: Pose
Pose.gac.text: Gain 3 momentum. If you lose control, you lose this momentum.

SuperMomentum.gac.name: Super Momentum
SuperMomentum.gac.text:
Hurricane Trademark

Play only after turn 18. Gain 1 Attitude, Agility and Technical. "Heat" is put into your opponent's hand.

KneeBreaker.gac.name: Knee Breaker
KneeBreaker.gac.text: If your opponent has 7 leg damage, you draw "Back Heel Trip" from your playbook. Then, your opponent takes 6 leg damage.

ChrisJerichoTourn.gac.name: Chris Jericho
ChrisJerichoTourn.gac.text:
Special: King of the World

Lose all your Attitude and choose a Momentum from your playbook. That page is drawn. Use this ability two times per match.

SetUpATable.gac.name: Set Up A Table
SetUpATable.gac.text: Play only if your opponent is stunned or if you have 10 Momentum. A Table is put into play. This move provides no Momentum.

BounceOffTheRopes.gac.name: Bounce Off The Ropes
BounceOffTheRopes.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. If you have 3 Strike, a random Strike move is drawn from your playbook.
If you play an Impact or Drop move and it connects, that move does +3 damage and you draw a page.

KneeLift.gac.name: Knee Lift
KneeLift.gac.text: Counters in close and head down moves.

TrapInTheCorner.gac.name: Trap In The Corner
TrapInTheCorner.gac.text:
Play only if a Ladder is in play and you and your opponent are in the ring.
If this move connects, you get 5 Warnings and your opponent is Trapped. (If your next move is a Strike move or Drop Kick it can't be countered.)

KickToTheKnee.gac.name: Kick To The Knee
KickToTheKnee.gac.text:
Your opponent is put on the mat. 

If your opponent has any leg damage, he ditches a random Strength or Agility move. Otherwise, this move does 2 leg damage.

Boring2E.gac.name: Boring
Boring2E.gac.text:
Willpower 2 (This page counts as two pages for Autocountering.)

Draw three pages. Use only if your opponent's move and last connected move have the same move type and if you aren't in a submission Hold.

ArmDragTakedownEX2.gac.name: Arm Drag Takedown
ArmDragTakedownEX2.gac.text:
Counters arm extended moves. Can't be countered by Strike moves.

You get a +2% pin chance bonus for the rest of the match.

MatWrestling.gac.name: Mat Wrestling
MatWrestling.gac.text:
Play only if you are in control and you connected with a Takedown last turn. 

Draw a page. If your next move is a Hold it does +3 body damage each turn and your opponent can't play Specials until the Hold is countered.

Headlock.gac.name: Headlock
Headlock.gac.text:
Counters behind opponent and in close moves.

When this move connects, if your opponent has any Head damage, draw a page.

Your opponent cannot submit to this move.

AtomicDrop2E.gac.name: Atomic Drop
AtomicDrop2E.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves.

50% chance your opponent loses an additional Momentum.

FrogSplashTourn.gac.name: Frog Splash
FrogSplashTourn.gac.text:
Eddie Guerrero Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.
This move does +1 damage for each move type you have connected with this match. Your opponent is stunned until the end of the turn and you attempt a pin. If the pin fails, you remain in control.

Immunity.gac.name: Immunity
Immunity.gac.text:
Test Trademark

Name a move that isn't a Trademark, Finisher or defensive. No one may play that move. (Your opponent is told which page you chose.)

fields.Page_Played:
(if ((eq #page #this)
     (block 
          (WASetValue #initiator PlayedEntrance 1)
          (sett TempPage (WACreatePageByUNID #initiator (WAStringGetValue #this User_Data)))
          (WAStringAddValue #this BannedName (WAGetName TempPage))
          (WAMessage -1 "Jim Ross: Test has Immunity -- he can't be fired for any reason!")
          (WAMessage -1 "Lawler: Test seems to get away with a lot more than he used to, JR.")
          (WAMessage -1 "Immunity has banned:" (WAGetName TempPage))
     )
    )
)

ComeOnBaby.gac.name: Arrogant Cover
ComeOnBaby.gac.text: Play only if your opponent is on the mat and your last move did at least 6 damage. You attempt to pin with a -50% pin chance penalty. If the pin fails your opponent gets Insulted, you remain in control, and you draw two pages.

Duck.gac.name: Duck
Duck.gac.text:
This move may only be played if you are not in control.
Counters arm extended and leg extended moves. Countered by behind opponent and mad rush moves. This move provides no momentum.

2ndRopeLegDropEX2.gac.name: 2nd Rope Leg Drop
2ndRopeLegDropEX2.gac.text:
Matt Hardy Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat. Choose a move from your playbook that you have not connected with or Crowd Support. That page is put into your hand when this move connects. If your opponent is a Big Superstar this move does +6 damage. Your opponent remains on the mat.

DrawFromTheFans.gac.name: Draw From the Fans
DrawFromTheFans.gac.text: Play only if you have not had control for five turns or more. Draw three pages and gain 10 Momentum. This momentum goes away at the end of the next moves step. (Face page: cannot be played if you have played a Heel page.)

BlatantChoke2E.gac.name: Blatant Choke
BlatantChoke2E.gac.text:
Play only when your opponent is on the mat. Your opponent can't submit to this hold.

When this move connects and when it is applied, your opponent ditches two pages from hand and you get 3 Warnings. This move may be Autocountered for -1 page per turn.

fields.Begin_Refresh:
(block 
     (sett Victim (WAGetPlayedOn #this))
     (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount Victim) 0))
     (sett NumDitched 0)
     (sett StopNum 2)
     (loop (not Done)
           (block 
                (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount Victim)))
                (sett Card (item (WAGetHand Victim) Ditch))
                (WAMessage (WAGetOwner Victim) (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
                (WADitchPage Victim (subtract Ditch 1))
                (sett NumDitched (add NumDitched 1))
                (if ((eq NumDitched StopNum)
                     (sett Done True)
                    )
                    (True
                     (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount Victim) 0))
                    )
                )
           )
     )
     (WAWarn (WAGetPlayedBy #this) 3)
)

HesCallingForIt.gac.name: He's Calling For It!
HesCallingForIt.gac.text: Play only if you have hit three or more moves in a row, and only with a move you haven't connected with this match. Your move can't be countered by moves. (Face page: cannot be played if you have played a Heel page.)

BackElbowEX1.gac.name: Back Elbow
BackElbowEX1.gac.text:
Counters behind opponent moves.

Choose one: Your opponent ditches a random Technical move, or your opponent takes 3 Head damage.

BubbaRayDudleyEX2.gac.name: Bubba Ray Dudley
BubbaRayDudleyEX2.gac.text:
You do +1 damage with Takedown moves.
Special: "Those Damn Dudleyz!"
Choose an Event or Unique page from your playbook. You draw that page. Use this ability twice per match.

RussianLegSweep2E.gac.name: Russian Leg Sweep
RussianLegSweep2E.gac.text:
Counters behind opponent and back to foe moves.

Your opponent's next page is ditched.

AgilityTourn.gac.name: Agility
AgilityTourn.gac.text: Gain 1 Agility. Your opponent can't see this page.

BubbasBackSplash.gac.name: Bubba's Back Splash
BubbasBackSplash.gac.text:
Bubba Ray Dudley Trademark

Play only in the ring when your opponent is on the mat, and only once per match. This move may be Autocountered for -4 pages. If this move is countered, you take 5 damage and are stunned until the end of the turn.

Respect.gac.name: Respect
Respect.gac.text:
Undertaker Trademark

If your opponent has 4 or more Attitude at the end of each turn, he ditches the next two pages from playbook and loses 2 Attitude.

ScottHall.gac.name: Scott Hall
ScottHall.gac.text:
nWo Superstar
When Scott Hall plays a Strike Momentum, you draw a random Heel page. When he plays a Strength Momentum, you draw a random Damage Special. Each ability works twice per match.

StraightJacketTakedown.gac.name: Straight Jacket Takedown
StraightJacketTakedown.gac.text: Five random pages from your playbook are revealed. Choose one; it is pushed and the others stay where they were.

Superplex.gac.name: Superplex
Superplex.gac.text:
Play this move only if you have hit three moves in a row and only in the ring. Countered by Shove, cannot be countered by Dodge.

If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn and you take 7 Back damage. If countered, you are stunned until the end of the turn.

SteveBlackman.gac.name: Steve Blackman
SteveBlackman.gac.text:
Hardcore Superstar

The first six times Steve Blackman counters with a non-Defensive move, he draws a page. (This page is drawn when the page is played, not when the counter move connects.)

CollarAndElbowTieup.gac.name: Collar And Elbow Tieup
CollarAndElbowTieup.gac.text:
Play only if you haven't connected with a non-Defensive move this match. Countered by Collar and Elbow Tieup.

If you have any Technical, the next Momentum page in your opponent's playbook is ditched.
If you have any Knowledge, you draw a page.

LouTheszPress.gac.name: Lou Thesz Press
LouTheszPress.gac.text:
Stone Cold Trademark

Counters mad rush moves. If you have no Warnings, gain +1 Attitude. If you played a Damage Special this turn, Drop The Hammer is drawn from your playbook.

DragonSleeper2E.gac.name: Dragon Sleeper
DragonSleeper2E.gac.text: Your opponent takes 6 head damage per turn.

ChristmasChaos.gac.name: 3D
ChristmasChaos.gac.text:
Dudleyz Trademark

Play only if you have both Bubba Ray and D-Von in play, and only if you haven't connected with this move this match.

This move can't be countered, but may be autocountered for +2 pages. If a Referee special is in play, you get 10 Warnings.

CollarAndElbowTieup2E.gac.name: Collar And Elbow Tieup
CollarAndElbowTieup2E.gac.text:
Play only if you haven't connected with a non-Defensive move this match. Countered by Collar and Elbow Tieup.

If you have any Technical, the next Momentum page in your opponent's playbook is ditched.
If you have any Knowledge, you draw a page.

BodySlamEX1.gac.name: Body Slam
BodySlamEX1.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

If you played a Damage Special with this move, you draw a Damage Special from your playbook.

AgilityJericho.gac.name: Y2J
AgilityJericho.gac.text:
Only Chris Jericho can play Y2J, only if you have hit two moves in a row, and only once per match.
Gain 1 Agility Momentum and draw a page. Your opponent sees this page when you play it.

Taunt2E.gac.name: Taunt
Taunt2E.gac.text:
Draw a page.

Your opponent loses one Attitude. Your next move does +2 damage.

(Heel pages can't be played if you've already played a Face page.)

RolloverCounter.gac.name: Rollover Counter
RolloverCounter.gac.text: This move can't be used offensively. Counters standing above moves. If this move connects, your opponent takes damage equal to the base damage of the countered move. Counts as 2 pages when you choose to ditch it.

ShoulderToMidsection.gac.name: Shoulder To Midsection
ShoulderToMidsection.gac.text:
Counters in close moves.

If this move connects and wasn't used as a counter, a random victim below move is drawn from your playbook.

Frustrated.gac.name: Frustrated
Frustrated.gac.text: A random one of your Gameplans are ditched from play. You can't play special pages from hand (excluding Once Too Often). You can't attempt to pin (unless it is from a move). This page leaves play when your opponent takes a total of 8 damage from your moves.

TheAPA.gac.name: The APA
TheAPA.gac.text:
At the end of each turn there is a 33% chance a random Heel or Run In page in your opponent's hand is ditched.

(You may only have one Support page in play.)

VerticalSuplexEX3.gac.name: Vertical Suplex
VerticalSuplexEX3.gac.text: If your opponent has at least 2 Technical, he loses 1.

OffTheTopOfTheLadder.gac.name: Off The Top Of The Ladder
OffTheTopOfTheLadder.gac.text:
Play only if a Ladder is in play. You can play another Special this turn.
Choose a high risk move from your playbook. It is drawn to your hand. If your next move is high risk and you connect, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

MafiaKick.gac.name: Mafia Kick
MafiaKick.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

This move does up to +5 damage. Your opponent is put on the mat.

SlingshotIntoPost.gac.name: Slingshot Into Post
SlingshotIntoPost.gac.text:
Counters victim below moves. Can only be used offensively if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent is put on the mat. If played at Ringside, your opponent is Busted Wide Open.

DistractTheReferee2E.gac.name: Distract The Referee
DistractTheReferee2E.gac.text: The Referee is distracted for 1 to 6 turns (any Referee Special in play is removed). Distracted Referees do not give warnings, and the match can't end except by time limit draw. If a Referee is played later, this page leaves play.

EyeRake2E.gac.name: Eye Rake
EyeRake2E.gac.text:
This move counters arm extended, in close, standing above and behind opponent moves.

You receive 2 Warnings and your opponent loses +1 Attitude.

CornerBarage.gac.name: Corner Barrage
CornerBarage.gac.text:
Play this move only if you have hit two moves in a row and only in the ring.

If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

Breakdown.gac.name: Breakdown
Breakdown.gac.text:
Chris Jericho Finisher

For each type of Momentum (including Attitude) that you have at least as much as your opponent, this move does +3 damage. This move stuns your opponent until the end of the next turn if Steel Folding Chair is in play.

ScissorsKickEX2.gac.name: Scissors Kick
ScissorsKickEX2.gac.text:
Booker T Finisher

Play only in the ring. Countered by Dodge, not by Shove.

Your opponent is put on the mat. This move does +2 damage (up to +12) for each special that was in your hand and your opponent's hand when you played this move.

SnapSuplex.gac.name: Snap Suplex
SnapSuplex.gac.text:
Counters head down and in close moves.

This move does +1 damage for each Attitude you have, up to +5.

Hurricanrana.gac.name: Hurricanrana
Hurricanrana.gac.text:
Countered by Power Bomb.
Your opponent ditches 2 pages. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

If you have any Technical, you pin your opponent. If the pin fails you stay in Control. If countered, you are stunned until the end of the turn.

Headlock2E.gac.name: Headlock
Headlock2E.gac.text:
Counters behind opponent and in close moves.

When this move connects, you draw a page if your opponent has any head damage. Your opponent cannot submit to this move.

RefereeTimWhite.gac.name: Referee Tim White
RefereeTimWhite.gac.text:
All pins have a -10% pin chance.

(You may only play a Referee if there is no other Referee in play.)

DropTheHammerEX1.gac.name: Drop The Hammer
DropTheHammerEX1.gac.text:
Stone Cold Trademark

Play only when your opponent is on the mat in the ring. If you connected with Lou Thesz Press last turn, gain +1 Attitude. If you have any Warnings, this move does +5 damage.

PunchEX1.gac.name: Punch
PunchEX1.gac.text:
Counters standing above moves.

Choose a Strike move from your playbook. That page is drawn to your hand.

JawbreakerEX2.gac.name: Jawbreaker
JawbreakerEX2.gac.text:
Counters victim below moves.

When you play this page you lose 1 Attitude (if you have any).

Intensity.gac.name: Intensity
Intensity.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Trademark

When you play a Technical or Strength move, if your next page in your Playbook is a Momentum page, you draw it. Intensity leaves play if your opponent hits with 4 moves in a row. You can only have one Intensity in play.

WithAuthorityWMX8.gac.name: With Authority! (Wrestlemania X8)
WithAuthorityWMX8.gac.text: Play with a move while in control. This move can't be Autocountered and if the move connects your opponent ditches a random Special from hand.

StandingSwitch2E.gac.name: Standing Switch
StandingSwitch2E.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters behind opponent and in close moves. Countered by back to foe moves and Standing Switch. This move provides no Attitude.

PumpHandleSlamEX2.gac.name: Pump Handle Slam
PumpHandleSlamEX2.gac.text:
Test Trademark

Counters head down and back to foe moves. If your opponent isn't stunned and has connected with less Impact moves than you, he is stunned until the end of next turn.

ReverseDDT.gac.name: Reverse DDT
ReverseDDT.gac.text:
Counters in close moves. Can only be used as a counter if you have Agility.

The next four pages from your opponent's playbook are ditched.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

DDT2E.gac.name: DDT
DDT2E.gac.text:
Counters head down moves.

Choose one: A random special in your opponent's hand is ditched or you gain +1 Attitude.

SpinningHeelKickEX2.gac.name: Step-Over Heel Kick
SpinningHeelKickEX2.gac.text:
Rob Van Dam Trademark

Counters leg extended moves. Your opponent is put on the mat and you draw a random Agility move from your playbook.
(Counts as Spinning Heel Kick.)

KurtAngle.gac.name: Kurt Angle
KurtAngle.gac.text: At the start of turns 1 and 20, Kurt Angle gets +1 Knowledge.

BigDogInTheYardEX1.gac.name: Big Dog In The Yard
BigDogInTheYardEX1.gac.text:
Undertaker Trademark

Play only while in control. Choose a Momentum. If your next move connects, it does +3 damage for each point of that Momentum your opponent has (up to +15), then your opponent loses 1 of that Momentum.

Leapfrogged.gac.name: Leapfrogged
Leapfrogged.gac.text:
Play only if you connected with Leapfrog last turn.

If your next move counters mad rush moves, you draw a random Momentum from your playbook. If it connects, you get +1 Attitude.

Chop.gac.name: Chop
Chop.gac.text:
Countered by Chop.

If used to counter Chop, you take 4 damage and if your opponent's playbook has a Chop, your opponent draws it.

DoubleLegTakedown2E.gac.name: Double Leg Takedown
DoubleLegTakedown2E.gac.text: Counters leg extended and victim below moves.

Clothesline2E.gac.name: Clothesline
Clothesline2E.gac.text:
Counters hit or miss and leg extended moves. Countered by Clothesline and Duck.

Your opponent is put on the mat.

ChokeslamToTheFloor.gac.name: Chokeslam To The Floor
ChokeslamToTheFloor.gac.text:
Big Superstars Trademark

Can only be played against Cruiserweights and only in the ring. They are moved to ringside.

(Counts as "Chokeslam")

TornadoDDT.gac.name: Tornado DDT
TornadoDDT.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit two moves in a row.

Your opponent's next 2 pages from playbook and 1 random page from hand are ditched. Your opponent takes 3 Head damage.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount #target) 0))
          (sett NumDitched 0)
          (sett StopNum 1)
          (loop (not Done)
                (block 
                     (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount #target)))
                     (sett Card (item (WAGetHand #target) Ditch))
                     (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #target) (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
                     (WADitchPage #target (subtract Ditch 1))
                     (sett NumDitched (add NumDitched 1))
                     (if ((eq NumDitched StopNum)
                          (sett Done True)
                         )
                         (True
                          (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount #target) 0))
                         )
                     )
                )
          )
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

BroncoBuster.gac.name: Bronco Buster
BroncoBuster.gac.text:
Can be played only by X-Pac, and only when your opponent is on the mat, and only in the ring. Countered by Low Blow Kick.

This move does up to +7 damage.

UpAndOver.gac.name: Up and Over
UpAndOver.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters behind opponent and head down moves. Countered by back to foe moves and Standing Switch. This move provides no Momentum.

Strength1.gac.name: Strength
Strength1.gac.text: Gain 1 Strength. Your opponent can't see this page.

DropKick2E.gac.name: Drop Kick
DropKick2E.gac.text:
Counters high risk and mad rush moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat. If countered, you lose up to an additional two Attitude.

fields.Move_Countered:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Momentum (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
          (sett MLoss (WARandom 0 2))
          (sett Momentum (subtract Momentum MLoss))
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum Momentum)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

TheFinalCutEX1.gac.name: The Final Cut
TheFinalCutEX1.gac.text:
Big Show Finisher

Does +20 damage, -2 damage for each time your opponent has connected with a Takedown move this match (this bonus can't be less than 0).

FujiwaraArmbar.gac.name: Fujiwara Armbar
FujiwaraArmbar.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit two moves in a row.

Each turn, this move does 4 arm damage. This hold can only be applied for three turns. If you keep it applied for all three turns, you draw three pages.

AsaiMoonsault2E.gac.name: Asai Moonsault
AsaiMoonsault2E.gac.text:
Play only in the ring while your opponent is at ringside. You move to ringside when you play this move.
Draw a page (up to 4) for each move you have connected with since your opponent last had control.

ToritoLE.gac.name: Torito
ToritoLE.gac.text:
Rey Mysterio Trademark

The pages in your hand and your opponent's hand are shuffled into their owner's playbooks. Then, both draw replacement pages (one per page buried).

InjuredHead.gac.name: Injured Head
InjuredHead.gac.text: Whenever you connect with a standing above, behind opponent or head down move, there is a 50% chance that you ditch a random page.

HighFlyingStart.gac.name: High-Flying Start
HighFlyingStart.gac.text:
Play only if you have no Agility limit.

Draw a page and counter your opponent's move (if any). Your opponent moves to ringside and takes 5 damage. You are moved to ringside and Grounded.

MissileDropkick.gac.name: Missile Dropkick
MissileDropkick.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit three moves in a row and your opponent is on the mat in the ring.

Your opponent ditches 3 random pages. If countered, you're stunned until the end of the turn.

PushThePace.gac.name: Push The Pace
PushThePace.gac.text:
During the Refresh step, all Superstars have a 25% chance per point of Agility they have of drawing an extra page.

Special: The player in control may remove Push the Pace from the game.

fields.AI_PlayPage: (WASetValue #this AIScore 90)

TakerCareOfBusiness.gac.name: Taker Care Of Business
TakerCareOfBusiness.gac.text:
Undertaker Finisher

Your opponent takes 9 head damage per turn. If your opponent has a Strength limit, this move does +5 head damage per turn.

BookerT.gac.name: Booker T
BookerT.gac.text:
Special: Can You Dig It?

Choose a move page in hand. That page is ditched and you draw a page. This ability works nine times per match.

TheBigShowTourn.gac.name: The Big Show
TheBigShowTourn.gac.text:
Member of nWo

Special: G-Money

Your opponent's move does -4 damage. You can't use this Special again for 10 turns.

ShoulderBlock2E.gac.name: Shoulder Block
ShoulderBlock2E.gac.text: Counters leg extended moves. Countered by Shoulder Block.

RefereeNickPatrick.gac.name: Referee Nick Patrick
RefereeNickPatrick.gac.text:
You can't play this during a Hardcore match. If a Superstar ends a turn with more than 5 Warnings, they are given 10 more Warnings by the Referee.
Special: If you have 3 or more Warnings, you draw 3 pages. Each player can use this once per match.

AnglesAnkleLockEX3.gac.name: Angle's Ankle Lock
AnglesAnkleLockEX3.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Finisher

This move counters any move that costs 8 or more. (It can't counter anything else.)
Your opponent is put on the mat. This move does 5 leg damage each turn.

fields.Counters: arm extended|behind opponent|back to foe|head down|defensive|hit or miss|high risk|standing above|victim below|leg extended|in close|mad rush

NeckbreakerEX3.gac.name: Neckbreaker
NeckbreakerEX3.gac.text: If your opponent has at least 2 Strength, he loses 1.

ThrowOffTheStage.gac.name: Throw Off The Stage
ThrowOffTheStage.gac.text: Play only in a Hardcore match and only while at Ringside.

WithAuthorityWMX7.gac.name: With Authority! (Wrestlemania X-7)
WithAuthorityWMX7.gac.text:
(Counts as With Authority!)

Play only while in Control.
This move does +4 damage. If you have 17 Momentum or more, you draw a page and this move does +8 damage instead.

DodgeTourn.gac.name: Dodge
DodgeTourn.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters high risk, hit or miss, and standing above moves. Countered by victim below moves. This move provides no Attitude.

Stomp.gac.name: Stomp
Stomp.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent moves to ringside. If he has any Attitude, he loses two. Otherwise you draw a random Strike move.

SpineKick.gac.name: Spine Kick
SpineKick.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent takes 5 Back damage.

Unprettier.gac.name: Unprettier
Unprettier.gac.text:
Christian Finisher

This move does +2 damage for each momentum type your opponent has. If not already stunned, this move stuns your opponent until the end of the next turn.

TheBigElbowEX2.gac.name: The Big Elbow
TheBigElbowEX2.gac.text:
Test Trademark

Play only if your opponent is in the ring.

If your opponent is stunned, this move does +5 damage. If your opponent is on the mat, he stays on the mat, you draw a page and attempt a pin. You remain in control if the pin fails.

PowerBomb.gac.name: Power Bomb
PowerBomb.gac.text:
Countered by Hurricanrana.

If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

FlyingWheelKickEX3.gac.name: Flying Wheel Kick
FlyingWheelKickEX3.gac.text:
Countered by Duck.

Your opponent is put on the mat and you get Crowd Support.

DVon.gac.name: Half-Brother D-Von
DVon.gac.text:
Bubba Ray Dudley Trademark

Play only if D-Von isn't in the match. When at ringside, your opponent ditches a random momentum or special from hand at the end of each turn. 
Special: When you are in control and your opponent is on the mat, D-Von puts a Table into play. Use once per game.

Goldust.gac.name: Goldust
Goldust.gac.text:
Special: "The Bizarre One"

Ditch your entire hand. You draw ten pages. Use this ability only once, and only after turn 20.

fields.Special_Special:
(if ((eq #test 1)
     (and (greater (WAGetTurn) 20)
          (not (eq (WAGetValue #this UsedSpecial) 1))
          (not (eq (WAGetValue (WAGameMap) NoSpecialAbilities)
                   1
               )
          )
          (not (WAIsStunned #this))
     )
    )
    (True
     (block 
          (WASetValue #this UsedSpecial 1)
          (loop (greater (count (WAGetHand #this)) 0)
                (WADitchPage #this 0)
          )
          (WADrawPage #this)
          (WADrawPage #this)
          (WADrawPage #this)
          (WADrawPage #this)
          (WADrawPage #this)
          (WADrawPage #this)
          (WADrawPage #this)
          (WADrawPage #this)
          (WADrawPage #this)
          (WADrawPage #this)
     )
    )
)

BackHeelTrip.gac.name: Back Heel Trip
BackHeelTrip.gac.text:
Counters leg extended moves.

If your opponent doesn't have any Technical, this move can't be countered by a move.

TheNextBigThing.gac.name: The Next Big Thing
TheNextBigThing.gac.text:
Brock Lesnar Trademark

At the start of each turn, if your opponent is stunned you draw two pages.

IGotYourBack2E.gac.name: I Got Your Back
IGotYourBack2E.gac.text: Your opponent's Support is removed from play. You draw a random Support special from your playbook.

TechnicalEX1.gac.name: Technical
TechnicalEX1.gac.text: Gain 1 Technical. Your opponent can't see this page.

AnkleKeyLock.gac.name: Ankle Key Lock
AnkleKeyLock.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Each turn, the next 10 pages of your opponent's playbook are ditched (if there are 70 or more). Also, your opponent takes 6 leg damage each turn.

SnowsDragonSleeper.gac.name: Snow's Dragon Sleeper
SnowsDragonSleeper.gac.text:
Al Snow Finisher

Play only when the opponent is on the mat.

This move does 12 Head damage per turn.

EyeOfTheHurricaneLE.gac.name: Eye Of The Hurricane
EyeOfTheHurricaneLE.gac.text:
Hurricane Finisher

This move does +1 damage (up to +12) for each Technical move you have connected with. "Hook The Leg" is drawn from your playbook.

ArmDragCounter.gac.name: Arm Drag Counter
ArmDragCounter.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters arm extended and mad rush moves. Countered by in close moves. This move provides no Momentum.

DontTrustAnybody2E.gac.name: Don't Trust Anybody
DontTrustAnybody2E.gac.text: Choose Action, Gameplan, Support, Run In, or Referee. All specials of the chosen type in every Superstar's hand are buried.

ChokeOnTheRopes.gac.name: Choke On The Ropes
ChokeOnTheRopes.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.

You get 3 Warnings from the referee and you draw a page. Your opponent ditches a random page from hand.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WAWarn #superstar 3)
          (WADrawPage #superstar)
          (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount #target)))
          (sett Card (item (WAGetHand #target) Ditch))
          (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #target) (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
          (WADitchPage #target (subtract Ditch 1))
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

LowBlowKick2E.gac.name: Low Blow Kick
LowBlowKick2E.gac.text: You get 3 Warnings. Your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

FlipClothesline.gac.name: Flip Clothesline
FlipClothesline.gac.text:
This move may only be played by X-Pac.

This move does up to +5 damage.

SavageElbow.gac.name: The Big Elbow
SavageElbow.gac.text:
Test Trademark

Play only if your opponent is in the ring.

If your opponent is stunned, this move does +5 damage. If your opponent is on the mat, he stays on the mat, you draw a page and attempt a pin. You remain in control if the pin fails.

RoundKick2E.gac.name: Round Kick
RoundKick2E.gac.text: 33% chance your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

Punch.gac.name: Punch
Punch.gac.text: Counters arm extended and in close moves.

AgilityEX2.gac.name: Agility
AgilityEX2.gac.text: Gain 1 Agility. Your opponent can't see this page.

Edgeomatic2E.gac.name: Edge-o-matic
Edgeomatic2E.gac.text:
Edge Trademark

Counters back to foe moves. Your opponent can't play Specials (except Once Too Often) until this move is countered. You get a +7% pin chance for the rest of the match.

fields.Move_Connected: (WASetValue #superstar AffectPinScore (add 7 (WAGetValue #superstar AffectPinScore)))

NumbersGame.gac.name: Numbers Game
NumbersGame.gac.text:
Play only if you have Support.

Your opponent ditches a random page from hand. Choose one: you draw a page or gain +1 Attitude.

HandspringBackElbowLE.gac.name: Handspring Back Elbow
HandspringBackElbowLE.gac.text:
Tajiri Trademark

Play only in the ring. Counters mad rush moves. Your opponent is put on the mat. 

Strike Combo: Draw two random Strike moves from your playbook.

Pedigree2E.gac.name: Pedigree
Pedigree2E.gac.text:
Triple H Finisher

Counters head down moves. If your opponent has less than 40 pages left in his playbook, this move does +1 damage for each page less (up to +20.)

HoustonHangover.gac.name: Houston Hangover
HoustonHangover.gac.text:
Booker T Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. This move does +4 damage for each pair of Agility + Knowledge you have (up to +16).

GreatForm.gac.name: Great Balance
GreatForm.gac.text:
Play only if you have 1 Agility, 1 Technical and 2 Attitude. Your opponent sees this page when played.

Gain +1 Agility and +1 Technical Momentum, and lose 2 Attitude.

StandingSideHeadlock.gac.name: Standing Side Headlock
StandingSideHeadlock.gac.text:
Your opponent takes 1 Head damage per turn, but can't submit to this move.

When this move connects, you draw a random Hold from your playbook.

HollywoodHulkHoganTourn.gac.name: Hulk Hogan
HollywoodHulkHoganTourn.gac.text: The first five times you play a Face special you gain 1 Knowledge.

VictoryRoll.gac.name: Victory Roll
VictoryRoll.gac.text: Play only in the ring. Your opponent is put on the mat and you attempt to pin. If the pin fails you get +4 Attitude and +20% pin bonus for the rest of the match, but you lose control.

StunningBlow.gac.name: Stunning Blow
StunningBlow.gac.text:
Play only with an Impact move that is not a Finisher.
If your move connects your opponent takes an additional 4 damage and is Stunned until the end of the next turn.

FlyingClothesline.gac.name: Flying Clothesline
FlyingClothesline.gac.text:
Your opponent ditches a random page from hand and is put on the mat. If countered, you take 5 damage.

Agility Combo: Draw a page.

DropToeHoldTourn.gac.name: Drop Toe Hold
DropToeHoldTourn.gac.text:
Counters mad rush and hit or miss moves. Countered by standing above moves.
When played, you are put on the mat. This move may only be played offensively if you have played Irish Whip. If so, and this move connects and you have any Technical, your opponent ditches 4 pages from playbook.

TheBigShow.gac.name: The Big Show
TheBigShow.gac.text: The first 3 times you Autocounter without playing a Special that turn, you draw 3 pages.

SentonSplash2E.gac.name: Senton Splash
SentonSplash2E.gac.text:
Eddie Guerrero Trademark

Play only while your opponent is on the mat in the ring.
You gain +1 Attitude. If you have connected with more move types than your opponent, draw a page.

SpanishAnnounceTable.gac.name: Spanish Announce Table
SpanishAnnounceTable.gac.text: Play only at Ringside while in Control. When someone connects with a Takedown move at Ringside, their opponent takes 10 damage and is stunned for 2 turns, and this page leaves play. The superstar doing the move receives 6 Warnings.

BackUpPlan.gac.name: Back-Up Plan
BackUpPlan.gac.text:
Play once per match. When played, all pages in your hand are "moved inside" Back-Up Plan and you draw five pages.

Special: All of the pages in your hand are ditched and the pages "inside" Back-Up Plan are moved to your hand. Back-Up Plan is removed from the game.

RollUp.gac.name: Roll-up
RollUp.gac.text:
Counters leg extended moves. If this move connects as a counter your opponent ditches a random page.
Your opponent is put on the mat. You attempt a pin. If the pin fails you remain in control.

BigandNastyEX1.gac.name: Big and Nasty
BigandNastyEX1.gac.text:
Big Show Trademark

Your Strength moves do +2 damage. Your Strike moves that cost 4 or more have a 33% chance of stunning your opponent until the end of next turn. This page leaves play if you are hit with 3 moves in a row. You can only have one Big and Nasty in play.

InsideCradle.gac.name: Inside Cradle
InsideCradle.gac.text:
Counters in close and standing above moves.
Your opponent is put on the mat and you Pin your opponent. If the pin does not work you stay in Control. (After a failed pin attempt, your opponent is removed from the mat.)

PowerSlam.gac.name: Power Slam
PowerSlam.gac.text:
Counters high risk and mad rush moves. This move does an additional +1 damage for each Strength you have (up to +5.)
If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

HookTheLeg2E.gac.name: Hook The Leg
HookTheLeg2E.gac.text:
Play only if you are in control and if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.

You draw a page and attempt a pin. If the pin fails you remain in control and your move string is broken.

ChopPromo.gac.name: Chop
ChopPromo.gac.text:
Countered by Chop.

If used to counter Chop, you take 4 damage and if your opponent's playbook has a Chop, your opponent draws it.

ReleaseSpineBuster2E.gac.name: Release Spine Buster
ReleaseSpineBuster2E.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves. 

If your opponent has 7 back damage, he ditches all Strength moves in hand.

(Counts as "Spine Buster".)

InterviewWithTheCoach.gac.name: Interview With The Coach
InterviewWithTheCoach.gac.text:
Draw a page.

You are told what the first ten pages in your opponent's playbook are and where in your playbook your next momentum page is.

SentonBackSplash.gac.name: Senton Back Splash
SentonBackSplash.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat. If countered, you take 3 damage.

Otherwise this move does +2 damage for each type of Momentum you have more than your opponent and you get +1 Attitude.

PoseEX3.gac.name: Pose
PoseEX3.gac.text:
Play only if you have a Knowledge limit and only when in control.

Draw pages equal to your Attitude (up to 8), then lose your Attitude.

GrabTheRopes2E.gac.name: Grab The Ropes
GrabTheRopes2E.gac.text:
Play only if the referee is not distracted and only in the ring. Draw a page.
Any pin attempt, hold, or attempt to escape a steel cage is countered. Your opponent remains in control but can't attempt to pin or escape until another move has been played.

ShortArmClothesline.gac.name: Short Arm Clothesline
ShortArmClothesline.gac.text:
Counters arm extended moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat. Your opponent loses 1 Knowledge.

TooBig.gac.name: Too Big
TooBig.gac.text:
Big Show Trademark

Counters all Takedown moves. Countered by Strike moves that aren't Takedown moves. This move can't be played offensively, and you can't play this if your opponent has 4 Technical or 4 Strength.

fields.Counters: arm extended|behind opponent|back to foe|head down|defensive|hit or miss|high risk|standing above|victim below|leg extended|in close|mad rush
fields.Countered_By: arm extended|behind opponent|back to foe|head down|defensive|hit or miss|high risk|standing above|victim below|leg extended|in close|mad rush
fields.Page_Played: (WAMessage -1 "Jim Ross: The Big Show is 500 pounds -- he's just too big.")

SplashEX2.gac.name: Splash
SplashEX2.gac.text: Play only if your opponent is on the mat. If countered, you take 4 damage.

FishermansSuplex.gac.name: Fisherman's Suplex
FishermansSuplex.gac.text: Your opponent is pinned. If the pin does not work you stay in Control.

LaMagistralCradle2E.gac.name: La Magistral Cradle
LaMagistralCradle2E.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent ditches a random page from hand and you attempt a pin. If the pin fails you remain in control.

AngleSlam2E.gac.name: Angle Slam
AngleSlam2E.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Finisher

Counters arm extended, in close, and back to foe moves. This move does +5 damage for each "Three I's" Special you have in play.

FlipFlopAndFly.gac.name: Flip Flop and Fly
FlipFlopAndFly.gac.text:
Bubba Ray Dudley Trademark

Your opponent is put on the mat. If he has a Status, you draw a page. Otherwise, he is Staggered.

Sleeper2E.gac.name: Sleeper
Sleeper2E.gac.text: Counters mad rush moves. Countered by Back Suplex. This move does 2 head damage per turn. Each turn, if your opponent has 0 Attitude, a random move from his hand is ditched. Otherwise, he loses 1 Attitude.

LeapingAxeKick.gac.name: Leaping Side Kick
LeapingAxeKick.gac.text:
Booker T Trademark

Your opponent is put on the mat. If you played a Damage special with this move and it connects, you draw two random Drop moves. Otherwise, this does up to +4 damage.

UpAndOverTourn.gac.name: Up and Over
UpAndOverTourn.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters behind opponent and head down moves. Countered by back to foe moves and Standing Switch. This move provides no Attitude.

KneeDropToElbow.gac.name: Knee Drop to Leg
KneeDropToElbow.gac.text:
Play this move only if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent takes 5 Leg damage. If countered, you lose up to an additional 2 Momentum.

fields.Move_Countered:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Momentum (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
          (sett MLoss (WARandom 0 2))
          (sett Momentum (subtract Momentum MLoss))
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum Momentum)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

TrashTalking.gac.name: Trash Talking
TrashTalking.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit two moves in a row.
A random move with a cost equal to your total Momentum is drawn from your playbook. If there aren't any, you gain 1 Attitude instead.
(Heel page.)

SensingVictory2E.gac.name: Sensing Victory
SensingVictory2E.gac.text:
Willpower 2
Draw a page. Each turn during the Refresh step you find out how many Hit Points your opponent has. This page leaves play when you're stunned. You can only have one Sensing Victory in play.

WillToWin2E.gac.name: Will To Win
WillToWin2E.gac.text:
Willpower 3 (This page counts as three for Autocountering.)

This page can't be played.

HighImpactMove.gac.name: High Impact Move
HighImpactMove.gac.text:
Play only with an Impact move.
If the move connects, it does +4 damage and your opponent loses all but one of his Strength and Strike Momentum. For each Strength lost, a copy of "Strength" is added to his hand. For each Strike lost, a copy of "Strike" is added to his hand.

GermanSuplex2E.gac.name: German Suplex
GermanSuplex2E.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves.

Your opponent loses +1 Attitude and you attempt to pin. You stay in control if the pin fails.

GreatLeverage.gac.name: Great Leverage
GreatLeverage.gac.text:
Play only if you have 1 Strength, 1 Technical and 2 Attitude. Your opponent sees this page when played.

Gain +1 Strength and +1 Technical Momentum, and lose 2 Attitude.

ThrowIntoTheCage.gac.name: Throw Into The Cage
ThrowIntoTheCage.gac.text:
Play only in a Cage Match, and only if you have at least as much Strength as your opponent. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.
(Counts as "Throw Over The Ropes.")

HogansLegDrop2E.gac.name: Hogan's Leg Drop
HogansLegDrop2E.gac.text:
Hulk Hogan Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat. If you have 7 Knowledge and you haven't yet connected with this move this match, this move can't be countered.
(Counts as "Leg Drop")

TimeToPlayTheGame.gac.name: Time To Play The Game
TimeToPlayTheGame.gac.text:
Triple H Trademark

If you have 10 Momentum or more at the end of turn 20, you draw 4 pages.

(Superstars may only play one Entrance, and only on turn one or two.)

FlyingForearm.gac.name: Flying Forearm
FlyingForearm.gac.text:
Play only in the ring.

Gain +2 Attitude. Your opponent is put on the mat.

RunningClotheslineEX2.gac.name: Running Clothesline
RunningClotheslineEX2.gac.text: Counters mad rush moves. Choose a page in hand. If this move connects that page is ditched, you get Crowd Support, your opponent ditches a random page from hand and is put on the mat.

BodySlam2E.gac.name: Body Slam
BodySlam2E.gac.text: Counters mad rush and high risk moves.

RollingGermanSuplex2E.gac.name: Rolling German Suplex
RollingGermanSuplex2E.gac.text:
Chris Benoit Trademark

Counters back to foe moves.

This move does +1 to +8 damage and your opponent ditches 1 to 3 random pages.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Victim #target)
          (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount Victim) 0))
          (sett NumDitched 0)
          (sett StopNum (WARandom 1 3))
          (loop (not Done)
                (block 
                     (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount Victim)))
                     (sett Card (item (WAGetHand Victim) Ditch))
                     (WAMessage (WAGetOwner Victim) (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
                     (WADitchPage Victim (subtract Ditch 1))
                     (sett NumDitched (add NumDitched 1))
                     (if ((eq NumDitched StopNum)
                          (sett Done True)
                         )
                         (True
                          (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount Victim) 0))
                         )
                     )
                )
          )
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

Lionsault2E.gac.name: Lionsault
Lionsault2E.gac.text:
Chris Jericho Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat and in the ring.

You gain +1 Attitude and attempt to pin. If the pin fails you remain in control.

Kane.gac.name: Kane
Kane.gac.text: Kane takes -1 damage from Impact moves and ignores the first Stun he receives.

Edge2E.gac.name: Edge
Edge2E.gac.text: Each time you connect with a move you haven't connected yet, you get a +0-4% pin chance bonus for the rest of the match. (When you pin, you are told your current bonus total.)

HulkUp2E.gac.name: Hulk Up!
HulkUp2E.gac.text:
Hulk Hogan Trademark
Play while not in control when you have less than 25 Hit Points. For three turns your opponent can't pin. His moves must be Strike moves (and not Holds or Finishers). You can't counter moves. You take no damage from moves and gain 1 Attitude each turn. After three turns you gain control.

DirtiestPlayerInTheGame.gac.name: Dirtiest Player In The Game
DirtiestPlayerInTheGame.gac.text:
Ric Flair Trademark

Draw a page.

If you play a Strike move as a counter, it can't be countered. You receive no Warnings this turn. This page leaves play at the end of the turn.

CatchHimStunned.gac.name: Catch Him Stunned
CatchHimStunned.gac.text:
Play only if you are in control and your opponent is Stunned.

Your opponent ditches three pages at random and you attempt a pin.

BackSuplexEX3.gac.name: Back Suplex
BackSuplexEX3.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves.

Technical Combo: "Strength" is drawn from your playbook.

BackItUp.gac.name: Back It Up!
BackItUp.gac.text:
Rikishi Trademark

Your Drop moves do +5 damage. When you connect with a mad rush move, your opponent loses an extra 2 Attitude.
(Superstars may only play one Entrance, and only on turn one or two.)

FlairFlop.gac.name: Flair Flop
FlairFlop.gac.text:
Ric Flair Trademark

Play only when not in control. You draw five pages. Your opponent gets 4 Attitude.

fields.Page_Played:
(if ((eq #page #this)
     (block 
          (WASetValue (WAGameMap) PlayedFlairFlop 1)
          (WASetValue 
               (WAGameMap)
               EventsPlayed
               (add 1
                    (WAGetValue (WAGameMap) EventsPlayed)
               )
          )
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum (add 4 (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum)))
     )
    )
)

WithAuthorityEX1Release.gac.name: With Authority! (No Way Out Release)
WithAuthorityEX1Release.gac.text:
Play with a move that isn't defensive. That move does +5 damage.

When you play this special, if your opponent is on the mat, draw a page.

Improv.gac.name: Improv
Improv.gac.text: Play only while not in control. Name a page. If it is in the next 6 pages in your playbook, you draw it. Otherwise, gain 1 Attitude. (Each Event special may only be played once per match, and no more than three Events total.)

fields.Page_Played:
(if ((eq #page #this)
     (block 
          (WASetValue (WAGameMap) PlayedImprov 1)
          (WASetValue 
               (WAGameMap)
               EventsPlayed
               (add 1
                    (WAGetValue (WAGameMap) EventsPlayed)
               )
          )
          (WAMessage -1 "Jim Ross: Let's see if" (WAGetName #initiator) "can improvise a solution...")
          (sett MatchName (WAStringGetValue #this User_Data))
          (sett MatchPage (WACreatePageByUNID (WAGetPlayedBy #this) MatchName))
          (sett MatchUNID (WAGetUNID MatchPage))
          (sett MyPlaybook (WAGetPlaybook #initiator))
          (if ((or (eq (item MyPlaybook 1) MatchUNID)
                   (eq (item MyPlaybook 2) MatchUNID)
                   (eq (item MyPlaybook 3) MatchUNID)
                   (eq (item MyPlaybook 4) MatchUNID)
                   (eq (item MyPlaybook 5) MatchUNID)
                   (eq (item MyPlaybook 6) MatchUNID)
               )
               (WADrawPageByUNID #initiator MatchUNID)
              )
              (True
               (WASetValue #initiator Generic_Momentum (add 1 (WAGetValue #initiator Generic_Momentum)))
              )
          )
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

Facebuster2E.gac.name: Facebuster
Facebuster2E.gac.text:
Triple H Trademark

Your opponent ditches pages from his playbook equal to the amount of Technical and Strength Momentum you have.

RunningNeckbreaker.gac.name: Running Neckbreaker
RunningNeckbreaker.gac.text:
Counters head down moves.

Choose a page in hand. If this move connects that page is ditched, you get Crowd Support and your opponent is put on the mat.

TheUnamericans.gac.name: The Un-Americans
TheUnamericans.gac.text:
Un-Americans Trademark

Superstars who are not Un-Americans cannot play pages that begin with the letter "U", "S" or "A". (Momentum and Defensive moves are immune.)
Special: Your opponent loses 5 Attitude. Use this ability once.

DVonEX2.gac.name: Half-Brother D-Von
DVonEX2.gac.text:
Bubba Ray Dudley Trademark

Play only if D-Von isn't in the match. When at ringside, your opponent ditches a random momentum or special from hand at the end of each turn. 
Special: When you are in control and your opponent is on the mat, D-Von puts a Table into play. Use once per game.

RunningLadderShot.gac.name: Running Ladder Shot
RunningLadderShot.gac.text:
This move requires a Ladder in play. Counters Climb The Ladder.

You get 5 Warnings and a +5% climb chance. Your opponent is put on the mat and unless he has 2 Agility, he is Busted Wide Open.

BaseballSlideEX2.gac.name: Baseball Slide
BaseballSlideEX2.gac.text: Play only if your opponent is at ringside while you are in the ring. When you play this move you move to ringside. If it is countered, your opponent ditches two random pages from hand, but you are stunned until the end of the turn.

KnowledgeEX3.gac.name: Knowledge
KnowledgeEX3.gac.text: Gain +1 Knowledge. Your opponent can't see this page.

TestEX2.gac.name: Test
TestEX2.gac.text:
"Un-Americans" Member

Your Impact moves do +1 damage for each other Impact move you have connected with. This count resets when you lose control.

DragonSleeper.gac.name: Dragon Sleeper
DragonSleeper.gac.text: Your opponent takes 6 Head damage per turn.

KneeLift2E.gac.name: Knee Lift
KneeLift2E.gac.text: Counters in close and head down moves.

OlympicSlam.gac.name: Angle Slam
OlympicSlam.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Finisher

Counters arm extended, in close, and back to foe moves. This move does +5 damage for each "Three I's" Special you have in play.

RunTheRails.gac.name: Run The Rails
RunTheRails.gac.text:
Jeff Hardy Trademark

Play only at ringside and only once per match. If this move connects your opponent's next 20 pages in playbook are ditched. If countered, the next 10 pages in your playbook are ditched and you are stunned for the rest of the turn.

ThrowOverTheRopes.gac.name: Throw Over The Ropes
ThrowOverTheRopes.gac.text: Play only in the ring. Your opponent is sent to Ringside. Unless already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

DudleyDog.gac.name: Dudley Dog
DudleyDog.gac.text:
Spike Dudley Finisher

Play only in the ring. You attempt to pin your opponent with a pin chance bonus equal to half your opponent's starting hit points. You stay in control if the pin fails.

BackBodyDrop2E.gac.name: Back Body Drop
BackBodyDrop2E.gac.text: Counters mad rush and victim below moves. Countered by Facebuster.

AtomicDrop.gac.name: Atomic Drop
AtomicDrop.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves.

50% chance your opponent loses an additional Momentum.

CrucifixPowerbomb.gac.name: Crucifix Powerbomb
CrucifixPowerbomb.gac.text:
Play only if you haven't connected with this move this match. Countered by Up and Over.

If you have 4 Strength or more, your opponent's next 17 pages from playbook are ditched.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WASetValue #superstar Crucifixed 1)
          (if ((greater-eq (WAGetValue #superstar Strength_Momentum) 4)
               (block 
                    (if ((WAHasModifier #target '$Female)

PunchesInTheCornerEX2.gac.name: Punches In The Corner
PunchesInTheCornerEX2.gac.text:
Play only in the ring and only if you have hit two moves in a row.
Each turn this hold is applied, this move does 3 damage per turn for each Status special your opponent has. It can only be applied for three turns.

BackBodyDrop.gac.name: Back Body Drop
BackBodyDrop.gac.text: Counters mad rush and victim below moves. Countered by Facebuster.

WillToWin.gac.name: Will To Win
WillToWin.gac.text:
Willpower 3 (This page counts as three for Autocountering.)

This page can't be played.

PierSixBrawl.gac.name: Pier Six Brawl
PierSixBrawl.gac.text: Play only while in control, and if you haven't played a move this turn. For the next 5 turns, Superstars may only use Strike moves. Those moves can't be countered, but can be Autocountered for -3 pages. Specials, pin attempts, Finishers and Holds aren't allowed. Control changes at the end of each turn.

fields.Page_Played:
(if ((eq #page #this)
     (block 
          (WAAddValue (WAGameMap) NoSpecialAbilities 1)
          (WAAddValue (WAGameMap) PlayedPierSixBrawl 1)
          (WAAddValue 
               (WAGameMap)
               EventsPlayed
               (add (WAGetValue (WAGameMap) EventsPlayed)
                    1
               )
          )
          (WAAddValue #this TurnsInPlay 0)
          (WAAddValue #this '$InControl #incontrol)
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

Poison2E.gac.name: Poison
Poison2E.gac.text:
nWo Trademark

Whenever a Superstar connects with a move, if they have already connected with two in a row, that Superstar loses 1 Attitude.

SwantonBomb.gac.name: Swanton Bomb
SwantonBomb.gac.text:
Jeff Hardy Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.

You attempt to pin your opponent with a +2% pin bonus for each turn that has passed in the match.

ThrustKick.gac.name: Thrust Kick
ThrustKick.gac.text: Your opponent is put on the mat. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

BookerTsKneeDrop.gac.name: Booker T's Knee Drop
BookerTsKneeDrop.gac.text:
Booker T Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat. Your opponent loses one Momentum of the type he has the most in (including Attitude) unless he only has one of that type.

BigSplash.gac.name: Big Splash
BigSplash.gac.text:
Big Superstars Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat. Your opponent loses 1 Technical. If the move is countered you're stunned for the rest of the turn.
(Counts as "Splash.")

KnowledgeTourn.gac.name: Knowledge
KnowledgeTourn.gac.text: Gain 1 Knowledge. Your opponent can't see this page.

WhipIntoSteelSteps2E.gac.name: Whip Into Steel Steps
WhipIntoSteelSteps2E.gac.text:
Play this move only when both you and your opponent are at Ringside.

Your opponent ditches two random pages and is put on the mat. You gain +1 Attitude.

WithAuthority1Ann.gac.name: With Authority! (One Year Anniversary)
WithAuthority1Ann.gac.text:
Play only while in Control. This move does +6 damage to your opponent's most damaged body part, and may not be Autocountered.
(If used with a Hold, it can be autocountered after the first turn it is applied.)

LitasMoonsault2E.gac.text:
Lita Finisher

(Counts as "Moonsault.")

VanDaminatorEX2.gac.text:
Rob Van Dam Trademark

Counters "Chair Shot" and "Chair to the Back". Unless one is already in play, Steel Folding Chair is put into play when you play this move. If this move connects as a counter, your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn. Otherwise, you get 4 Warnings.

GotAllOfIt2E.gac.name: Got All Of It!
GotAllOfIt2E.gac.text:
Play only with a move that isn't defensive.

This move does +1 damage for each Strength you have (up to +14). Your opponent can't play specials this turn unless the move is countered.

ClotheslineInTheCorner.gac.name: Clothesline In The Corner
ClotheslineInTheCorner.gac.text: Play only in the ring. Your opponent loses 1 Attitude.

SideBackBreakerEX2.gac.name: Side Back Breaker
SideBackBreakerEX2.gac.text: Counters mad rush moves. To play, you must choose and ditch a page from hand. This move does 7 back damage.

TheUndertakerEX1.gac.name: The Undertaker
TheUndertakerEX1.gac.text: The first five times your opponent counters one of your moves that cost 6 or more to play, you draw a page.

ChokeOnTheRopesEX2.gac.name: Choke On The Ropes
ChokeOnTheRopesEX2.gac.text: Play only when your opponent is on the mat in the ring. You get 1 Warning and your opponent is Staggered.

GermanSuplex.gac.name: German Suplex
GermanSuplex.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves.

Your opponent loses 1 additional Momentum and is pinned. If the pin does not work you stay in Control.

WorkingStiff2E.gac.name: Working Stiff
WorkingStiff2E.gac.text: Each of your Strike moves get a random bonus of +1 to +4 damage, but not more than the base damage of the move. This page leaves play when you are stunned. You can only have one Working Stiff in play.

Punch2E.gac.name: Punch
Punch2E.gac.text: Counters arm extended and in close moves.

BellyToBellySuplex2E.gac.name: Belly-to-Belly Suplex
BellyToBellySuplex2E.gac.text: Counters in close and mad rush moves.

Splash2E.gac.name: Splash
Splash2E.gac.text: Play only if your opponent is on the mat. Your opponent stays on the mat. Unless your opponent has less than 4 pages in hand, your opponent ditches 1 random page. If countered, you lose up to an additional 2 Attitude.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WASetOnMat #target 1)
          (sett Done (lesser (WAGetHandCount #target) 4))
          (sett NumDitched 0)
          (sett StopNum 1)
          (loop (not Done)
                (block 
                     (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount #target)))
                     (sett Card (item (WAGetHand #target) Ditch))
                     (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #target) (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
                     (WADitchPage #target (subtract Ditch 1))
                     (sett NumDitched (add NumDitched 1))
                     (if ((eq NumDitched StopNum)
                          (sett Done True)
                         )
                         (True
                          (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount #target) 0))
                         )
                     )
                )
          )
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)
fields.Move_Countered:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Momentum (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
          (sett MLoss (WARandom 0 2))
          (sett Momentum (subtract Momentum MLoss))
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum Momentum)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

StiffForearmShot.gac.name: Stiff Forearm Shot
StiffForearmShot.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent loses 1 Strength and takes 3 Head damage.

MomentumShift.gac.name: Momentum Shift
MomentumShift.gac.text:
Play only when not in control.
If you connect with a move that does at least 3 damage, your opponent loses +3 Attitude and you gain +3 Attitude. This page leaves play at the start of the next turn. (If your opponent has less than 3 Attitude, your opponent loses all of it and you gain the amount lost.)

Elbow.gac.name: Elbow
Elbow.gac.text: Counters back to foe and behind opponent moves.

StandBackTheresAHurricaneComingThrough.g.name: There's a Hurricane Coming Through!
StandBackTheresAHurricaneComingThrough.g.text:
Hurricane Trademark

After turn 25, whenever you connect with a move that costs 6 or more your opponent ditches two random pages from hand.

AsaiMoonsault.gac.name: Asai Moonsault
AsaiMoonsault.gac.text:
Play this move only if your opponent is at Ringside. You may play this move from Ringside or in the ring, and are sent to Ringside when you play this move.

This move does up to +5 damage. Your opponent ditches 2 random pages. If countered, you are stunned until the end of the turn.

EvenThingsUp.gac.name: I Got Your Back
EvenThingsUp.gac.text:
Your opponent's Support is removed from play. You draw a Support special from your playbook.

(Face page: cannot be played if you have played a Heel page.)

HighCrossBodyEX3.gac.name: High Cross Body
HighCrossBodyEX3.gac.text: You draw a page. If in the ring, you attempt to pin your opponent. If the pin fails, or if at ringside, you get a 5% pin bonus for the rest of the match.

LowBlowUppercut.gac.name: Low Blow Uppercut
LowBlowUppercut.gac.text:
Counters leg extended and victim below moves. You get 4 Warnings from the Referee. This move does up to +7 damage.
There is a 50% chance your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn. (Heel page.)

ChairShotEX2.gac.name: Chair Shot
ChairShotEX2.gac.text: Play only if Steel Folding Chair is in play. You get 5 Warnings. Your opponent is put on the mat. For each Strike you have there is a 10% chance your opponent is Busted Wide Open, and this move does +2 damage (up to +12).

MonkeyFlip.gac.name: Monkey Flip
MonkeyFlip.gac.text:
Play only in the ring. Can only be played offensively if you have just played Irish Whip. Counters mad rush moves. Countered by hit or miss moves that are Drop moves.
When you play this move you are put on the mat.

RobVanDamEX2.gac.name: Rob Van Dam
RobVanDamEX2.gac.text:
Special: R-V-D
Use once per match after turn 10, while in control, and before you play a move. Draw 1 page and gain 1 Attitude for each move in a row you've connected with. You can't play more pages this turn.

Elbow2E.gac.name: Elbow
Elbow2E.gac.text: Counters back to foe and behind opponent moves.

SetUpATable2E.gac.name: Set Up A Table
SetUpATable2E.gac.text: Play only if your opponent is stunned or if you have 10 Momentum. A Table is put into play. This move provides no Attitude.

Intelligence2E.gac.name: Intelligence
Intelligence2E.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Trademark

When you play Knowledge, if your next page in your playbook is a special page, you draw it. Intelligence leaves play if you are hit with a move that does 7 damage or more. You can only have one Intelligence in play.

PayThePrice.gac.name: Pay The Price
PayThePrice.gac.text:
Play only if you have 7 or more damage on a body part, or less than 22 Hit Points.
At the end of each turn, you draw an extra page, the top two pages in your playbook are ditched, and you take 1 damage on your most damaged body part.

AgilityEX1.gac.name: Agility
AgilityEX1.gac.text: Gain 1 Agility. Your opponent can't see this page.

HighKnee2E.gac.name: High Knee
HighKnee2E.gac.text:
Triple H Trademark

Counters mad rush moves. Your opponent is put on the mat and ditches pages from his playbook equal to your Attitude. This move cant be countered by Strength moves.

Slap2E.gac.name: Slap
Slap2E.gac.text: Your opponent ditches a random page from hand that isn't momentum, and gains 3 Attitude.

ShoveWithLegs.gac.name: Shove With Legs
ShoveWithLegs.gac.text:
This move may not be played offensively. Counters standing above moves.

This page counts as 2 pages when you choose to ditch it.

BackSuplexEX1.gac.name: Back Suplex
BackSuplexEX1.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves.

Choose one: Your opponent ditches a Knowledge Momentum from hand or your opponent ditches a random Special from hand.

ChrisJerichoPromo.gac.name: Chris Jericho
ChrisJerichoPromo.gac.text:
Special: Jerichoholics
Lose 1 Attitude and choose a Momentum from your playbook. That page is drawn. Use this ability three times per match and only if you have at least 1 Attitude.

VinceMcMahon2E.gac.name: Vince McMahon
VinceMcMahon2E.gac.text: If you begin a turn with 8 Knowledge and a Technical Hold applied that costs 7 or more, there is a 33% chance that Vince McMahon declares you the winner of the match by Submission. (Even if there is no Referee.)

InvertedAtomicDropEX2.gac.name: Inverted Atomic Drop
InvertedAtomicDropEX2.gac.text:
Counters in close moves.

Choose a hit or miss move in your playbook. You draw that page if this move connects.

ScottyTooHottie.gac.name: Scotty 2 Hotty
ScottyTooHottie.gac.text:
Special: Turn it up!

Choose a Gameplan Special from your playbook; you draw it. Use only if you have connected with 2 moves in a row, once per move string and four times per match.

TheBookEnd.gac.name: Book End
TheBookEnd.gac.text:
Booker T Finisher

Counters in close moves.

If your opponent is The Rock or has no Attitude, and isn't currently stunned, this move stuns your opponent until the end of the next turn. This move does up to +10 damage if you played Spinaroonie this turn.

Title-Hardcore.gac.name: WWE With Authority! Hardcore Champion
Title-Hardcore.gac.text:
Play only while in control.
Draw a page. You and your opponent move to Ringside. If you connect with an illegal move this turn, you draw an additional page.

TheRattlesnake.gac.name: The Rattlesnake!
TheRattlesnake.gac.text: Play only if not in control, you have 4 Warnings more than your opponent and Stone Cold isn't in the match. There is an 80% chance Austin comes to the ring and gives a Stone Cold Stunner to your opponent, which can't be countered, and you get from 3 to 7 Warnings. Otherwise, you're stunned for this turn and take 15 damage.

CurtainCall.gac.name: Curtain Call
CurtainCall.gac.text:
Goldust Finisher

Counters in close moves.

This move does up to +20 damage based on a hidden, complex, bizarre formula.

BodySlamEX3.gac.name: Body Slam
BodySlamEX3.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

"Will To Win" is put into your hand.

WithAuthoritySS2002.gac.name: With Authority! (SummerSlam 2002)
WithAuthoritySS2002.gac.text:
Play only while in control.

This move can't be Autocountered and does +2 damage. (Holds can be Autocountered after the turn they connect.)

Willpower 2

AnkleLock.gac.name: Angle's Ankle Lock
AnkleLock.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Finisher

Play only when your opponent is on the mat. 

This move does 10 Leg damage per turn, or 14 Leg damage if you have Intensity in play.

ThePeoplesElbow2ELE.gac.name: The People's Elbow
ThePeoplesElbow2ELE.gac.text:
The Rock Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.

If you have less than 30 pages left in your playbook, this move does +1 damage for each page less (up to +15.) If your last move was Spine Buster, you get +2 Attitude.

CornerChargeEX2.gac.name: Corner Charge
CornerChargeEX2.gac.text:
Play only if you are Rikishi or if you have any Agility, and only in the ring.

You may choose to lose 2 Attitude when this move connects. If you do, this move does +6 damage.

HulkUp.gac.name: Hulk Up!
HulkUp.gac.text:
Hulk Hogan Trademark
Play while not in control when you have less than 25 Hit Points. For three turns your opponent can't pin. His moves must be Strike moves (and not Holds or Finishers). You take no damage from moves and gain 1 Attitude each turn but you can't play pages. After three turns you gain control.

BubbaBomb.gac.name: Bubba Bomb
BubbaBomb.gac.text:
Bubba Ray Dudley Finisher
Counters arm extended moves. This move does +1 damage (up to +12) for each Takedown you have connected with. When used as a counter when not in control, this move can't be countered.

BackElbow2E.gac.name: Back Elbow
BackElbow2E.gac.text:
Counters behind opponent moves.

Choose one: Your opponent ditches a random Technical move, or your opponent takes 3 head damage.

ChairShot.gac.name: Chair Shot
ChairShot.gac.text:
Play this move only if Steel Folding Chair is in play.

You get 4 Warnings from the referee.  Your opponent takes 5 Head damage and is Stunned until the end of the next turn.

WithAuthorityEX2Release.gac.name: With Authority! (TLC Release)
WithAuthorityEX2Release.gac.text: Choose one of your opponent's Gameplan or Weapon specials in play. (You can't play this if there aren't any.) If the move connects, it does +2 damage and that special is shuffled into the playbook of the Superstar who played it.
