TwistOfFate.gac.name: Twist of Fate
TwistOfFate.gac.text:
Matt Hardy Finisher

If your opponent isn't stunned, this move stuns your opponent until the end of the next turn.

This move does +1 damage (up to +15, not less than 0) for each different move you've connected with more than your opponent.

WithAuthorityEX1.gac.name: With Authority!
WithAuthorityEX1.gac.text:
Play with a move that isn't defensive. That move does +5 damage.

When you play this special, if your opponent is on the mat, draw a page.

HardcoreEX3.gac.name: Hardcore
HardcoreEX3.gac.text:
Hardcore Trademark

For the next 5 turns (including this one) you can't be stunned and both you and your opponent take -2 damage from moves.

GutBuster.gac.name: Gut Buster
GutBuster.gac.text:
Strike Combo: +4 damage.

(This move does +4 damage if you connected with a Strike move last turn.)

LariatEX2.gac.name: Lariat
LariatEX2.gac.text: Choose a page in your hand. If this move connects that page is ditched, your opponent is put on the mat and you gain +1 Attitude.

RicFlair.gac.name: Ric Flair
RicFlair.gac.text: If your opponent plays a Heel page or receives a Warning, you get 3 Attitude. If your opponent has Vince McMahon in play, your moves do +2 damage.

WhipIntoCornerPost.gac.name: Whip Into Corner Post
WhipIntoCornerPost.gac.text: If your opponent has less than 8 Arm damage, this move does 4 Arm damage. Otherwise, there is a 40% chance that this move stuns your opponent until the end of the next turn.

IrishWhip2E.gac.name: Irish Whip
IrishWhip2E.gac.text: Play only while in control. Play with a move that counters mad rush moves. If you have 3 Strength, a random Strength move is drawn from your playbook. That move does +5 damage, and if the move connects you gain +1 Attitude Momentum.

TrishsRoundhouseKickLE.gac.name: Trish's Roundhouse Kick
TrishsRoundhouseKickLE.gac.text:
Trish Stratus Trademark

Counters mad rush moves. Your opponent is Staggered and you get Crowd Support.

KickToTheRibs.gac.name: Kick To The Ribs
KickToTheRibs.gac.text:
Play only when your opponent is on the mat.

Draw a page.

LadderShot.gac.name: Ladder Shot
LadderShot.gac.text: Play only if a Ladder is in play. Countered by Duck. Counters Climb The Ladder. You get 5 Warnings and a +5% climb chance. If your opponent is Busted Wide Open or Staggered, he is stunned until the end of next turn.

RockBottomTourn.gac.name: Rock Bottom
RockBottomTourn.gac.text:
The Rock Finisher

Counters arm extended and in close moves. If your opponent is not stunned and has less pages in hand than you, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

CrucifixRollUp.gac.name: Crucifix Roll-Up
CrucifixRollUp.gac.text:
Counters arm extended and mad rush moves.

You draw a page, your opponent is put on the mat and you attempt a pin. If the pin fails you remain in control.

ClotheslineEX3.gac.name: Clothesline
ClotheslineEX3.gac.text: Counters in close and leg extended moves. Your opponent is put on the mat.

Compactor.gac.name: Compactor
Compactor.gac.text:
Jeff Hardy Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat or if you have 3 Technical.
You attempt to pin your opponent. You get Crowd Support and remain in control if the pin fails.

LayingTheSmackDown.gac.name: Laying The Smack Down!
LayingTheSmackDown.gac.text:
The Rock Trademark

Play only in the ring, and only if you haven't connected with this move this match.
Your opponent moves to ringside, or is put on the mat (randomly chosen). You draw 3 pages and gain +2 Attitude, and your opponent ditches 2 random Strike moves from hand.

AdvantageStrength.gac.name: Advantage: Power
AdvantageStrength.gac.text:
When in control, the first Strength move you do each turn does +1 damage.

If you have 4 Strength and 4 Strike, you do +4 damage instead.

Slap.gac.name: Slap
Slap.gac.text: Your opponent ditches a random page from hand that isn't Momentum, and gains 3 Attitude.

EnzugiriEX2.gac.name: Enzugiri
EnzugiriEX2.gac.text:
Counters in close moves.

Your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn (if not already stunned) and is put on the mat. If countered, you lose 1 Attitude.

HellfireAndBrimstone.gac.name: Hellfire And Brimstone
HellfireAndBrimstone.gac.text:
Kane Trademark

Your Strength moves do +1 damage. Until turn 10, you take no damage from Strike moves.
(Superstars may only play one Entrance, and only on turn one or two.)

LaMagistralCradle.gac.name: La Magistral Cradle
LaMagistralCradle.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent ditches 1 random page and is pinned. If the pin fails you remain in Control.

RunningChairShot.gac.name: Running Chair Shot
RunningChairShot.gac.text:
Play only if Steel Folding Chair is in play, and only once per match. Countered by Van Daminator.

If this move connects, your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn and you get 5 Warnings. If countered by a move, you take 8 damage and are stunned until the end of the next turn.

BlownSpot2E.gac.name: Blown Spot
BlownSpot2E.gac.text: Play when your opponent has no Knowledge and is attempting a non-Finisher move that is mad rush, high risk, or costs 7 or more. Your opponent's move is countered and you gain control. Willpower 2 (This page counts as two pages for Autocountering.)

HammerlockEX3.gac.name: Hammerlock
HammerlockEX3.gac.text: The turn this move connects, you get +1 Attitude and if your opponent has at least 2 Strike, he loses 1. Other turns, this move does 3 arm damage. Your opponent cannot submit to this move.

Technical2E.gac.name: Technical
Technical2E.gac.text: Gain 1 Technical. Your opponent can't see this page.

SupportFromLita.gac.name: Support From Lita
SupportFromLita.gac.text:
Matt Hardy Trademark
Play only if Lita isn't in play, and only if you've been hit with three moves in a row. Lita runs in and plays a Litacanrana (countering your opponent's move) that can't be countered by a Big Superstar. If countered, you suffer the effects of the countering move.

TheHurricaneLE.gac.name: The Hurricane
TheHurricaneLE.gac.text:
Special: Super Powers

Choose a Move in your opponent's hand. You steal it and gain enough momentum to play it until end of turn (even breaking your limits). Use once per match, after turn 5.

AttitudeStarMafiaKick.gac.name: The Big Boot
AttitudeStarMafiaKick.gac.text:
Test Finisher

Counters mad rush moves. Your opponent is put on the mat.  This move does +1 damage for each different Impact move you have connected with. (Counts as Mafia Kick.)

HighKnee.gac.name: High Knee
HighKnee.gac.text: Only Triple H may play High Knee. Counters mad rush moves. Cannot be countered by Strength moves. Your opponent ditches pages from his playbook equal to your Attitude Momentum, and is put on the mat.

Tazz.gac.name: Tazz
Tazz.gac.text:
Special: Change The Mood

Ditch a random page and name an In Close move in your Playbook. That move is drawn to your hand. This works 2 times per match.

ClipEX2.gac.name: Clip
ClipEX2.gac.text: Your opponent is put on the mat and is Grounded.

StompAMudhole.gac.name: Stomp A Mudhole
StompAMudhole.gac.text:
Stone Cold Trademark

Play only when your opponent is on the mat. 

Each turn this hold is applied, your opponent takes 5 damage and you have a 33% chance of drawing a Damage special from your playbook. This Hold can only be applied for three turns.

PedigreeTourn.gac.name: Pedigree
PedigreeTourn.gac.text:
Triple H Finisher

Counters head down moves. If your opponent has less than 40 pages left in his playbook, this move does +1 damage for each page less (up to +20.)

Enzugiri2E.gac.name: Enzugiri
Enzugiri2E.gac.text: Your opponent takes 8 head damage and is put on the mat.

BlownSpot.gac.name: Blown Spot
BlownSpot.gac.text: Play when your opponent has no Knowledge and is attempting a non-Finisher move that is mad rush, high risk, or costs 7 or more. Your opponent's move is countered and you gain control. This page counts as two pages when you choose to ditch it.

fields.Page_Played:
(if ((eq #page #this)
     (block 
          (WAMessage -1 "Jim Ross:" (WAGetName #target) "really blew that one.")
          (WASetValue (WAGameMap) PlayedBlownSpot 1)
          (WASetValue 
               (WAGameMap)
               EventsPlayed
               (add 1
                    (WAGetValue (WAGameMap) EventsPlayed)
               )
          )
          (WAAutoCounter #initiator)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

ForearmSmash2E.gac.name: Forearm Smash
ForearmSmash2E.gac.text:
This move does up to +2 damage.

(Face page: cannot be played if you have played a Heel page.)

OutCold.gac.name: Taking Punishment
OutCold.gac.text:
Your opponent's moves do -1 or -2 damage. You can only have one Taking Punishment in play.

(Hidden pages aren't seen by your opponent.)

StraightJacket.gac.name: Straight Jacket
StraightJacket.gac.text:
William Regal Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat. Countered by Inside Cradle.

This move does 3 arm and 3 back damage each turn. If your opponent has 12 arm and back damage, you draw a page at the end of each turn.

RazorsEdge.gac.name: Razor's Edge
RazorsEdge.gac.text:
Scott Hall Finisher

This move does +5 damage (up to +20) for each nWo special you have in play. Unless already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

GetIllegalLeverage.gac.name: Get Illegal Leverage
GetIllegalLeverage.gac.text: The next time you connect with a hold in the ring that does body damage, this leaves play and an "Illegal Leverage" special is played (which gives you 1 Warning, and each turn does +4 body damage but not more than the move's base body damage). You may only have one Get Illegal Leverage in play.

Edge.gac.name: Edge
Edge.gac.text: Whenever you attempt a pin after turn 10, you gain 1 Attitude (including pin attempts from moves or specials that pin).

Heat.gac.name: Heat
Heat.gac.text:
Play only after turn 10. Your opponent sees this page when played.

Gain 2 Attitude.

FlyingHeadScissors.gac.name: Flying Head Scissors
FlyingHeadScissors.gac.text: Choose a move type (other than defensive). A random move in your opponent's hand that matches that type is buried. If countered, you take 2 damage.

fields.List_Values: Name a Move Type|arm extended|back to foe|behind opponent|head down|high risk|hit or miss|in close|leg extended|mad rush|standing above|victim below

HipTossEX2.gac.name: Hip Toss
HipTossEX2.gac.text:
Counters arm extended moves.

This move can't be countered by Strike moves.

WithAuthorityEX3Release.gac.name: With Authority! (Unforgiven Release)
WithAuthorityEX3Release.gac.text:
Play only when in control.

This move can't be Autocountered. If the move is countered, you get Crowd Support.
(If played with a Hold, this special leaves play at the end of the turn.)

TrishStratus.gac.name: Trish Stratus
TrishStratus.gac.text: Special: You cant play moves this turn. There is a 50% chance that you ditch 2 pages. Otherwise, you gain control at the end of the turn, your move next turn can't be countered by moves, and you can't use this ability again. Use this ability only when your opponent is in control and isn't playing or applying a Hold.

RefereeTeddyLong.gac.name: Referee Teddy Long
RefereeTeddyLong.gac.text:
Play only if you have a Knowledge limit.

All pin attempts have a +10% pin chance. 

(You may only play a Referee if there is no other Referee in play.)

InsideCradle2E.gac.name: Inside Cradle
InsideCradle2E.gac.text:
Counters in close and standing above moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat and you attempt to pin. If the pin fails you stay in control. (After a failed pin attempt, your opponent is removed from the mat.)

StealYourFinisherX8.gac.name: Steal Your Finisher
StealYourFinisherX8.gac.text: Play if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. If your opponent's Finisher is in his hand or playbook, you play it as your move this turn. If it connects, your opponent loses 10 Attitude. (If there is more than one, a random one is chosen.)

TripleHTourn.gac.name: Triple H
TripleHTourn.gac.text:
Special: Best In The Business

Choose a page in your playbook. It is drawn to your hand. Use this ability once after turn 10 and once after turn 40.

LegDrop2E.gac.name: Leg Drop
LegDrop2E.gac.text: Play only if your opponent is on the mat. If this move is countered you lose up to an additional 2 Attitude.

fields.Move_Countered:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Momentum (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
          (sett MLoss (WARandom 0 2))
          (sett Momentum (subtract Momentum MLoss))
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum Momentum)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

LitasTwistOfFate2E.gac.name: Lita's Twist of Fate
LitasTwistOfFate2E.gac.text:
Lita Trademark

Choose a Face page in your playbook. You draw that page from your playbook. (You can't play this page if you don't have any in your playbook.)

LowBlowUppercut2E.gac.name: Low Blow Uppercut
LowBlowUppercut2E.gac.text:
Counters leg extended and victim below moves. You get 4 Warnings. This move does up to +7 damage.

There is a 50% chance your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

SnakeEyes2E.gac.name: Snake Eyes
SnakeEyes2E.gac.text: Your opponent ditches two random pages.

GermanSuplexEX2.gac.name: German Suplex
GermanSuplexEX2.gac.text: You attempt to pin your opponent. If the pin fails you remain in control.

OneStepAhead.gac.name: One Step Ahead
OneStepAhead.gac.text: Draw a page. At the beginning of the Refresh step, you are told what your opponent's next page is. This effect ends when you are Stunned. Multiple uses of this card allow you to see more pages from your opponent's playbook.

SchoolboyRollup.gac.name: Schoolboy Roll-up
SchoolboyRollup.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat. Choose a move type and attempt a pin. If the pin fails you stay in control and get a pin bonus equal to the number of moves that match that move type in your opponent's playbook.

fields.List_Values: Name a Move Type|arm extended|back to foe|behind opponent|head down|high risk|hit or miss|in close|leg extended|mad rush|standing above|victim below

PowerSlamEX2.gac.name: Power Slam
PowerSlamEX2.gac.text:
Counters mad rush and hit or miss moves.

Choose a Strength move in your playbook. If this move connects you draw that page.

LegDropOnTheRingApron.gac.name: Ring Apron Leg Drop
LegDropOnTheRingApron.gac.text:
Undertaker Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat. Your opponent takes 5 head damage and both players move to ringside.

DistractTheReferee.gac.name: Distract The Referee
DistractTheReferee.gac.text:
Play only if the Referee is not distracted. The Referee is distracted for 1 to 6 turns (any Referee Special in play is removed). Distracted Referees do not give warnings, count pins or accept submissions. This effect ends if a Referee Special is played later.
(Heel page: cannot be played if you have played a Face page.)

ChokeWithCord.gac.name: Choke With Cord
ChokeWithCord.gac.text:
Play only at ringside or in a Hardcore match, and only if your opponent is on the mat. 

When this move connects and each turn it is applied, you get 2 Warnings and your opponent's next five pages from playbook are ditched. This move is released after 3 turns.

fields.Begin_Refresh:
(if ((eq (WAGetTurn)
         (WAGetTurnPlayedOn #this)
     )
     (block 
          (sett Me (WAGetPlayedBy #this))
          (sett Opp (WAGetOpponent Me))
          (WAWarn Me 2)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook Opp)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook Opp)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook Opp)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook Opp)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook Opp)
     )
    )
)

TheBigBootEX2.gac.name: The Big Boot
TheBigBootEX2.gac.text:
Test Finisher

Counters mad rush moves. Your opponent is put on the mat.  This move does +1 damage for each different Impact move you have connected with. (Counts as Mafia Kick.)

DoubleBackBreaker.gac.name: Double Back Breaker
DoubleBackBreaker.gac.text:
Brock Lesnar Trademark

Your opponent takes up to 10 back damage. If they have a Status, they take an additional 10 back damage.

NWOCountry.gac.name: nWo Country
NWOCountry.gac.text:
nWo Trademark

Draw a random Move, Special and Momentum from your playbook. Your opponent draws a page. Kevin Nash does commentary for the rest of the match.

GetAShoulderUp.gac.name: Get a Shoulder Up
GetAShoulderUp.gac.text:
Play only if you have 4 Strength or 4 Agility, only while being pinned, and only twice per match. Your opponent's pin attempt fails and you gain Control. 
(Face page: cannot be played if you have played a Heel page.)

RefereeJackDoan.gac.name: Referee Jack Doan
RefereeJackDoan.gac.text:
Superstars cant be pinned unless they are on the mat or were hit with a Finisher this turn or last turn.

(You may only play a Referee if there is no other Referee in play.)

ChrisJericho2E.gac.name: Chris Jericho
ChrisJericho2E.gac.text:
Special: King of the World

Lose all your Attitude and choose a Momentum from your playbook. That page is drawn. Use this ability two times per match.

FlyingWheelKick.gac.name: Flying Wheel Kick
FlyingWheelKick.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

Unless your opponent has less than 4 pages in hand, your opponent ditches 2 random pages. This move does up to +3 damage.

FloatoverDDT.gac.name: The Rock's DDT
FloatoverDDT.gac.text:
This move may only be played by The Rock. 
Counters mad rush moves. If you have any Knowledge you draw a page and gain 1 Attitude. If you have any Agility you draw a page and gain 1 Attitude. Counts as DDT.

FlyingElbow.gac.name: Flying Elbow
FlyingElbow.gac.text: Play if your opponent is on the mat or if you have 10 Momentum. Your opponent is put on the mat. Draw a page. For each Agility you have, your opponent's next page from playbook is ditched.

Steveweiser.gac.name: Steveweiser
Steveweiser.gac.text:
Stone Cold Trademark

Draw a page.
No one can attempt a pin until turn 25. At the end of turn 25 you gain +2 Attitude. (Superstars may only play one Entrance, and only on turn one or two.)

SteveweiserEX2.gac.name: Steveweiser
SteveweiserEX2.gac.text:
Stone Cold Trademark

Draw a page.
No one can attempt a pin until turn 25. At the end of turn 25 you gain +2 Attitude. (Superstars may only play one Entrance, and only on turn one or two.)

3DEX2.gac.name: 3D
3DEX2.gac.text:
Dudleyz Trademark

Play only if you have both Bubba Ray and D-Von in play, and only if you haven't connected with this move this match.

This move can't be countered, but may be autocountered for +2 pages. If a Referee special is in play, you get 10 Warnings.

Wazzzzzaaaappp.gac.name: Diving Headbutt
Wazzzzzaaaappp.gac.text:
D-Von Dudley Finisher

Play only if your opponent is in the ring on the mat. Your opponent stays on the mat. Choose a number from 0 to 10. If this move connects and Bubba Ray is in play, you get that many Warnings, and your opponent takes that much extra damage.

WithAuthoritySummercon2001.gac.name: With Authority! (SummerCon 2001)
WithAuthoritySummercon2001.gac.text:
(Counts as With Authority!)

Play only while in control. This move does +4 damage and can't be Autocountered.

TheBrahmaBull.gac.name: The Brahma Bull!!
TheBrahmaBull.gac.text: Play only if you are Stunned or have 0 Hit Points, and The Rock isn't in this match. The Rock enters the ring and plays Laying the Smack Down or Rock Bottom, ignoring play restrictions. The move can't be Autocountered, and you get 5 Warnings. If countered, you suffer the effects of the countering move.

ShaneMcMahon.gac.name: Shane McMahon
ShaneMcMahon.gac.text:
Hardcore Superstar

Whenever you play a Special or receive a Warning, Shane McMahon heals 2 Hit Points and his opponent gets a -2% pin chance penalty.

TheFinalCut2E.gac.name: The Final Cut
TheFinalCut2E.gac.text:
Big Show Finisher

Does +20 damage, -2 damage for each time your opponent has connected with a Takedown move this match (this bonus can't be less than 0).

PokeInTheEye.gac.name: Eye Rake
PokeInTheEye.gac.text:
This move counters arm extended, in close, standing above and behind opponent moves.

You receive 2 Warnings from the referee and your opponent loses 1 Momentum.

KendoStick.gac.name: Kendo Stick
KendoStick.gac.text: Special: The player in control chooses and ditches a page in hand. Kendo Stick Shot is put into your hand. This page leaves play when an offensive move other than Kendo Stick Shot connects.

RunningElbow.gac.name: Running Elbow
RunningElbow.gac.text:
Spike Dudley Trademark

Play only in the ring. If your opponent is a Cruiserweight, they are put on the mat and you draw a page. Otherwise, you get +2 Attitude.

LitaTourn.gac.name: Lita
LitaTourn.gac.text:
Member of Team XTreme, Diva Superstar

You get "Crowd Support" when you play a Face page.
Special: Get XTreme
All moves do double base damage this turn. Use this ability once per match.

LegDropOfDoom.gac.name: Hogan's Leg Drop
LegDropOfDoom.gac.text:
Hollywood Hulk Hogan Finisher
Play only if your opponent is on the mat. If you have 7 Knowledge and you haven't yet connected with this move, it can't be countered.
(Counts as Leg Drop.)

FiveStarFrogSplash.gac.name: Five-Star Frog Splash
FiveStarFrogSplash.gac.text:
Rob Van Dam Finisher

Play only when your opponent is on the mat in the ring. Choose a number from 0 to 15. You take that much damage, and this move does that much extra damage.

LegDrop.gac.name: Leg Drop
LegDrop.gac.text: Play only if your opponent is on the mat. If this move is countered you lose up to an additional 2 Momentum.

fields.Move_Countered:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Momentum (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
          (sett MLoss (WARandom 0 2))
          (sett Momentum (subtract Momentum MLoss))
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum Momentum)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

Kane2E.gac.name: Kane
Kane2E.gac.text: Kane ignores the first stun he receives. After turn 20 he does +2 damage with all Strength moves.

ElectricChair.gac.name: Electric Chair
ElectricChair.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves.

You take 4 damage and gain +2 Attitude.

Technical Combo: Your opponent's next five pages in playbook are ditched.

Shove2E.gac.name: Shove
Shove2E.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters back to foe and victim below moves. Countered by arm extended moves. This move provides no Momentum.

TenCount.gac.name: Ten Count
TenCount.gac.text:
Play only if a Referee is in play. Draw a page and counter your opponent's move (if any). If you did, your opponent draws two pages.

No moves or specials can be played. This page leaves play in 3 to 6 turns (after this one) and the match is extended that number of turns.

SpineBuster.gac.name: Spine Buster
SpineBuster.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

This move does 3 Back damage.

SuplexToTheFloor.gac.name: Suplex To The Floor
SuplexToTheFloor.gac.text:
Play this move only if both you and your opponent are in the ring.

Both you and your opponent are moved to Ringside.

TheWholeDamShow.gac.name: The Whole Dam Show
TheWholeDamShow.gac.text:
Rob Van Dam Trademark

Draw a random Trademark from your playbook. The first time you connect with each Trademark move, you get +1 Attitude and a +5% pin chance bonus for the rest of the match.

Sharpshooter.gac.name: Sharpshooter
Sharpshooter.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat or as a counter to Sharpshooter. If played as a counter, your opponent is put on the mat. Your opponent can't play moves the first three turns this hold is applied (but he can the turn you play this move).

This move does 10 Leg and 10 Back damage per turn.

BookerTEX2.gac.name: Booker T
BookerTEX2.gac.text:
Special: Can You Dig It?

Choose a move page in hand. That page is ditched and you draw a page. This ability works nine times per match.

BackBodyDropOverTheRopes.gac.name: Back Body Drop to Ringside
BackBodyDropOverTheRopes.gac.text: Play this move only in the ring. Counters victim below moves. Your opponent is moved to Ringside. There is a 33% chance your opponent ditches his next page from his playbook.

InTheInterestOfFairness.gac.name: In The Interest Of Fairness
InTheInterestOfFairness.gac.text:
Draw a page.
Each superstar ditches a page from playbook for each Special they have in play (including this one.) Each player buries all Specials in hand, then draws a page for each that was buried.

SlingshotIntoTheRopes.gac.name: Slingshot Into The Ropes
SlingshotIntoTheRopes.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

You get 1 Warning. Your opponent stays on the mat and takes 5 head damage. Choose a Momentum page; two random pages with that name (ignoring set) are ditched from your opponent's playbook.

BackSuplex.gac.name: Back Suplex
BackSuplex.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves.

This move does 1 Back damage.

MountedPunches2E.gac.name: Mounted Punches
MountedPunches2E.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Each turn this Hold is applied, your opponent takes 1 damage for each Strike you have. This Hold can only be kept applied for 3 turns.

AdvantageAgility.gac.name: Advantage: Quickness
AdvantageAgility.gac.text:
When in control, if the first move you do on a turn costs 6 or more, it does +3 damage.

When you aren't in control, your Defensive moves can't be countered.

AlwaysThinking.gac.name: Always Thinking
AlwaysThinking.gac.text:
Draw a page.
After you draw a page during the Refresh step, you are told what the next page is. This effect lasts until you are Stunned. Multiple uses of this page allow you to see more pages from your playbook.

TheCripplerChrisBenoit.gac.name: Chris Benoit
TheCripplerChrisBenoit.gac.text:
Special: "Prove Me Wrong!"

Choose a body part. Your Impact moves do between 1 and 4 points of damage to that body part (until you use this ability again.) Use this ability twice per game.

BanzaiDrop.gac.name: Banzai Drop
BanzaiDrop.gac.text: Only Rikishi Phatu may play Banzai Drop, and it can't be Autocountered. Play only in the ring and if your opponent is on the mat. Your opponent is stunned until end of turn, and is pinned. You stay in control if the pin fails.

ChokeInTheCorner.gac.name: Choke In The Corner
ChokeInTheCorner.gac.text: Play only in the ring. You get 2 Warnings. Your opponent loses 2 Attitude. If your opponent has at least 2 Knowledge, he loses 1.

DeathblowLE.gac.name: Deathblow
DeathblowLE.gac.text:
Tajiri Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat or you have 18 Momentum.

Your opponent is put on the mat.

PleadToTheReferee.gac.name: Plead to the Referee
PleadToTheReferee.gac.text: You cannot play this if 'Ref Bump' is in play. If 'Distract The Referee' is in play it is removed. If the move being played against you is illegal, your opponent gets 4 Warnings. (Face page: play only if you have played no Heel pages.)

GrabTheTights.gac.name: Grab The Tights
GrabTheTights.gac.text: Play when your opponent is on the mat. If your opponent has "Plead to the Ref" in hand, it is ditched. Otherwise, your opponent can't play Specials this turn and you attempt a pin with a 75% pin chance, ignoring all modifiers. (Heel page.)

VinceMcMahon.gac.name: Vince McMahon
VinceMcMahon.gac.text: If you begin a turn with 8 Knowledge and a Technical Hold applied that costs 7 or more, there is a 33% chance that Vince McMahon declares you the winner of the match by Submission. (Even if there is no Referee.)

PumpHandleSlam.gac.name: Pump Handle Slam
PumpHandleSlam.gac.text:
Test Trademark

Counters head down and back to foe moves. If your opponent isn't stunned and has connected with less Impact moves than you, he is stunned until the end of next turn.

RicFlairsFigureFourLE.gac.name: Ric Flair's Figure Four
RicFlairsFigureFourLE.gac.text:
Ric Flair Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat or as a counter. Counters Figure Four.
This move does 10 leg damage per turn. If your opponent has more leg damage than twice his Knowledge, this move can't be countered by moves the turn you play it. (Counts as "Figure Four.")

ShirtsOff.gac.name: Shirts Off!
ShirtsOff.gac.text:
Team Xtreme Trademark

Play only if you have hit 3 moves in a row. Choose an Ability Momentum type. You get +1 Momentum of that type for each 2 Attitude you have.

JustAnotherVictim.gac.name: Just Another Victim
JustAnotherVictim.gac.text:
Tazz Trademark

Choose a move type. You steal a random page from your opponent's hand that is of that move type and costs at least 5. If there aren't any, you draw a page.

fields.List_Values: Choose a move type|arm extended|back to foe|behind opponent|defensive|head down|high risk|hit or miss|in close|mad rush|leg extended|standing above|victim below

WhispersInTheWind.gac.name: Whisper In The Wind
WhispersInTheWind.gac.text:
Jeff Hardy Trademark

Play only in the ring. Counters mad rush moves. If used as a counter when you aren't in control, this move can't be countered. Otherwise you get Crowd Support.

GreatImpact.gac.name: Great Impact
GreatImpact.gac.text:
Play only if you have 1 Agility, 1 Strike and 2 Attitude. Your opponent sees this page when played.

Gain +1 Agility and +1 Strike Momentum, and lose 2 Attitude.

SideSuplex.gac.name: Side Suplex
SideSuplex.gac.text: Play only if you have at least as much Strength as your opponent. One of your opponent's Gameplans (from in hand or in play, randomly chosen) are ditched.

JumpingBulldog.gac.name: Jumping Bulldog
JumpingBulldog.gac.text:
Scotty 2 Hotty Trademark

Play only in the ring. This move does +2 damage (up to +8) for each Gameplan special you have in play. If your opponent isn't stunned and you have 3 or more in play, he is stunned until the end of the next turn and you get +2 Attitude.
(Counts as "Bulldog")

LegGrapevine.gac.name: Leg Grapevine
LegGrapevine.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

This move does 3 Leg damage each turn. At the end of each turn, your opponent's next 4 pages in playbook are ditched.

FrogSplash2E.gac.name: Frog Splash
FrogSplash2E.gac.text:
Eddie Guerrero Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.
This move does +1 damage for each move type you have connected with this match. Your opponent is stunned until the end of the turn and you attempt a pin. If the pin fails, you remain in control.

ToTheFloor.gac.name: To The Floor
ToTheFloor.gac.text:
Play if you don't have Knowledge, or To The Floor in play. Draw a page.
Whenever you hit with a move that does 5 or more damage and isn't a Hold, there is a 20% chance that this page leaves play and your opponent is moved to Ringside. (If the Superstar was on the mat, he goes to the mat at Ringside.)

Quickness.gac.name: Quickness
Quickness.gac.text:
Play only with a non-Defensive move.

The move does +1 damage for each Agility you have. If the move connects, your opponent ditches a random special from hand.

DQWarning.gac.name: DQ Warning
DQWarning.gac.text:
You have received at least one DQ Warning from the Referee. 

Once you receive 5 or more Warnings you have a 5% chance per warning of being Disqualified.

RunningHeadbutt.gac.name: Running Headbutt
RunningHeadbutt.gac.text:
Spike Dudley Trademark

Choose a Method. Your opponent ditches all moves of that Method and draws a page.

TrishStratusEX3LE.gac.name: Trish Stratus
TrishStratusEX3LE.gac.text:
Diva Superstar
Special: 100%
Choose a Method. When your opponent plays or connects with a move of that Method that costs 6 or more, you get "Crowd Support". Use this ability once.

DropKickToTheFloor2E.gac.name: Drop Kick To The Floor
DropKickToTheFloor2E.gac.text:
Play this move only if both you and your opponent are in the ring. 

Your opponent ditches a random page and is moved to ringside. If countered, you lose up to an additional 2 Attitude.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WAMove #target (WAFindLocation '$Ringside))
          (WAMessage -1 "Jim Ross: A nasty tumble there!")
          (sett Done (lesser (WAGetHandCount #target) 1))
          (sett NumDitched 0)
          (sett StopNum 1)
          (loop (not Done)
                (block 
                     (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount #target)))
                     (sett Card (item (WAGetHand #target) Ditch))
                     (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #target) (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
                     (WADitchPage #target (subtract Ditch 1))
                     (sett NumDitched (add NumDitched 1))
                     (if ((eq NumDitched StopNum)
                          (sett Done True)
                         )
                         (True
                          (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount #target) 0))
                         )
                     )
                )
          )
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)
fields.Move_Countered:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Momentum (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
          (sett MLoss (WARandom 0 2))
          (sett Momentum (subtract Momentum MLoss))
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum Momentum)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

BlatantChoke.gac.name: Blatant Choke
BlatantChoke.gac.text:
Play only when your opponent is on the mat. Your opponent can't submit to this hold.

When this move connects and when it is applied, your opponent ditches 2 pages from hand and you get 3 Warnings. This move may be Autocountered for -1 page per turn it's applied.

fields.Begin_Refresh:
(block 
     (sett Victim (WAGetPlayedOn #this))
     (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount Victim) 0))
     (sett NumDitched 0)
     (sett StopNum 2)
     (loop (not Done)
           (block 
                (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount Victim)))
                (sett Card (item (WAGetHand Victim) Ditch))
                (WAMessage (WAGetOwner Victim) (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
                (WADitchPage Victim (subtract Ditch 1))
                (sett NumDitched (add NumDitched 1))
                (if ((eq NumDitched StopNum)
                     (sett Done True)
                    )
                    (True
                     (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount Victim) 0))
                    )
                )
           )
     )
     (WAWarn (WAGetPlayedBy #this) 3)
)

PlanchaEX2.gac.name: Plancha
PlanchaEX2.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is at Ringside and you have at least as much Agility as your opponent. You may play this from the ring or ringside, and are sent to ringside when you play it.

Your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn. You are Grounded.

SpinningElbow.gac.name: Spinning Elbow
SpinningElbow.gac.text:
D-Von Dudley Trademark

Your opponent is put on the mat and ditches one random move from hand. If your opponent has any Status specials, this move does +4 damage.

WithAuthority2E.gac.name: With Authority!
WithAuthority2E.gac.text:
Play only while in Control. This move does +4 damage and may not be Autocountered.

(If used with a Hold, the move can be autocountered after the first turn it is applied.)

Buzzkiller.gac.name: Edgecution
Buzzkiller.gac.text:
Edge Finisher

Counters head down moves.
This move does +1 damage for each Attitude you have (up to +10). You attempt to pin your opponent with a +1% pin chance for each different Agility and Technical move you've connected with this match. If the pin fails, you stay in control.

SpinningPowerbomb.gac.name: Spinning Powerbomb
SpinningPowerbomb.gac.text:
Brock Lesnar Trademark

Your opponent is stunned (if not already stunned), and Grounded.

ThrowOverTheRopes2E.gac.name: Throw Over The Ropes
ThrowOverTheRopes2E.gac.text: Play only in the ring. Your opponent is sent to ringside. Unless already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

SlamIntoAnnounceTable2E.gac.name: Slam Into Announce Table
SlamIntoAnnounceTable2E.gac.text: Play only at ringside. All of your opponent's Gameplan specials that are in play are ditched.

Dodge.gac.name: Dodge
Dodge.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters high risk, hit or miss, and standing above moves. Countered by victim below moves. This move provides no Momentum.

Snapped.gac.name: Snapped
Snapped.gac.text: Play only if you have hit five moves in the current move string that cost 4 or more. Your opponent can't play any pages or Autocounter for three turns, including this turn. (Heel page: cannot be played if you have played a Face page.)

DoubleUnderhookSuplex2E.gac.name: Double Underhook Suplex
DoubleUnderhookSuplex2E.gac.text: Your opponent's next 4 pages from playbook are ditched.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

DistractTheRefereeTourn.gac.name: Distract The Referee
DistractTheRefereeTourn.gac.text: The Referee is distracted for 1 to 6 turns (any Referee Special in play is removed). Distracted Referees do not give warnings, and the match can't end except by time limit draw. If a Referee is played later, this page leaves play.

LanceStorm.gac.name: Lance Storm
LanceStorm.gac.text:
Member of The Un-Americans

Special: "Serious"
If your next move this turn is countered, draw a page. Use this ability 9 times per match and only when in control.

HogansBigBoot.gac.name: Hogan's Big Boot
HogansBigBoot.gac.text:
Hollywood Hulk Hogan Trademark

Counters mad rush moves. If played with Irish Whip and you haven't connected with this move yet, this move can't be countered. Your opponent is put on the mat. 

(Counts as "Mafia Kick")

FrontFacelock.gac.name: Front Facelock
FrontFacelock.gac.text:
Counters head down moves. Countered by Northern Lights Suplex.

This move does 1 Head damage each turn, but can't cause submissions. Each turn, there is a 50% chance you draw Technical from your playbook.

RefereeEarlHebner.gac.name: Senior Referee Earl Hebner
RefereeEarlHebner.gac.text:
Play only if you have no Knowledge limit.
Special: Both players move from the ring to ringside. No count outs will be given but after 5 turns both superstars move back. Superstars can't move back into the ring otherwise. Use only if a move hasn't been played this turn, and only once per match.

TiltaWhirlBackbreaker.gac.name: Tilt-a-Whirl Backbreaker
TiltaWhirlBackbreaker.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

This move does 5 back damage.

RuthlessAggression.gac.name: Ruthless Aggression
RuthlessAggression.gac.text:
Play only with a non-Defensive move.

When played, everyone loses all Attitude. This move does +1 damage for each Attitude lost.

RefereeMikeChioda2E.gac.name: Referee Mike Chioda
RefereeMikeChioda2E.gac.text:
Superstars can't be disqualified unless they have 9 Warnings.

(You may only play a Referee if there is no other Referee in play.)

DirtiestPlayerInTheGameNoLE.gac.name: Dirtiest Player In The Game
DirtiestPlayerInTheGameNoLE.gac.text:
Ric Flair Trademark

Draw a page.

If you play a Strike move as a counter, it can't be countered. You receive no Warnings this turn. This page leaves play at the end of the turn.

AggressiveStrength.gac.name: Aggressive Strength
AggressiveStrength.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit two moves in a row and only after turn 5.

Gain +1 Strength and +1 Attitude.

OldSchool2E.gac.name: Old School
OldSchool2E.gac.text:
Undertaker Trademark

Play only in the ring and only if you haven't connected with this move this match. Countered by Arm Drag Counter, not by Dodge.
Name a Method. Your opponent is put on the mat, ditches all moves of that Method and you draw 2 pages.

RabidWolverine.gac.name: Rabid Wolverine
RabidWolverine.gac.text:
Chris Benoit Trademark

Play only when you are not in control. Your move can't be countered. (Holds can be countered after this turn.)

ReleaseSpineBuster.gac.name: Release Spine Buster
ReleaseSpineBuster.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

If your opponent has 7 Back damage, he ditches all Strength moves in hand.

(Counts as "Spine Buster".)

WithAuthorityNewWorldOrder.gac.name: With Authority! (New World Order)
WithAuthorityNewWorldOrder.gac.text: Can only be played if an nWo member is in the match, and only with a move while in control. If played by an nWo member, the move does +7 damage. If played against one, the move does +3 damage and you draw a page.

ElbowOnTheRingApron.gac.name: Elbow On The Ring Apron
ElbowOnTheRingApron.gac.text: Play only when your opponent is on the mat at Ringside. This move does +1 damage (up to +7) for each turn you have been at Ringside.

ThePeoplesElbow2E.gac.name: The People's Elbow
ThePeoplesElbow2E.gac.text:
The Rock Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.

If you have less than 30 pages left in your playbook, this move does +1 damage for each page less (up to +15.) If your last move was Spine Buster, you get +2 Attitude.

stsa.gac.name: Stone Cold
stsa.gac.text: You draw a page when you play a Damage special with a move that connects.

UpAndOver2E.gac.name: Up and Over
UpAndOver2E.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters behind opponent and head down moves. Countered by back to foe moves and Standing Switch. This move provides no Attitude.

ElbowDropEX3.gac.name: Elbow Drop
ElbowDropEX3.gac.text:
Big Superstars Trademark

Play only when your opponent is on the mat. If countered, you are stunned until the end of the turn.
If your opponent has at least 2 Strike, he loses 1.

BigDogInTheYard.gac.name: Big Dog In The Yard
BigDogInTheYard.gac.text:
Undertaker Trademark

Play only while in control. Choose a Momentum. If your next move connects, it does +3 damage for each point of that Momentum your opponent has (up to +15), then your opponent loses 1 of that Momentum.

OvercastLE.gac.name: Overcast
OvercastLE.gac.text:
Hurricane Trademark

Play only in the ring. Choose an Action special in your playbook or opponent's hand. That page is moved to your hand.

NeckVice2E.gac.name: Neck Vice
NeckVice2E.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent takes 2 head damage per turn.
When this move connects, if you have any Knowledge Momentum, draw a page.

OffTheBarricade.gac.name: Off The Barricade
OffTheBarricade.gac.text:
Play only when at ringside with a high risk or Drop move. Draw a page.
If the move connects it does +7 damage and your opponent gets a -7% pin chance penalty for the rest of the match. Otherwise, you take 7 damage.

Facebuster.gac.name: Facebuster
Facebuster.gac.text:
Only Triple H may play Facebuster. 

Your opponent ditches pages from his playbook equal to the amount of Technical and Strength Momentum you have.

RefereeMikeChioda.gac.name: Referee Mike Chioda
RefereeMikeChioda.gac.text:
Superstars can't be disqualified unless they have 9 Warnings.

(You may only play a Referee if there is no other Referee in play.)

LitasMoonsault.gac.name: Lita's Moonsault
LitasMoonsault.gac.text:
Lita Finisher

(Face Page.) Play only while your opponent is on the mat in the ring. If your opponent is not stunned and you have more Attitude, this move does +5 damage and stuns your opponent until the end of next turn.
(Counts as "Moonsault".)

BrainbusterSuplex.gac.name: Brainbuster Suplex
BrainbusterSuplex.gac.text: If your opponent has 7 Head damage or more, this move does +5 damage.

DDTEX2.gac.name: DDT
DDTEX2.gac.text: You may choose to lose 2 Attitude. If you do, this move does +6 damage.

DropKick.gac.name: Drop Kick
DropKick.gac.text:
Counters high risk and mad rush moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat. If countered, you lose up to an additional two Momentum.

fields.Move_Countered:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Momentum (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
          (sett MLoss (WARandom 0 2))
          (sett Momentum (subtract Momentum MLoss))
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum Momentum)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

ChokeOnTheRopes2E.gac.name: Choke On The Ropes
ChokeOnTheRopes2E.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.

You get 3 Warnings and draw a page. Your opponent ditches a random page from hand.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WAWarn #superstar 3)
          (WADrawPage #superstar)
          (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount #target)))
          (sett Card (item (WAGetHand #target) Ditch))
          (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #target) (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
          (WADitchPage #target (subtract Ditch 1))
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

WalkThroughTheCageDoor.gac.name: Escape Through The Door
WalkThroughTheCageDoor.gac.text: Play only if your opponent is on the mat and it's a Steel Cage match. Countered by in close moves. If this move is countered, you're stunned for the rest of the turn and this page is shuffled into your playbook. Otherwise, you have a 50% chance of winning the match (95% chance if your opponent is stunned). You lose control if you don't win the match.

RussianLegSweepEX1.gac.name: Swinging Neckbreaker
RussianLegSweepEX1.gac.text: Counters head down moves. Choose one: Your Technical Momentum or your opponent's Knowledge Momentum. Your opponent ditches pages from playbook equal to the amount of your choice (up to 7).

fields.List_Values: Choose one:|Your Technical Momentum|Opponent's Knowledge Momentum

Intensity2E.gac.name: Intensity
Intensity2E.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Trademark

When you play a Technical or Strength move, if your next page in your playbook is a momentum page, you draw it. Intensity leaves play if your opponent hits with 4 moves in a row. You can only have one Intensity in play.

StandingSwitch.gac.name: Standing Switch
StandingSwitch.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters behind opponent and in close moves. Countered by back to foe moves and Standing Switch. This move provides no Momentum.

OneStepAhead2E.gac.name: One Step Ahead
OneStepAhead2E.gac.text:
Draw a page.

At the beginning of the Refresh step, you are told what your opponent's next page is. Multiples of this page allow you to see more pages. This page leaves play when you are stunned.

Litacanrana.gac.name: Litacanrana
Litacanrana.gac.text:
Lita Trademark

Countered by Power Bomb. Your opponent ditches a page for each different Face move you have connected with this match. (Face Page.)

Jawbreaker.gac.name: Jawbreaker
Jawbreaker.gac.text:
Counters victim below moves.

If this move connects as a counter, and you have more Agility than your opponent has Strength, your opponent ditches two pages from hand.

Misunderstanding.gac.name: Misunderstanding
Misunderstanding.gac.text:
Play if your opponent has Support or no Knowledge.

If your opponent has Support, it is removed. Otherwise, your opponent can't play Specials for four turns (including this one).

HogansLegDropTourn.gac.name: Hogan's Leg Drop
HogansLegDropTourn.gac.text:
Hulk Hogan Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat. If you have 7 Knowledge and you haven't yet connected with this move this match, this move can't be countered.
(Counts as "Leg Drop")

WhatImpact.gac.name: What Impact!
WhatImpact.gac.text: Play with an Impact move. That move does +10 damage.

SuperplexEX2.gac.name: Superplex
SuperplexEX2.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit three moves in a row, and only in the ring. Can't be countered by Dodge, can be countered by Shove.
Your move string is reset. If countered, you're stunned until the end of the turn.

ThatRiskDidntPayOff.gac.name: That Risk Didn't Pay Off
ThatRiskDidntPayOff.gac.text: Play when your opponent is playing a High Risk move that isn't a Finisher. Counter your opponent's move and take control. Your opponent takes 5 damage. This page counts as two pages when you choose to ditch it.

BackHeelTripEX3.gac.name: Back Heel Trip
BackHeelTripEX3.gac.text:
Your opponent is put on the mat. You gain +1 Attitude.

Knee Breaker Combo: A random standing above move is drawn from your playbook and you get Crowd Support.

Strength2E.gac.name: Strength
Strength2E.gac.text: Gain 1 Strength. Your opponent can't see this page.

HeadlockTakedown.gac.name: Hip Toss
HeadlockTakedown.gac.text: Counters head down moves. When you play this move, name a move type. When this move connects, a random move in your opponent's hand that matches that move type is buried. (Defensive moves are immune.)

fields.List_Values: Name a Move Type|arm extended|back to foe|behind opponent|head down|high risk|hit or miss|in close|leg extended|mad rush|standing above|victim below

RicFlairsChopLE.gac.name: Ric Flair's Chop
RicFlairsChopLE.gac.text:
Ric Flair Trademark

Choose a cost range (1-4, 5-8, 9-12). The next two pages in your opponent's playbook with that cost range are buried. Your opponent is put on the mat.

StandingSwitchTourn.gac.name: Standing Switch
StandingSwitchTourn.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters behind opponent and in close moves. Countered by back to foe moves and Standing Switch. This move provides no Attitude.

AdvantageKnowledge.gac.name: Advantage: Experience
AdvantageKnowledge.gac.text:
Play only if you have no Knowledge limit. Draw a page.

When in control, the first move you do each turn does +1 damage.

RegalStretch.gac.name: Regal Stretch
RegalStretch.gac.text:
William Regal Finisher

Play only while your opponent is on the mat. Countered by Back Elbow.
This move does 1 Arm and 1 Back damage per turn for each Technical Momentum you have.

Clip2E.gac.name: Clip
Clip2E.gac.text: Your opponent is put on the mat, loses +1 Attitude and takes 5 leg damage.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WASetOnMat #target 1)
          (sett Momentum (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
          (sett Momentum (subtract Momentum 1))
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum Momentum)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

BodySlam.gac.name: Body Slam
BodySlam.gac.text: Counters mad rush and high risk moves.

NWOControl.gac.name: nWo Control
NWOControl.gac.text: You Autocounter for -1 page. Your opponent Autocounters for +1 page.

Dudleyville.gac.name: Dudleyville
Dudleyville.gac.text:
Dudleyz Trademark

Choose one: Technical, Strike or Agility. Gain 2 of that Momentum and your opponent draws a random Momentum page. Your opponent sees this page when you play it, and this page can't be in your Lead Off.

ThrustKick2E.gac.name: Thrust Kick
ThrustKick2E.gac.text: Your opponent is put on the mat. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

AlSnow.gac.name: Al Snow
AlSnow.gac.text:
Hardcore Superstar

Special: "What Does Everybody Want?"

Draw a page for each Momentum type you have. Use this ability once per game.

CrucifixPowerbomb2E.gac.name: Crucifix Powerbomb
CrucifixPowerbomb2E.gac.text:
You can't play this move if you have already connected with it this match. Countered by Up and Over.
If you have 4 Strength or more your opponent's next 17 pages from playbook are ditched.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WASetValue #superstar Crucifixed 1)
          (if ((greater-eq (WAGetValue #superstar Strength_Momentum) 4)
               (block 
                    (if ((WAHasModifier #target '$Female)
                         (sett Pronoun "her")
                        )
                        ((WAHasModifier #target '$Neuter)
                         (sett Pronoun "it")
                        )
                        (True
                         (sett Pronoun "him")
                        )
                    )
                    (WAMessage -1 "Jim Ross: I can't believe what I just witnessed!" (WAGetName #superstar) "could have" Pronoun "right here!")
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
               )
              )
          )
     )
    )
)

ThatWasThree2E.gac.name: That Was Three!
ThatWasThree2E.gac.text: Play while being pinned, and can be played while stunned. The pin fails and you gain control.

AnotherAttitudeStar.gac.name: Test
AnotherAttitudeStar.gac.text:
"Un-Americans" Member

Your Impact moves do +1 damage for each other Impact move you have connected with. This count resets when you lose control.

ShaneDistract.gac.name: Distract The Referee
ShaneDistract.gac.text: The Referee is distracted for 3 turns (any Referee Special in play is removed). Distracted Referees do not give warnings, count pins or accept submissions. This is removed from play if a Referee Special is played later.

TheBrahmaBull2E.gac.name: The Brahma Bull!!
TheBrahmaBull2E.gac.text: Play only if you are Stunned or have 0 Hit Points, and The Rock isn't in this match. The Rock enters the ring and plays Laying the Smack Down or Rock Bottom, ignoring play restrictions. The move can't be Autocountered, and you get 5 Warnings. If countered, you suffer the effects of the countering move.

TheRocksDDT2E.gac.name: The Rock's DDT
TheRocksDDT2E.gac.text:
The Rock Trademark

Counters mad rush moves. If you have any Knowledge you draw a page and gain 1 Attitude. If you have any Agility you draw a page and gain 1 Attitude. (Counts as DDT.)

Boring.gac.name: Boring
Boring.gac.text:
Draw three pages. Use only if your opponent's move and last connected move have the same move type and if you aren't in a submission Hold or in control.
If you ditch this page it counts as two pages.

fields.AI_PlayPage: (WASetValue #this AIScore 90)

KitchenSink.gac.name: Kitchen Sink
KitchenSink.gac.text: Special: The player in control can use this ability to make "Kitchen Sink Shot" their offensive move. Then, Kitchen Sink is ditched from play.

BackHeelTrip2E.gac.name: Back Heel Trip
BackHeelTrip2E.gac.text:
Counters leg extended moves.

If your opponent doesn't have any Technical, this move can't be countered by moves.

Moonsault.gac.name: Moonsault
Moonsault.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat and in the ring. If countered, you are stunned until the end of the turn.
All Specials in your opponent's hand are buried. Your opponent stays on the mat.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WASetOnMat #target 1)
          (sett Victim #target)
          (sett Thug #superstar)
          (sett NumStolen 0)
          (sett TheHand (WAGetHand Victim))
          (sett MatchName (WAStringGetValue #this User_Data))
          (sett HandIndex (count TheHand))
          (loop (greater HandIndex 0)
                (block 
                     (sett MBC (item TheHand HandIndex))
                     (sett HandIndex (subtract HandIndex 1))
                     (if ((WAIsSpecial MBC)
                          (block 
                               (sett PageTaken (WAMovePageFromHandToPlaybook Victim HandIndex -1))
                               (WAMessage -1 (WAGetName #superstar) "has buried" (cat (WAGetNAme #target) "'s") (WAGetName PageTaken))
                          )
                         )
                     )
                )
          )
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

GutWrenchSuplex.gac.name: Gut Wrench Suplex
GutWrenchSuplex.gac.text: Your opponent's next page in playbook is ditched.

Armbar.gac.name: Armbar
Armbar.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves, is countered by Armbar.

Your opponent takes 2 Arm damage each turn. Every turn there is a 40% chance that this hold is released.

StompInTheCorner.gac.name: Stomp In The Corner
StompInTheCorner.gac.text:
Play only if you connected with a move last turn and only in the ring.
You gain +1 Attitude and draw a random page from your playbook with the word "Corner" in the title (other than "Stomp In The Corner").

FlatOfTheFootEX2.gac.name: Flat of the Foot
FlatOfTheFootEX2.gac.text: Counters head down and arm extended moves.

StrikeEX3.gac.name: Strike
StrikeEX3.gac.text: Gain +1 Strike. Your opponent can't see this page.

FigureFour.gac.name: Figure Four
FigureFour.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

The turn you play this move, it does 11 Leg damage. Each other turn it does 7 Leg damage.

PumpHandle.gac.name: Pump Handle
PumpHandle.gac.text:
Counters behind opponent moves.

Your opponent takes 1 Arm damage and has his next 2 pages from playbook ditched.

SunsetFlip2E.gac.name: Sunset Flip
SunsetFlip2E.gac.text: Counters head down moves. Countered by standing above moves. You are put on the mat when you play this. Your opponent is put on the mat and you attempt a pin. If the pin fails you remain in control and draw a page.

PleadToTheReferee2E.gac.name: Plead to the Referee
PleadToTheReferee2E.gac.text: You cannot play this if 'Ref Bump' is in play. If 'Distract The Referee' is in play it is removed. If the move being played against you is Illegal and it connects, your opponent gets 4 Warnings.

Stratusfaction.gac.name: Stratusfaction
Stratusfaction.gac.text:
Trish Stratus Finisher

Counters back to foe and in close moves.
Your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn (unless already stunned).
(Counts as "Bulldog".)

ArmDragCounterTourn.gac.name: Arm Drag Counter
ArmDragCounterTourn.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters arm extended and mad rush moves. Countered by in close moves. This move provides no Momentum.

OldSchool.gac.name: Old School
OldSchool.gac.text:
Undertaker Trademark

Play only in the ring and only if you haven't connected with this move this match. Countered by Arm Drag Counter, not by Dodge.

Name a Method.  Your opponent is put on the mat, ditches all moves of that Method, and you draw 2 pages.

special1.gac.name: Achilles' Heel
special1.gac.text: Whenever you apply a Hold, it does +2 to +6 submission damage (randomly chosen each time). This page is removed when you are Stunned. You can only have one Achilles' Heel in play.

BellyToBellySuplexEX2.gac.name: Belly-to-Belly Suplex
BellyToBellySuplexEX2.gac.text: Counters mad rush and in close moves.

Title-World.gac.name: WWE With Authority! Undisputed Champion
Title-World.gac.text:
Choose one of the following abilities.
FACE: Gain 4 Momentum.
HEEL: If your move isn't countered this turn, your opponent loses 10 Momentum and takes an additional 5 damage. You get 5 Warnings.
