LandOnYourFeet.gac.name: Land On Your Feet
LandOnYourFeet.gac.text: Special: Counter your opponent's move and ditch this page from play. Use this ability only if that move isn't a Takedown and it countered one of your high risk or hit or miss moves.

EdgeTourn.gac.name: Edge
EdgeTourn.gac.text: Each time you connect with a move you haven't connected yet, you get a +1% pin chance bonus for the rest of the match. (When you pin, you are told your current bonus total.)

CompactorEX2.gac.name: Compactor
CompactorEX2.gac.text:
Jeff Hardy Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat or if you have 3 Technical.
You attempt to pin your opponent. You get Crowd Support and remain in control if the pin fails.

ShowstopperChokeslam2E.gac.name: Showstopper Chokeslam
ShowstopperChokeslam2E.gac.text:
Big Show Finisher

Does +10 damage if you have more Momentum than your opponent (not including Attitude). If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn.

(Counts as "Chokeslam".)

fields.Damage_Bonus:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett You (WAGetPlayedBy #this))
          (sett Opponent (WAGetOpponent You))
          (sett OppTotal (WAGetTotalMomentum Opponent))
          (sett OppAttitude (WAGetValue Opponent Generic_Momentum))
          (sett OppAbility (subtract OppTotal OppAttitude))
          (sett YourTotal (WAGetTotalMomentum You))
          (sett YourAttitude (WAGetValue You Generic_Momentum))
          (sett YourAbility (subtract YourTotal YourAttitude))
          (if ((greater YourAbility OppAbility)
               (sett Bonus 10)
              )
              (True
               (sett Bonus 0)
              )
          )
          (WASetValue #this Damage_Bonus (add (WAGetValue #this Damage_Bonus) Bonus))
     )
    )
)

InsideCradleEX3.gac.name: Inside Cradle
InsideCradleEX3.gac.text:
Counters in close, standing above, mad rush and back to foe moves.

This move can't be countered if used as a counter when your opponent has 12 momentum. Your opponent is put on the mat and you attempt a pin with a +35% pin chance bonus. You remain in control if the pin fails.

fields.Counters: in close|standing above|mad rush|back to foe

Hammerlock2E.gac.name: Hammerlock
Hammerlock2E.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves. Countered by Hammerlock.

Your opponent takes 1 arm damage each turn. During the Refresh step, 50% chance you draw a page.

Disadvantage.gac.name: Disadvantage
Disadvantage.gac.text:
Play only while not in control.

Choose one: your opponent's Damage specials are removed from play, or you draw a page and your opponent's move does -2 damage.

fields.List_Values: Choose One:|Opponent's Damage specials removed from play|Draw a page and opponent's move does -2 damage

SteelFoldingChair2E.gac.name: Steel Folding Chair
SteelFoldingChair2E.gac.text:
Chair Shot and Chair To The Back are placed into your hand.

Special: The player in control may remove Steel Folding Chair from the game.

Staggered.gac.name: Staggered
Staggered.gac.text: If this Superstar counters a move, he ditches 2 random pages. His countering move can't be countered by moves. This page leaves play in 3 turns (including this one), or when this Superstar starts a turn in control.

AsaiMoonsaultEX1.gac.name: Asai Moonsault
AsaiMoonsaultEX1.gac.text:
Play only in the Ring while your opponent is at Ringside. You move to Ringside when you play this move.
Draw a page (up to 4) for each move you have connected with since your opponent last had control.

HurriChokeslam.gac.name: Hurri-Chokeslam
HurriChokeslam.gac.text:
Hurricane Finisher

Can't be played against Big Superstars.

If your opponent is a Cruiserweight, this move does +10 damage and if not already stunned, he is stunned until the end of the next turn. Otherwise, he ditches three pages from hand.

MoveToRingside.gac.name: Move To Ringside
MoveToRingside.gac.text:
Play only in the ring, if no moves have been played yet this turn. You can play another special this turn.

You move to ringside. If your opponent was already there, draw two pages. Otherwise, draw one page.

ClimbTheLadder.gac.name: Climb The Ladder
ClimbTheLadder.gac.text: Play only in a Ladder Match or TLC Match, and only if a Ladder is in play. You can only play this in the ring, but your opponent may be at ringside. If your opponent has 0 Hit Points, this can't be countered. You have a chance of winning the match. If you don't win (including if this is countered), this page is shuffled into your playbook and you lose control.

2ndRopeSplash.gac.name: 2nd Rope Leg Drop
2ndRopeSplash.gac.text: Play only if your foe is on the mat in the ring. Your opponent stays on the mat, and if not already stunned, is stunned until the end of the next turn. You get 2 Momentum. If countered, you're stunned until the end of the turn.

RikishiDriver.gac.name: Rikishi Driver
RikishiDriver.gac.text:
Only Rikishi Phatu may play Rikishi Driver.

If your opponent has no Attitude Momentum, this move does +10 damage.

TemperTantrum.gac.name: Temper Tantrum
TemperTantrum.gac.text:
Christian Trademark

Play only in the ring while not in control, and only twice per match. Your opponent gains 2 Attitude and you can't counter his move this turn. Unless you are in a Hold or are stunned, you move to ringside at the end of the turn and draw three pages.

NoChanceInHell.gac.name: No Chance In Hell!
NoChanceInHell.gac.text:
No Specials may be played for 10 turns.

(Each Event may only be played once per match, and no more than three Events total.)

CamelClutchEX2.gac.name: Camel Clutch
CamelClutchEX2.gac.text:
Play only when your opponent is on the mat.

This move does 4 back damage per turn. Each turn this hold is applied your opponent ditches 2 pages from playbook per turn applied. If that playbook is empty, your opponent takes an additional 40 back damage.

KnowledgeEX1.gac.name: Knowledge
KnowledgeEX1.gac.text: Gain 1 Knowledge. Your opponent can't see this page.

TheUndertaker.gac.name: The Undertaker
TheUndertaker.gac.text: The first five times your opponent counters one of your moves that cost 6 or more to play, you draw a page.

HalfBostonCrab2E.gac.name: Half Boston Crab
HalfBostonCrab2E.gac.text:
Play only when your opponent is on the mat.
This move does 5 back damage, +5 for each turn this has been applied. This move may be Autocountered for -1 page for each turn it has been applied.

SensingVictory.gac.name: Sensing Victory
SensingVictory.gac.text: Draw a page. Each turn during the Refresh step you find out how many Hit Points your opponent has. This effect lasts until you're Stunned. You can only have one Sensing Victory in play. This counts as 2 pages when ditched.

RefereeStephanieMcMahon.gac.name: Guest Referee Stephanie McMahon
RefereeStephanieMcMahon.gac.text: Play only if Stephanie is not in play. You get a +5% pin chance bonus. If your opponent has no Knowledge limit, they get a -15% pin chance penalty. When this page leaves play everyone draws 3 pages.

NorthernLightsSuplexEX2.gac.name: Northern Lights Suplex
NorthernLightsSuplexEX2.gac.text:
Counters Power Bomb and Piledriver.

If this move connects you attempt to pin your opponent. If the pin fails you get a +7% pin chance bonus for the rest of the match.

ShowstopperChokeslam.gac.name: Showstopper Chokeslam
ShowstopperChokeslam.gac.text:
Big Show Finisher

Does +10 damage if you have more Ability Momentum than your opponent. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn.

(Counts as "Chokeslam".)

fields.Damage_Bonus:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett You (WAGetPlayedBy #this))
          (sett Opponent (WAGetOpponent You))
          (sett OppTotal (WAGetTotalMomentum Opponent))
          (sett OppAttitude (WAGetValue Opponent Generic_Momentum))
          (sett OppAbility (subtract OppTotal OppAttitude))
          (sett YourTotal (WAGetTotalMomentum You))
          (sett YourAttitude (WAGetValue You Generic_Momentum))
          (sett YourAbility (subtract YourTotal YourAttitude))
          (if ((greater YourAbility OppAbility)
               (sett Bonus 10)
              )
              (True
               (sett Bonus 0)
              )
          )
          (WASetValue #this Damage_Bonus (add (WAGetValue #this Damage_Bonus) Bonus))
     )
    )
)

KickToGut.gac.name: Kick To Gut
KickToGut.gac.text:
If you haven't connected with any leg extended moves this match, this move can't be countered.

Choose a victim below move or Stone Cold Stunner from your playbook. That move is drawn to your hand if this move connects.

BarbedWireTwoByFourShot.gac.name: Barbed-Wire 2x4 Shot
BarbedWireTwoByFourShot.gac.text: This move can't be countered. Your opponent is Busted Wide Open. You lose control at the end of the turn.

RicFlairEX3.gac.name: Ric Flair
RicFlairEX3.gac.text:
You can't play leg extended moves that cost 6 or more.
Special: The Man
If not in control, choose a Special in your hand (except "Once Too Often" or "Crowd Support"). Your opponent buries one page with that name from hand.

PunchesInTheCorner.gac.name: Punches In The Corner
PunchesInTheCorner.gac.text:
Play only in the ring and only if you have hit two moves in a row. Countered by Shove.

This move does 6 damage each turn it is applied, and can only be applied for 3 turns.

LatinoHeatEX1.gac.name: Latino Heat
LatinoHeatEX1.gac.text:
Eddie Guerrero Trademark

Play only while in control, and only if you have no Knowledge Momentum.  Each player may play Latino Heat three times per match.
For each move Method you have connected with in the current move string, draw a page.

ThePeoplesElbow.gac.name: The People's Elbow
ThePeoplesElbow.gac.text:
Only The Rock may play The People's Elbow, and only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.

If you have less than 30 pages left in your playbook, this move does +1 damage for each page less (up to +15.) If your last move was Spine Buster, you get an additional 2 Momentum.

RussianLegSweep.gac.name: Russian Leg Sweep
RussianLegSweep.gac.text:
Counters behind opponent and back to foe moves.

Your opponent's next page is ditched.

RaiseTheKnees.gac.name: Raise The Knees
RaiseTheKnees.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively. Counters Drop moves that are high risk or hit or miss.

This move does +2 damage for each Agility your opponent has.

DoubleLegTakedownSS2002.gac.name: Double Leg Takedown
DoubleLegTakedownSS2002.gac.text: Counters head down and in close moves.

TopeSuicida.gac.name: Plancha
TopeSuicida.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is at Ringside and you are in the Ring. When you play Plancha, you go to Ringside.

Your opponent ditches 1 random page and is stunned until the end of the next turn. You draw a page. If countered, you are stunned until the end of the turn.

TheLastRide2E.gac.name: The Last Ride
TheLastRide2E.gac.text:
Undertaker Finisher

If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn.

Choose: Knowledge, pages in hand, or pages in playbook. If your opponent has more of your choice than you do, this move does +10 damage.

fields.List_Values: Choose one|Pages in hand|Pages remaining in playbook|Knowledge Momentum

TheFinalCut.gac.name: The Final Cut
TheFinalCut.gac.text:
Big Show Finisher

Does +20 damage, -2 damage for each time your opponent has connected with a Takedown move this match (this bonus can't be less than 0).

RingVeteranEX2.gac.name: Ring Veteran
RingVeteranEX2.gac.text:
Can only be played if you have a Knowledge limit of 3 or more (or no limit), and only twice per match.
Name a non-Trademark Special other than "Break!", "Crowd Support" or "Once Too Often".  That page can't be played.

Stratusphere.gac.name: Stratusphere
Stratusphere.gac.text:
Trish Stratus Trademark

Counters high risk moves. Play only if you have hit 2 moves in a row or as a counter. Your opponent is Staggered and you get Crowd Support.
(Counts as "Hurricanrana".)

IrishWhip.gac.name: Irish Whip
IrishWhip.gac.text: Play only while in control. If you have 3 Strength, draw a random Strength move from your playbook. If played with a move that counters mad rush moves and the move connects, it does +5 damage and you gain 1 Attitude Momentum.

LookingForWeakness2E.gac.name: Looking For Weakness
LookingForWeakness2E.gac.text: Draw a page and name a body part. At the end of each turn you find out how much damage you have done to the named body part of your opponent. This page leaves play when you are stunned.

fields.Begin_Refresh:
(block 
     (sett SubDamage (WAGetSubmissionDamage (WAGetPlayedOn #this) (WAStringGetValue #this User_Data)))
     (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #this) "Lawler:" (WAGetName (WAGetPlayedOn #this)) "has" SubDamage "damage on" (WAStringGetValue #this User_Data))
     True
)

Hardcore.gac.name: Hardcore
Hardcore.gac.text:
Play only in a Hardcore, Table or Ladder match. Your opponent sees this page when played.

You lose 3 Attitude and gain 4 Agility, Technical, Strike or Strength (your choice).

BubbaRay.gac.name: Half-Brother Bubba Ray
BubbaRay.gac.text:
Dudleyz Trademark

Play only if Bubba Ray isn't in play. Your opponent cannot play Support or Run In pages.

Special: Your opponent is put on the mat and you receive two Warnings. Use only three times per match, and only when in control.

KneeDrop2E.gac.name: Knee Drop
KneeDrop2E.gac.text:
Play this move only if your opponent is on the mat.

If this move is countered you lose up to an additional 2 Attitude. Your opponent stays on the mat. Unless your opponent has less than 4 pages in hand, your opponent ditches 1 random page.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WASetOnMat #target 1)
          (sett Done (lesser (WAGetHandCount #target) 4))
          (sett NumDitched 0)
          (sett StopNum 1)
          (loop (not Done)
                (block 
                     (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount #target)))
                     (sett Card (item (WAGetHand #target) Ditch))
                     (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #target) (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
                     (WADitchPage #target (subtract Ditch 1))
                     (sett NumDitched (add NumDitched 1))
                     (if ((eq NumDitched StopNum)
                          (sett Done True)
                         )
                         (True
                          (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount #target) 0))
                         )
                     )
                )
          )
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

Knowledge1.gac.name: Knowledge
Knowledge1.gac.text: Gain 1 Knowledge. Your opponent can't see this page.

ShootingStarPress2E.gac.name: Shooting Star Press
ShootingStarPress2E.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring, and only if you haven't yet connected with this move this match.

You attempt a pin with a +5% pin chance. If the pin fails you remain in control.

NorthernLightsSuplex.gac.name: Northern Lights Suplex
NorthernLightsSuplex.gac.text:
Counters victim below moves.

Your opponent is pinned. If the pin does not work you stay in Control.

ControlThePace.gac.name: Control The Pace
ControlThePace.gac.text: Play only if you have hit three moves in a row and you don't have Control The Pace in play. If your move is countered by a move, you draw a page. When your opponent's moves are, your opponent draws a page and the next page from his playbook is ditched. This page leaves play when you are hit with three moves in a row.

ClotheslineOverTheRopes.gac.name: Clothesline Over The Ropes
ClotheslineOverTheRopes.gac.text:
Play this move only if both you and your opponent are in the ring. Countered by Back Body Drop To Ringside.

This move does up to +7 damage. Your opponent is moved to Ringside.

TechnicalEX2.gac.name: Technical
TechnicalEX2.gac.text: Gain 1 Technical. Your opponent can't see this page.

RikishiPhatu.gac.name: Rikishi Phatu
RikishiPhatu.gac.text:
Special: "Sultan of Squat"
Your opponent loses 1 Momentum and a Strength or Strike Momentum page is placed in your hand. This ability works twice a match.

Hello.gac.name: Hello!
Hello.gac.text:
William Regal Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat and you have hit two moves in a row.

Name a Special in your deck, which is drawn to your hand.  Gain one Attitude.  (You can't play this if there are no Specials left in your playbook.)

StratusfactionLE.gac.name: Stratusfaction
StratusfactionLE.gac.text:
Trish Stratus Finisher

Counters back to foe and in close moves.
Your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn (unless already stunned).
(Counts as "Bulldog".)

PunchEX2.gac.name: Punch the Chair
PunchEX2.gac.text:
Big Superstars Trademark

Play only if Steel Folding Chair is in play. Counters "Chair Shot" and "Running Chair Shot". When used as a counter, this move can't be countered and does +4 damage.

SpinningHeelKick2E.gac.name: Spinning Heel Kick
SpinningHeelKick2E.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat. Unless already stunned, he is stunned until the end of the next turn.

619LE.gac.text:
Rey Mysterio Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. Your opponent is Staggered. This move does +1 damage for each page in your hand less than 10. (3 pages in hand will give this move +7 damage.)

TopRopeNeckbreaker.gac.name: Top Rope Neckbreaker
TopRopeNeckbreaker.gac.text:
Play only once per match, only in the ring and only if you have hit three moves in a row.
Your opponent ditches all Agility and Strength moves and is stunned until the end of the next turn. You gain +3 Attitude.

SidewalkSlamEX2.gac.name: Sidewalk Slam
SidewalkSlamEX2.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

"Strength" is drawn from your playbook.

SpineBuster2E.gac.name: Spine Buster
SpineBuster2E.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

This move does 3 Back damage.

ChopEX2.gac.name: Chop
ChopEX2.gac.text:
Counters Chop.

Choose a page in your hand. If this move connects that page is ditched.

XFactor.gac.name: X-Factor
XFactor.gac.text:
Only X-Pac may play X-Factor. Counters head down moves.

This move does up to +9 damage. If your opponent is not stunned, he is stunned until the end of the next turn.

GeneralManagerEricBischoff.gac.name: RAW General Manager Eric Bischoff
GeneralManagerEricBischoff.gac.text:
Play only in a Normal or Main Event match.

No warnings can be given and no count outs can happen. At a random point, both Superstars may be moved to ringside.
This page leaves play after 7 turns.

fields.Page_Played:
(if ((eq #page #this)
     (block 
          (WASetValue (WAGameMap) RefNoCountOut 1)
          (WASetValue (WAGameMap) PlayedEricBischoff 1)
          (WASetValue 
               (WAGameMap)
               EventsPlayed
               (add 1
                    (WAGetValue (WAGameMap) EventsPlayed)
               )
          )
          (WAMessage -1 "Jim Ross: Wait a minute, it's RAW General Manager Eric Bischoff!")
          (WAMessageFromPage #this -1 "You people, well, you are not entertaining me. This match is now a No DQ match.")
          (WASetValue #this RandomMove (WARandom 1 3))
     )
    )
)

TechnicalEX3.gac.name: Technical
TechnicalEX3.gac.text: Gain +1 Technical. Your opponent can't see this page.

SteelFoldingChair.gac.name: Steel Folding Chair
SteelFoldingChair.gac.text:
"Chair Shot" and "Chair To The Back" are placed into your hand.

Special: The player in control may remove Steel Folding Chair from the game.

LowBlowMuleKick2E.gac.name: Low Blow Mule Kick
LowBlowMuleKick2E.gac.text:
Counters behind opponent moves.
Your opponent is put on the mat and stunned next turn.
You receive 4 Warnings. When used as a counter, there is a 90% chance that you receive only 1 Warning.

splash.gac.name: Splash
splash.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat. Your opponent stays on the mat.

Unless your opponent has less than 4 pages in hand, your opponent ditches 1 random page. If countered, you lose up to an additional 2 Momentum.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WASetOnMat #target 1)
          (sett Done (lesser (WAGetHandCount #target) 4))
          (sett NumDitched 0)
          (sett StopNum 1)
          (loop (not Done)
                (block 
                     (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount #target)))
                     (sett Card (item (WAGetHand #target) Ditch))
                     (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #target) (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
                     (WADitchPage #target (subtract Ditch 1))
                     (sett NumDitched (add NumDitched 1))
                     (if ((eq NumDitched StopNum)
                          (sett Done True)
                         )
                         (True
                          (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount #target) 0))
                         )
                     )
                )
          )
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)
fields.Move_Countered:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Momentum (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
          (sett MLoss (WARandom 0 2))
          (sett Momentum (subtract Momentum MLoss))
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum Momentum)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

ShoulderBreaker.gac.name: Shoulder Breaker
ShoulderBreaker.gac.text: Your opponent is put on the mat. This move does Arm damage equal to your Technical.

fields.Move_Connected: (WASetOnMat #target 1)

LowBlowHeadbutt.gac.name: Low Blow Headbutt
LowBlowHeadbutt.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat. 

You receive 2 Warnings from the Referee and your opponent's next 9 pages from playbook are ditched.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WAWarn #superstar 2)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

JeffHardyEX2.gac.name: Jeff Hardy
JeffHardyEX2.gac.text:
Member of Team Xtreme

Jeff Hardy can Autocounter for -1 page.

When Jeff Hardy plays a Drop move you draw a page.

XPac.gac.name: X-Pac
XPac.gac.text:
When in control, your Impact moves do up to +3 damage.
Special: Martial Arts Pro
Choose a Leg Extended move in your Playbook. That move is drawn to your hand. Use once per match.

StratusfactionGuaranteed.gac.name: Stratusfaction Guaranteed!
StratusfactionGuaranteed.gac.text:
Trish Stratus Trademark
The first time you play "Stratusfaction" it can't be countered if you have 6 Technical. Choose a Method. Whenever you connect with a move of that Method that costs 6 or more, you get "Crowd Support" if your opponent isn't a Diva.

AbdominalStretch.gac.name: Abdominal Stretch
AbdominalStretch.gac.text:
Countered by Hip Toss.

This move does 6 Back damage per turn. At the end of the turn there is a 25% chance that this hold is released. (Your opponent gets control.)

SteelFoldingChairEX2.gac.name: Steel Folding Chair
SteelFoldingChairEX2.gac.text: Special: Either this page is removed from the game or "Chair Shot" is played as your move this turn (your choice). Only use this ability if you haven't played a move this turn, you're in your opponent's location and only once each time you have control.

fields.List_Values: Choose one:|Remove Steel Folding Chair from the game|Play Chair Shot

M.gac.name: M
M.gac.text:
Scotty 2 Hotty Trademark

Play only if you have W, O, R in play and The Worm in your hand.
Gain 6 momentum. All of your specials in play are removed at the end of the turn.

FistDrop.gac.name: Fist Drop
FistDrop.gac.text: Play this move only if your opponent is on the mat. If countered you lose up to an additional 2 momentum.

fields.Move_Countered:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Momentum (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
          (sett MLoss (WARandom 0 2))
          (sett Momentum (subtract Momentum MLoss))
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum Momentum)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

Whooooooooooo.gac.name: Whooooooooooo!
Whooooooooooo.gac.text:
Ric Flair Trademark

Draw a page. Your opponent can't play special pages for the next four turns (including this one).

Neckbreaker.gac.name: Neckbreaker
Neckbreaker.gac.text:
Counters behind opponent moves.
Your opponent takes 2 Head damage and has his next page ditched. Unless your opponent has less than 4 pages in hand, your opponent ditches 1 random page from hand.

TripleH2E.gac.name: Triple H
TripleH2E.gac.text:
Special: Best In The Business

Choose a page in your playbook. It is drawn to your hand. Use this ability once after turn 10 and once after turn 40.

TestOfStrength.gac.name: Test Of Strength
TestOfStrength.gac.text:
Play only if you haven't connected with any non-defensive moves. Can only be used offensively if you have any Technical. Countered by Test Of Strength.
If you have more Strength moves and momentum in your playbook (combined) than your opponent, you draw two random Defensive moves.

BustedOpen2E.gac.name: Busted Open
BustedOpen2E.gac.text: Play with a Strike Impact move. If the move connects it does +4 damage and your opponent is Busted Wide Open.

EddieGuerreroTourn.gac.name: Eddie Guerrero
EddieGuerreroTourn.gac.text:
The first time you connect with a move in any Method after turn 5, you draw a page.
(This special ignores moves on the first five turns completely.)

BubbaBombEX2.gac.name: Bubba Bomb
BubbaBombEX2.gac.text:
Bubba Ray Dudley Finisher
Counters arm extended moves. This move does +1 damage (up to +12) for each Takedown you have connected with. When used as a counter when not in control, this move can't be countered.

SamoanDropEX2.gac.name: Samoan Drop
SamoanDropEX2.gac.text: Play only in the ring. Counters mad rush moves. To play, you must choose and ditch a page. A random Gameplan special in play is ditched.

DoubleLegTakedown.gac.name: Double Leg Takedown
DoubleLegTakedown.gac.text: Counters leg extended and victim below moves.

LowBlow.gac.name: Low Blow Kick
LowBlow.gac.text: You receive 3 Warnings from the referee. Your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

LegGrapevine2E.gac.name: Leg Grapevine
LegGrapevine2E.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

This move does 3 Leg damage each turn. At the end of each turn, your opponent's next 4 pages in playbook are ditched.

Lionsault.gac.name: Lionsault
Lionsault.gac.text:
Chris Jericho Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat and in the ring.

You gain +1 Attitude and attempt a pin. If the pin fails you remain in control.

PressSlamEX2.gac.name: Press Slam
PressSlamEX2.gac.text: This move can't be played unless you have at least as much Strength as your opponent.

Lariat2E.gac.name: Lariat
Lariat2E.gac.text:
Counters hit or miss and mad rush moves.
When you play this move, name a move type (not Defensive). If this connects, your opponent buries a move of the chosen move type and is put on the mat.

fields.List_Values: Name a Move Type|arm extended|back to foe|behind opponent|head down|high risk|hit or miss|in close|leg extended|mad rush|standing above|victim below

TheWorm.gac.name: The Worm
TheWorm.gac.text:
Scotty 2 Hotty Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. This move does +3 damage for each WORM special you have in play. If you played them all this turn, this move may not be countered (your opponent cannot play moves or Specials) and your opponent's Specials in hand are ditched.

ReverseDDT2E.gac.name: Reverse DDT
ReverseDDT2E.gac.text:
Counters in close moves. Can only be used as a counter if you have Agility.

Your opponent's next four pages from playbook are ditched.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

EuropeanUppercutEX3.gac.name: European Uppercut
EuropeanUppercutEX3.gac.text: Play only as a counter or if you have Strike. Counters in close moves.

LatinoHeat2E.gac.name: Latino Heat
LatinoHeat2E.gac.text:
Eddie Guerrero Trademark

Play only while in control, and only if you have no Knowledge. Each player may play Latino Heat three times per match.
For each move Method you have connected with in the current move string, draw a page.

ShoulderBlockEX3.gac.name: Shoulder Block
ShoulderBlockEX3.gac.text:
Play only if your Strength limit is 3 or more.

A random Gameplan in your opponent's hand is buried. If there aren't any, the next one in his playbook is buried instead.

SuplexOntoTheRopes.gac.name: Suplex Onto The Ropes
SuplexOntoTheRopes.gac.text:
Willpower 2

Can't be played against Big Superstars.

Strike Combo: This move does +2 damage and you get +2 Attitude.

Litacanrana2E.gac.name: Litacanrana
Litacanrana2E.gac.text:
Lita Trademark

Countered by Power Bomb. Your opponent ditches a page for each different Face move you have connected with this match.

HollywoodHogan.gac.name: Hollywood Hulk Hogan
HollywoodHogan.gac.text:
nWo Superstar. You may play only one nWo page.
Special: "The Icon"
Use only while in control when you have a Special in hand, up to five times per match. The least expensive Special in your hand is ditched and you gain 1 Knowledge.

MissileDropkick2E.gac.name: Missile Dropkick
MissileDropkick2E.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit three moves in a row and your opponent is on the mat in the ring.

Your opponent ditches 3 random pages. If countered, you're stunned until the end of the turn.

BubbaTough.gac.name: Bubba Tough
BubbaTough.gac.text:
Bubba Ray Dudley Trademark

Play only if you don't have one in play. You can play this even while stunned. At the end of each turn, you lose a random Status and are unstunned. This leaves play in six turns.

ExposeTheTurnbuckle.gac.name: Expose The Turnbuckle
ExposeTheTurnbuckle.gac.text: If "Turnbuckle Smash", "Slingshot Into Post", or "Snake Eyes" connects in the ring, there is a 75% chance the Superstar hit with the move gets Busted Wide Open and the Superstar doing the move gets 4 Warnings. If the move is countered, it is shuffled into the playbook of the Superstar doing the move.

FlipOffTheReferee.gac.name: Intimidate The Referee
FlipOffTheReferee.gac.text: No warnings will be given out for three turns (including this one). If "Plead to the Referee" is played, this page leaves play but it can't be played unless that superstar has any Knowledge.

ArmbarTakedown.gac.name: Armbar Takedown
ArmbarTakedown.gac.text:
Counters arm extended moves.

Your opponent takes 1 Arm damage and there is a 50% chance your opponent's next page is ditched.

SledgehammerShot.gac.name: Sledgehammer Shot
SledgehammerShot.gac.text:
Triple H Finisher

Countered by moves that counter mad rush moves. Your opponent is Busted Wide Open and put on the mat, and you get 15 Warnings.

fields.Countered_By: arm extended|behind opponent|back to foe|defensive|head down|in close|hit or miss|high risk|mad rush|standing above|leg extended|victim below

LowBlowMuleKickEX3.gac.name: Low Blow Mule Kick
LowBlowMuleKickEX3.gac.text:
Counters back to foe and in close moves.

When you play this, your opponent is Staggered and can't play specials this turn, and you get 3 Warnings.

BuildingMomentum.gac.name: Building Momentum
BuildingMomentum.gac.text: Choose a number from 1 to 3. You draw that many random common momentum pages from your playbook (but not more than your Attitude), then lose that much Attitude.

BostonCrab.gac.name: Boston Crab
BostonCrab.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

This move does 8 back damage per turn. At the end of each turn, you have a 30% chance of drawing a Damage special from your playbook. If countered, you're stunned for the rest of the turn.

TarantulaLE.gac.name: Tarantula
TarantulaLE.gac.text:
Tajiri Trademark

Play only in the ring. Counters mad rush moves. Each turn this is applied, you get 1 Warning and draw a random momentum page from your playbook, and your opponent takes 5 damage.
Mad rush combo: Specials can't be played until this move is countered or released.

DDTEX1.gac.name: DDT
DDTEX1.gac.text:
Counters head down moves.

Choose one: A random special in your opponent's hand is ditched or you gain +1 Attitude.

BaseballSlide.gac.name: Baseball Slide
BaseballSlide.gac.text:
Play this move only if you are in the ring and your opponent is Ringside. When you play Baseball Slide, you go to Ringside.
Your opponent ditches pages from his playbook equal to twice your Technical (up to +12).

Clip.gac.name: Clip
Clip.gac.text: Your opponent is put on the mat, loses 1 Attitude and takes 5 Leg damage.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WASetOnMat #target 1)
          (sett Momentum (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
          (sett Momentum (subtract Momentum 1))
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum Momentum)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

KnockOffTheTurnbuckle.gac.name: Knock Off The Turnbuckle
KnockOffTheTurnbuckle.gac.text:
This move can only be played in the ring and can't be used offensively. Counters high risk moves.

Your opponent loses 1 Agility. This page counts as two pages when you choose to ditch it.

RefereeJimmyKorderas.gac.name: Referee Jimmy Korderas
RefereeJimmyKorderas.gac.text:
Superstars can't be counted out unless they have been at Ringside for at least 7 turns.

(You may only play a Referee if there is no other Referee in play.)

AlwaysThinking2E.gac.name: Always Thinking
AlwaysThinking2E.gac.text:
Draw a page.
After you draw a page during the Refresh step, you are told what the next page is. Multiple uses of this page allow you to see more pages from your playbook. If you are stunned, this page leaves play.

Hammerlock.gac.name: Hammerlock
Hammerlock.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves. Countered by Hammerlock.

Your opponent takes 1 Arm damage each turn. During the Refresh step, 50% chance you draw a page.

HogansBigBoot2E.gac.name: Hogan's Big Boot
HogansBigBoot2E.gac.text:
Hulk Hogan Trademark
Counters mad rush moves. If played with Irish Whip and you haven't connected with this move yet, this move can't be countered. Your opponent is put on the mat. 
(Counts as "Mafia Kick")

JustBringIt.gac.name: Just Bring It!
JustBringIt.gac.text:
The Rock Trademark

On turn four, your opponent can't play Holds. At the end of turn four, if your opponent has control you get control. Otherwise, you draw a page.
(Superstars may only play one Entrance, and only on turn one or two.)

ChrisBenoit2E.gac.name: Chris Benoit
ChrisBenoit2E.gac.text: Each time an opponent's body part takes 5 damage, you draw a page. (This happens when that body part takes 14 damage, 21 damage, and so on.)

TheHeadliner.gac.name: The Headliner!
TheHeadliner.gac.text:
Shawn Michaels Trademark

If you receive a Status, this page leaves play.

Choose a method. When you connect with a move of that method, you gain +1 Attitude.

StealYourFinisher2E.gac.name: Steal Your Finisher
StealYourFinisher2E.gac.text: Play if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. If your opponent's Finisher is in his hand or playbook, you play it as your move this turn (randomly chosen if there's more than one). If it connects, your opponent loses 10 Attitude.

Strike2E.gac.name: Strike
Strike2E.gac.text: Gain 1 Strike. Your opponent can't see this page.

DiveToTheFloor.gac.name: Dive To The Floor
DiveToTheFloor.gac.text:
Play this move only if your opponent is at ringside and you are in the ring. When you play Dive To The Floor, you are sent to Ringside. If countered, you are stunned until the end of the turn.

You draw a page. This move is worth 3 Momentum. (Face page.)

KurtAngle2E.gac.name: Kurt Angle
KurtAngle2E.gac.text:
Special: It's True
Draw a page (up to 5) for each Special that is in play. Use this ability once per match.

Taunt.gac.name: Taunt
Taunt.gac.text:
Draw a page.

Your opponent loses one Momentum. Your next move does +2 damage. (Heel page: cannot be played if you have played a Face page.)

PowerBombEX3.gac.name: Power Bomb
PowerBombEX3.gac.text:
Cruiserweight Trademark

Play only against a Cruiserweight. Can't be played by a Diva.
Technical Combo: This move does +7 damage.

Willpower 2

HurricanranaEX2.gac.name: Hurricanrana
HurricanranaEX2.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

This move does +1 damage for each Momentum your opponent has. If your opponent has 3 Knowledge, this move can't be countered the first time you play it. If countered, you're Grounded.

Enzugiri.gac.name: Enzugiri
Enzugiri.gac.text: Your opponent takes 8 Head damage and is put on the mat.

BackToTheWellOnceToOften.gac.name: Once Too Often
BackToTheWellOnceToOften.gac.text: Counter your opponent's move. Use only if your opponent has connected with that move this match, and only if you are not in control and not in a submission Hold. You may use this page even if you are stunned.

CowBellShot.gac.name: Cow Bell Shot
CowBellShot.gac.text:
Bradshaw Trademark

Counters mad rush moves. You get 5 Warnings (except the first time you connect with this move). Your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

TripleH.gac.name: Triple H
TripleH.gac.text:
Special: Be The Game
Name a page. That page is drawn from your Playbook and put into your hand. Use this ability once per game.

TakeABreather.gac.name: Take A Breather
TakeABreather.gac.text: Your opponent draws a page and you gain 3 Hit Points. Gain an additional HP for each Strength momentum point you have (up to 10 additional.) You cannot have more than your maximum Hit Points.

BustedOpen.gac.name: Busted Open
BustedOpen.gac.text: Play with a Strike Impact move. If the move connects it does +4 damage and your opponent gets a Busted Wide Open status Special (ignoring play restrictions).

WithAuthorityEX2.gac.name: With Authority!
WithAuthorityEX2.gac.text: Choose one of your opponent's Gameplan or Weapon specials in play. (You can't play this if there aren't any.) If the move connects, it does +2 damage and that special is shuffled into the playbook of the Superstar who played it.

TheLastRideTourn.gac.name: The Last Ride
TheLastRideTourn.gac.text:
Undertaker Finisher

If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn.

Choose: Knowledge, pages in hand, or pages in playbook. If your opponent has more of your choice than you do, this move does +10 damage.

fields.List_Values: Choose one|Pages in hand|Pages remaining in playbook|Knowledge Momentum

ArmDragTakedown2E.gac.name: Arm Drag Takedown
ArmDragTakedown2E.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

If you have any Knowledge Momentum, draw one page.

GarbageCanShot.gac.name: Garbage Can Shot
GarbageCanShot.gac.text:
Play only in a Hardcore match. Countered by Mafia Kick.

Your opponent is put on the mat and loses 1 Knowledge. If he then has 0 Knowledge, you draw a page.

AnglesAnkleLock2E.gac.name: Angle's Ankle Lock
AnglesAnkleLock2E.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Finisher

Play only when your opponent is on the mat. 

This move does 10 Leg damage per turn, or 14 Leg damage if you have Intensity in play.

BodySlamEX2.gac.name: Body Slam
BodySlamEX2.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

You may choose to lose 1 Attitude when this move connects. If you do, your opponent is moved to ringside.

ArmbarTakedownEX3.gac.name: Armbar Takedown
ArmbarTakedownEX3.gac.text:
Counters arm extended moves.

This move does 5 arm damage.

Technical Combo: "Armbar" is drawn from your playbook.

AggressiveAgility.gac.name: Aggressive Agility
AggressiveAgility.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit two moves in a row and only after turn 5.

Gain +1 Agility and +1 Attitude.

RulesEX1.gac.name: No Way Out Rules Page
RulesEX1.gac.text:
Some pages say they 'count as' other pages. This means that you can only have a total of five pages combined in a single playbook (you could have five Lita's Moonsault or Moonsault, or two of each, but not three of each).
All pages with the exact same name always 'count as' each other.
