FlyingWheelKick2E.gac.name: Flying Wheel Kick
FlyingWheelKick2E.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

Unless your opponent has less than 4 pages in hand, your opponent ditches 2 random pages. This move does up to +3 damage.

RingBellShot.gac.name: Ring Bell Shot
RingBellShot.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is stunned or at ringside, and only once per match.

You get 5 Warnings and your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn and is Busted Wide Open.

24InchPythons2E.gac.name: 24 Inch Pythons
24InchPythons2E.gac.text:
Hulk Hogan Trademark

Special: Lose 1 Attitude. If you connect with a Strength move this turn it does +4 damage.

SnowPlow.gac.name: Snow Plow
SnowPlow.gac.text:
Al Snow Finisher

For each Momentum that you have 2 or more of, you get:
Strength: +4 damage
Strike: +4 damage
Agility: gain +2 Attitude
Technical: your opponent loses 3 Attitude
Knowledge: attempt a pin. If the pin fails you remain in control.

AsaiMoonsaultEX3.gac.name: Asai Moonsault
AsaiMoonsaultEX3.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is at ringside. If you are in the ring, you are moved to ringside when you play this.

Draw three pages. If countered, you take 9 damage.

EddieGuerrero.gac.name: Eddie Guerrero
EddieGuerrero.gac.text: When you end a turn without playing a move (or keeping a Hold applied), you lose up to 4 Attitude Momentum.  When your opponent does this after turn 5, you draw a page.

WraparoundNeckbreaker.gac.name: Wraparound Neckbreaker
WraparoundNeckbreaker.gac.text:
William Regal Trademark

Counters arm extended moves.
Choose one: This move does 5 Arm and 5 Head damage, or you draw a random Special from your playbook.

fields.List_Values: Choose One:|Arm and Head damage|Draw a random Special

MafiaKick2E.gac.name: Mafia Kick
MafiaKick2E.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

This move does up to +5 damage. Your opponent is put on the mat.

DiveToTheFloorEX2.gac.name: Dive To The Floor
DiveToTheFloorEX2.gac.text:
Play only if a Ladder is in play, you are in the ring and your opponent is at ringside.
When you play this move, you move to ringside, all pages in your hand are ditched and you draw pages equal to the amount you had. This move does +1 damage for each page you had (up to +12) and your opponent is put on the mat.

HogansBigBoot2ELE.gac.name: Hogan's Big Boot
HogansBigBoot2ELE.gac.text:
Hulk Hogan Trademark
Counters mad rush moves. If played with Irish Whip and you haven't connected with this move yet, this move can't be countered. Your opponent is put on the mat. 
(Counts as "Mafia Kick")

PowerBombFromTheLadder.gac.name: Power Bomb From Ladder
PowerBombFromTheLadder.gac.text:
Counters Climb The Ladder.

Play only if a Ladder is in play. You get 5 Warnings and a +5% climb chance. If used as a counter, this move can't be countered.

CaptureSuplex.gac.name: T-Bone Suplex
CaptureSuplex.gac.text:
Only Tazz may play T-Bone Suplex. Counters leg extended and mad rush moves.

All opponent's pages in hand that are not Specials are buried. That player then draws three pages.

Lita2E.gac.name: Lita
Lita2E.gac.text:
Member of Team XTreme, Diva Superstar

You get "Crowd Support" when you play a Face page.
Special: Get XTreme
All moves do double base damage this turn. Use this ability once per match.

BodyVice.gac.name: Body Vice
BodyVice.gac.text:
Brock Lesnar Trademark

Your opponent takes 5 damage and 1 back damage each turn this is applied. If he is Busted Wide Open, they take 11 damage and 1 back damage instead.

KevinNash.gac.name: Kevin Nash
KevinNash.gac.text:
Scott Hall Trademark

At the end of each fifth turn of the match, you gain 1 Attitude.
Special: The Referee is removed from the game.
(Heel page: cannot be played if you have played a Face page.)

ToughGuy2E.gac.name: Tough Guy
ToughGuy2E.gac.text:
Play only if you don't have Tough Guy in play. The next time you would be stunned, this page is removed from play instead.
You may play this page if you are stunned. If you do, you are no longer stunned and this remains in play.

TakingAHugeChance.gac.name: Taking a Huge Chance
TakingAHugeChance.gac.text:
Play when at ringside or during a Hardcore or Ladder match, and only with a high risk move.
You take 8 damage and the move does +13 damage. The move can't be Autocountered. Your opponent can't play any pages except Dodge. If countered, you ditch five random pages from your hand.

TheMainEvent.gac.name: The Main Event
TheMainEvent.gac.text:
Special: Choose a move or special in your playbook with a total cost less than or equal to your Knowledge.  That page is drawn to your hand. You can use this ability twice, your opponent can use this once.

(Superstars may only play one Entrance, and only on turn one or two.)

VerticalSuplexEX1.gac.name: Vertical Suplex
VerticalSuplexEX1.gac.text:
Countered by Up and Over.

If you are at Ringside, your opponent ditches a random page from hand. Otherwise, your opponent's next 2 pages from playbook are ditched.

CamelClutch.gac.name: Camel Clutch
CamelClutch.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat and you have hit 2 moves in a row.

This move does 7 Head damage per turn.

ClotheslineEX1.gac.name: Clothesline
ClotheslineEX1.gac.text:
Counters hit or miss moves. Your opponent is put on the mat.

Choose one: Draw a random hit or miss move from your playbook or this move does up to +5 damage.

fields.List_Values: Choose one:|Draw Hit or Miss move|Up to +5 damage

TopRopeClothesline.gac.name: Top Rope Clothesline
TopRopeClothesline.gac.text:
Kane Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

You gain 5 Hit Points. Your opponent stays on the mat.

GrabTheRope.gac.name: Grab The Ropes
GrabTheRope.gac.text:
Play only in the ring and only if the referee isn't distracted. Draw a page.

Any pin attempt, submission Hold, or attempt to escape a steel cage is countered. Your opponent remains in control but can't attempt to pin or escape the cage until another move is played.

CripplerCrossFace2E.gac.name: Crippler Cross Face
CripplerCrossFace2E.gac.text:
Chris Benoit Finisher

Counters arm extended and in close moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat. This move does 9 arm and 9 head damage per turn.

ElbowToSmallOfTheBack.gac.name: Elbow To The Kidneys
ElbowToSmallOfTheBack.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves.

This move does 3 back damage.

FlyingArmbarTakedown.gac.name: Flying Armbar Takedown
FlyingArmbarTakedown.gac.text:
Play only in the ring.

This move does 15 arm damage. If countered, you take 5 damage.

StrengthEX3.gac.name: Strength
StrengthEX3.gac.text: Gain +1 Strength. Your opponent can't see this page.

RunningPowerslam.gac.name: Running Powerslam
RunningPowerslam.gac.text:
This move cannot be played against Big Superstars, and counts as 2 pages when ditched. Countered by Up and Over.
"Strength" is drawn from your playbook. (Counts as "Powerslam.")

AggressiveStrike.gac.name: Aggressive Strike
AggressiveStrike.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit two moves in a row and only after turn 5.

Gain +1 Strike and +1 Attitude.

WithAuthorityWMX8X8.gac.name: With Authority! (Wrestlemania X-8)
WithAuthorityWMX8X8.gac.text: Play with a move while in control. This move can't be Autocountered and if the move connects your opponent ditches a random Special from hand.

AdvantageTechnical.gac.name: Advantage: Impact
AdvantageTechnical.gac.text:
Whenever you connect with an Impact move your opponent loses an extra Attitude.

If you have 4 Strike and 4 Agility, the move does +3 damage and you also gain +1 Attitude.

Shove.gac.name: Shove
Shove.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters back to foe and victim below moves. Countered by arm extended moves. This move provides no Momentum.

SpineKickEX3.gac.name: Spine Kick
SpineKickEX3.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent's next five pages are revealed to you. Choose one; the others are ditched. (This can't be played if your opponent has no pages left.)

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett ThePlaybook (WAGetPlaybook #target))
          (sett DummyPage (WACreatePageByUNID #superstar (WAStringGetValue #this User_Data)))
          (sett MatchUNID (WAGetUNID DummyPage))
          (if ((eq (item ThePlaybook 1) MatchUNID)
               (block 
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 4)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 3)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 2)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 1)
               )
              )
              ((eq (item ThePlaybook 2) MatchUNID)
               (block 
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 4)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 3)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 2)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 0)
               )
              )
              ((eq (item ThePlaybook 3) MatchUNID)
               (block 
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 4)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 3)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 1)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 0)
               )
              )
              ((eq (item ThePlaybook 4) MatchUNID)
               (block 
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 4)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 2)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 1)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 0)
               )
              )
              ((eq (item ThePlaybook 4) MatchUNID)
               (block 
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 3)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 2)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 1)
                    (WADitchFromPlaybook #target 0)
               )
              )
          )
     )
    )
)

LookingForWeaknesses.gac.name: Looking For Weakness
LookingForWeaknesses.gac.text: Draw a page and name a body part. At the end of each turn you are told how much damage you have done to that body part of your opponent. Lasts until you're Stunned.

fields.Begin_Refresh:
(block 
     (sett SubDamage (WAGetSubmissionDamage (WAGetPlayedOn #this) (WAStringGetValue #this User_Data)))
     (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #this) "Lawler:" (WAGetName (WAGetPlayedOn #this)) "has" SubDamage "damage on" (WAStringGetValue #this User_Data))
     True
)

GarbageCan.gac.name: Garbage Can
GarbageCan.gac.text: Special: Choose "Garbage Can Lid Shot" or "Garbage Can Shot". It is played as your move, ignoring play requirements (including Momentum). Use this ability when in control, and only if you haven't played a move yet this turn. Use this ability once per match.

Christian.gac.name: Christian
Christian.gac.text:
"Un-Americans" Member
If you don't have Warnings, your opponent can't play "Plead to the Referee" or "Good Officiating!"
Special: On Your Own
The number of Warnings you have is reset to 0. Use twice per match.

WithAuthority.gac.name: With Authority!
WithAuthority.gac.text:
Play only while in Control. This move does +4 damage and may not be Autocountered.

(If used with a Hold, the move can be autocountered after the first turn it is applied.)

R.gac.name: R
R.gac.text:
Scotty 2 Hotty Trademark

Your Agility moves do +1 damage for each WORM special you have in play, and get a 25% chance of ditching an extra page from opponent's hand. You may play another Special after you play this (on the same turn). You can only have one R in play.

CheeseGrater.gac.name: Cheese Grater
CheeseGrater.gac.text:
Play only in a Steel Cage match and only if your opponent is on the mat.

If your opponent is Busted Wide Open, the next 12 pages in his playbook are ditched. Otherwise he is Busted Wide Open.

ArmDragTakedown.gac.name: Arm Drag Takedown
ArmDragTakedown.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

If you have any Knowledge Momentum, draw one page.

CatchTheFoot.gac.name: Catch The Foot
CatchTheFoot.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively. Counters leg extended moves. Countered by Enzugiri.
When you play this page, if you have any Technical, a random mad rush or behind opponent move is drawn from your playbook.

TheLastRide.gac.name: The Last Ride
TheLastRide.gac.text:
Undertaker Finisher

If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn.

Choose: Knowledge Momentum, pages in hand, or pages in playbook. If your opponent has more of your choice than you do, this move does +10 damage.

fields.List_Values: Choose one|Pages in hand|Pages remaining in playbook|Knowledge Momentum

WithAuthorityEX3.gac.name: With Authority!
WithAuthorityEX3.gac.text:
Play only when in control.

This move can't be Autocountered. If the move is countered, you get Crowd Support.

(If played with a Hold, this special leaves play at the end of the turn.)

IllegalLeverage.gac.name: Illegal Leverage
IllegalLeverage.gac.text:
You get 1 Warning.

This hold does +4 body damage each turn (but not more than the base body damage of the move).

TrishsChop.gac.name: Trish's Roundhouse Kick
TrishsChop.gac.text:
Trish Stratus Trademark

Counters mad rush moves. Your opponent is Staggered and you get Crowd Support.

GoingUpTop.gac.name: Going Up Top!
GoingUpTop.gac.text: Play if you have hit two moves in a row, and only with a high risk move. Draw a page. If the move connects your opponent ditches a page. If it doesn't connect, you draw another page.

WallsOfJericho.gac.name: Walls Of Jericho
WallsOfJericho.gac.text:
Chris Jericho Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Each turn, your opponent takes 7 back damage, plus 1 back damage for each Momentum type you have.

AdvantageStrike.gac.name: Advantage: Precision
AdvantageStrike.gac.text: Choose a body part. Whenever you connect with a Strike move it does +1 damage to that part. If there is 7 or more damage on that part, you draw a random Standing Above move from your playbook.

LowBlowUppercutEX3.gac.name: Low Blow Uppercut
LowBlowUppercutEX3.gac.text:
Counters head down and leg extended moves.

When you play this, your opponent is Staggered and can't play specials this turn, and you get 3 Warnings.

BigAndNasty2E.gac.name: Big and Nasty
BigAndNasty2E.gac.text:
Big Show Trademark

Your Strength moves do +2 damage. Your Strike moves that cost 4 or more have a 33% chance of stunning your opponent. This page leaves play if you are hit with 3 moves in a row. You can only have one Big and Nasty in play.

BearHug.gac.name: Bear Hug
BearHug.gac.text:
Counters in close and mad rush moves, is countered by Ear Clap.

This move does 4 Back damage per turn.

FireExtinguisher.gac.name: Fire Extinguisher
FireExtinguisher.gac.text:
Play only in a Hardcore match. This move can only be used offensively if your opponent is on the mat. Counters arm extended, behind opponent, mad rush and high risk moves.

If your opponent has any Attitude, he loses 2 and is Staggered. Otherwise, your opponent ditches a random page.

RussianLegSweepEX2.gac.name: Russian Leg Sweep
RussianLegSweepEX2.gac.text:
Counters behind opponent and back to foe moves.

If you have more pages in your playbook than your opponent, this move does +4 damage.

KurtAngleTourn.gac.name: Kurt Angle
KurtAngleTourn.gac.text:
Special: It's True
Draw a page (up to 5) for each Special that is in play. Use this ability once per match.

RefereeEarlHebner2E.gac.name: Senior Referee Earl Hebner
RefereeEarlHebner2E.gac.text:
Play only if you have no Knowledge limit.
Special: Both players move from the ring to ringside. No count outs will be given but after 5 turns both superstars move back. Superstars can't move back into the ring otherwise. Use only if a move hasn't been played this turn, and only once per match.

EyeOfTheHurricane.gac.name: Eye Of The Hurricane
EyeOfTheHurricane.gac.text:
Hurricane Finisher

This move does +1 damage (up to +12) for each Technical move you have connected with. "Hook The Leg" is drawn from your playbook.

InsaneBump.gac.name: Insane Bump
InsaneBump.gac.text:
Spike Dudley Trademark

Play if your opponent is playing a non-Hold move that costs 7 or more. You can't counter the move, draw four pages and gain 4 Attitude.

BigDogInTheYard2E.gac.name: Big Dog In The Yard
BigDogInTheYard2E.gac.text:
Undertaker Trademark

Play only while in control. Choose a Momentum. If your next move connects, it does +3 damage for each point of that Momentum your opponent has (up to +15), then your opponent loses 1 of that Momentum.

TooFar.gac.name: Too Far
TooFar.gac.text: Play only after turn 30. At the end of each turn, each Superstar takes damage equal to their Head or Back damage (whichever is less, maximum 4 damage).

TopRopeClothesline2E.gac.name: Top Rope Clothesline
TopRopeClothesline2E.gac.text:
Kane Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

You gain 5 Hit Points. Your opponent stays on the mat.

LowBlowChairShot.gac.name: Low Blow Chair Shot
LowBlowChairShot.gac.text:
Play only if Steel Folding Chair is in play and you aren't in control. Counters standing above, arm extended and in close moves. Countered by Dodge.

You get 5 Warnings from the referee and your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

TurnbuckleSmash2E.gac.name: Turnbuckle Smash
TurnbuckleSmash2E.gac.text:
Play only in the ring. Countered by Turnbuckle Smash.

For each point of Strike momentum you have this move does +2 damage (up to +10.)

HighSpot.gac.name: High Spot
HighSpot.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Choose a Move page in your playbook that costs 6 or more and draw it.
If your next move this turn is High Risk, you gain 1 Momentum.

ReverseChinlock.gac.name: Reverse Chinlock
ReverseChinlock.gac.text:
Play this move only if you have hit two moves in a row. Your opponent takes 2 Head damage each turn.

There is a 33% chance that this move is released each turn. During the Refresh step draw a page.

SetUp.gac.name: Set Up
SetUp.gac.text:
Play only when in control at ringside.

Choose a move from your playbook. It is drawn to your hand. If it is still in your hand at the end of the turn, it is ditched.

Spear.gac.name: Spear
Spear.gac.text:
Edge Trademark

Counters mad rush moves. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn and you draw "Catch Him Stunned" from your playbook.

ArmbarTakedown2E.gac.name: Armbar Takedown
ArmbarTakedown2E.gac.text:
Counters arm extended moves.

Your opponent takes 1 arm damage and there is a 50% chance your opponent's next page from playbook is ditched.

AlbertaCanada.gac.name: Alberta, Canada
AlbertaCanada.gac.text:
Lance Storm and Chris Benoit Trademark

Play only after turn 15. Gain +1 Technical and +1 Knowledge.

TheFansComeAlive.gac.name: The Fans Come Alive
TheFansComeAlive.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent has connected with two moves in a row. Your opponent's move this turn can't be countered (you can't play any more pages or Autocounter). If you aren't stunned or in a Hold at the end of the turn, you take control. If you still have control after 3 turns, you lose control.
(Face Page.)

Technical1.gac.name: Technical
Technical1.gac.text: Gain 1 Technical. Your opponent can't see this page.

HipToss2E.gac.name: Hip Toss
HipToss2E.gac.text: Counters head down moves. When you play this move, choose a move type. When this move connects, a random move in your opponent's hand that matches that move type is buried. (Defensive moves are immune.)

fields.List_Values: Name a Move Type|arm extended|back to foe|behind opponent|head down|high risk|hit or miss|in close|leg extended|mad rush|standing above|victim below

DoubleUnderhookSuplex.gac.name: Double Underhook Suplex
DoubleUnderhookSuplex.gac.text: Your opponent's next 4 pages from playbook are ditched.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

CrossArmBreaker2E.gac.name: Cross Arm Breaker
CrossArmBreaker2E.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

This move does 11 arm damage per turn and can be Autocountered for -3 pages.

StacyKiebler.gac.name: Stacy Keibler
StacyKiebler.gac.text:
You may play Stacy Keibler if you already have a Support page in play, and only once per match.
Special: Use when not in control. Your opponent's Strike or mad rush move is countered and you gain control. Your opponent draws two pages. Stacy Keibler then leaves play.

BreakEX2.gac.name: Break!
BreakEX2.gac.text:
Play if you aren't in control and your opponent has 3 or more Attitude than you, and only before turn 30.

Your opponent loses 5 Attitude and ditches a random move from hand.

BackSuplex2E.gac.name: Back Suplex
BackSuplex2E.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves.

Choose one: Your opponent ditches a Knowledge Momentum from hand or your opponent ditches a random Special from hand.

DriveIntoTheCorner.gac.name: Shoulder Thrusts In The Corner
DriveIntoTheCorner.gac.text:
Brock Lesnar Trademark

Play only in the ring and only if you hit with a move last turn. Choose one of these Statuses: Grounded, Frustrated, or Staggered. Your opponent gets that Status.

KneeDropEX2.gac.name: Knee Drop
KneeDropEX2.gac.text: Play only when your opponent is on the mat. Choose a page in your hand. If this move connects, that page is ditched and you gain +1 Attitude.

HollywoodHulkHoganLE.gac.name: Hulk Hogan
HollywoodHulkHoganLE.gac.text: The first five times you play a Face special you gain 1 Knowledge.

DiveToTheFloorEX3.gac.name: Dive To The Floor
DiveToTheFloorEX3.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is at ringside and you are in the ring. When you play this move, you are sent to ringside.

Technical Combo: Your opponent's next 10 pages from playbook are ditched.

Trip.gac.name: Trip
Trip.gac.text:
Play only if you have Support and your opponent is playing a mad rush or Agility move.

You counter your opponent's move and get 2 Warnings. Your opponent is Trapped.

W.gac.name: W
W.gac.text:
Scotty 2 Hotty Trademark

While in control, your Strike moves do +1 damage for each WORM special you have in play, and you have a 50% chance of gaining an extra momentum. You may play another Special after you play this (on the same turn). You can only have one W in play.

StepOverHeelKickEX2.gac.name: Step-Over Heel Kick
StepOverHeelKickEX2.gac.text:
Rob Van Dam Trademark

Counters leg extended moves. Your opponent is put on the mat and you draw a random Agility move from your playbook.
(Counts as Spinning Heel Kick.)

ArmStretch.gac.name: Arm Stretch
ArmStretch.gac.text:
Play this move only if your opponent is on the mat.

This move does 3 Arm damage per turn.

WorkTheLeg.gac.name: Work The Leg
WorkTheLeg.gac.text: If your opponent has 5 Leg Damage or more, whenever you connect with an Impact move your opponent ditches a random Agility move.

SlingshotIntoTheCage.gac.name: Slingshot Into The Cage
SlingshotIntoTheCage.gac.text:
Play only in a cage match. Counters victim below moves. Can only be used offensively if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent is put on the mat and is Busted Wide Open.

LatinoHeat.gac.name: Latino Heat
LatinoHeat.gac.text:
Eddie Guerrero Trademark

Play only while in control, and only if you have no Knowledge Momentum.  Each player may play Latino Heat three times per match.
For each move Method you have connected with in the current move string, draw a page.

RefereeCharlesRobinson.gac.name: Referee Charles Robinson
RefereeCharlesRobinson.gac.text:
The turn limit for this match is extended by 10 to 20 turns.

(You may only play a Referee if there is no other Referee in play.)

Tazzmission.gac.name: Tazzmission
Tazzmission.gac.text:
Tazz Finisher

Counters back to foe moves.

Your opponent takes 10 head damage per turn.

SpanishAnnounceTableEX2.gac.name: Spanish Announce Table
SpanishAnnounceTableEX2.gac.text: If a Superstar gets hit with a Drop move that does 6 or more damage while at Ringside, they take +20 damage and this page leaves play. The Superstar doing the move gets 7 Warnings.

WhatImpact2E.gac.name: What Impact!
WhatImpact2E.gac.text: Play with an Impact move. That move does +10 damage.

StrikeEX2.gac.name: Strike
StrikeEX2.gac.text: Gain 1 Strike. Your opponent can't see this page.

RollingGermanSuplex.gac.name: Rolling German Suplex
RollingGermanSuplex.gac.text:
This move may only be played by Chris Benoit. Counters back to foe moves.

This move does +1 to +8 damage. Your opponent ditches 1 to 3 random pages.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Victim #target)
          (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount Victim) 0))
          (sett NumDitched 0)
          (sett StopNum (WARandom 1 3))
          (loop (not Done)
                (block 
                     (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount Victim)))
                     (sett Card (item (WAGetHand Victim) Ditch))
                     (WAMessage (WAGetOwner Victim) (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
                     (WADitchPage Victim (subtract Ditch 1))
                     (sett NumDitched (add NumDitched 1))
                     (if ((eq NumDitched StopNum)
                          (sett Done True)
                         )
                         (True
                          (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount Victim) 0))
                         )
                     )
                )
          )
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

StrengthEX1.gac.name: Strength
StrengthEX1.gac.text: Gain 1 Strength. Your opponent can't see this page.

Clothesline.gac.name: Clothesline
Clothesline.gac.text:
Counters hit or miss and leg extended moves. Countered by Clothesline and Duck.

Your opponent is put on the mat.

Sharpshooter2E.gac.name: Sharpshooter
Sharpshooter2E.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat or as a counter to Sharpshooter. If played as a counter, your opponent is put on the mat. Your opponent can't play moves the first three turns this hold is applied (but he can the turn you play this move).

This move does 10 leg and 10 back damage each turn.

FlyingChairShot.gac.name: Flying Chair Shot
FlyingChairShot.gac.text:
Only Shane McMahon may play Flying Chair Shot.
When you play this move you ditch your hand and Steel Folding Chair is put into play. You get 10 Warnings from the Referee. This move may not be countered.

ShoveTourn.gac.name: Shove
ShoveTourn.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters back to foe and victim below moves. Countered by arm extended moves. This move provides no Momentum.

PowerBomb2E.gac.name: Power Bomb
PowerBomb2E.gac.text:
Countered by Hurricanrana.

If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

DDTEX3.gac.name: DDT
DDTEX3.gac.text:
Counters head down moves.
Your opponent's next three pages are revealed to you. Choose one; the others are ditched. (This can't be played if your opponent has no pages left.)

LionsaultTourn.gac.name: Lionsault
LionsaultTourn.gac.text:
Chris Jericho Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat and in the ring.

You gain +1 Attitude and attempt to pin. If the pin fails you remain in control.

FloatoverDDT2E.gac.name: The Rock's DDT
FloatoverDDT2E.gac.text:
The Rock Trademark
 
Counters mad rush moves. If you have any Knowledge you draw a page and gain 1 Attitude. If you have any Agility you draw a page and gain 1 Attitude. Counts as DDT.

VerticalSuplex2E.gac.name: Vertical Suplex
VerticalSuplex2E.gac.text: Counters in close moves. Countered by Up and Over.

CrossArmBreaker.gac.name: Cross Arm Breaker
CrossArmBreaker.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

This move does 11 Arm damage per turn and can be Autocountered for -3 pages.

OldSchoolEX1.gac.name: Old School
OldSchoolEX1.gac.text:
Undertaker Trademark

Play only in the ring and only if you haven't connected with this move this match. Countered by Arm Drag Counter, not by Dodge.

Name a Method.  Your opponent is put on the mat, ditches all moves of that Method, and you draw 2 pages.

Hurricanrana2E.gac.name: Hurricanrana
Hurricanrana2E.gac.text:
Countered by Power Bomb.

Your opponent ditches 2 pages. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn. If you have any Technical, you pin your opponent. If the pin fails you stay in control. If countered, you are stunned until the end of the turn.

ShaneMcMahonEX1.gac.name: Shane-o-Mac
ShaneMcMahonEX1.gac.text: Play only if Shane McMahon isn't in the match. Special: The referee is distracted for 3 turns (any Referee Special in play is removed). Shane gives your opponent a Flying Chair Shot. Use this ability while not in control, if the ref is not distracted, once per match, and if your opponent has no Support. (Heel page.)

F5.gac.name: F5
F5.gac.text:
Brock Lesnar Finisher

This move does +5 damage for each of these Statuses your opponent received this match: Grounded, Busted Wide Open, Frustrated, and Staggered.

fields.Damage_Bonus:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Cmt "Bonuses here are kept track of on the Brock SS")
          (sett Bonus (WAGetValue #superstar GroundedOpponent))
          (sett Bonus (add Bonus (WAGetValue #superstar BustedWideOpenOpponent)))
          (sett Bonus (add Bonus (WAGetValue #superstar FrustratedOpponent)))
          (sett Bonus (add Bonus (WAGetValue #superstar StaggeredOpponent)))
          (sett Bonus (multiply Bonus 5))
          (WASetValue #this Damage_Bonus (add Bonus (WAGetValue #this Damage_Bonus)))
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

BlockTourn.gac.name: Block
BlockTourn.gac.text: Can't be used offensively. Counters arm extended, leg extended, in close, mad rush, back to foe and standing above moves that are Strike moves. Countered by arm extended, leg extended, and in close moves that are Strike moves. Your opponent can't counter this with a move he has already connected with.

fields.Counters: arm extended|leg extended|in close|mad rush|back to foe|standing above

Bradshaw.gac.name: Bradshaw
Bradshaw.gac.text:
Hardcore Superstar

When you connect with an Impact move that costs 5 or more, your opponent ditches a random special from hand (except Crowd Support) or Gameplan from play.

What.gac.name: What?
What.gac.text:
Stone Cold Trademark

Play with a Strike or Strength move while in control. If the move connects another copy of that move is put into your hand, all copies of What? in your hand are shuffled into your playbook and your opponent ditches 1 Crowd Support from hand.

StraightShooter.gac.name: Straight-Shooter
StraightShooter.gac.text:
Lance Storm Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat. This move does 4 leg damage each turn, +4 leg damage for each pair of Technical and Knowledge you have.

TheLastRideEX1.gac.name: The Last Ride
TheLastRideEX1.gac.text:
Undertaker Finisher

If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn.

Choose: Knowledge Momentum, pages in hand, or pages in playbook. If your opponent has more of your choice than you do, this move does +10 damage.

fields.List_Values: Choose one|Pages in hand|Pages remaining in playbook|Knowledge Momentum

TheBigShow2E.gac.name: The Big Show
TheBigShow2E.gac.text:
Member of nWo

Special: G-Money

Your opponent's move does -4 damage. You can't use this Special again for 10 turns.

Break2E.gac.name: Break!
Break2E.gac.text:
Play if you have hit with two moves in a row, and only if you have not played a move this turn.

Gain 1 Attitude and draw two pages. Your opponent gets control.

Disadvantage2E.gac.name: Disadvantage
Disadvantage2E.gac.text:
Play only while not in control.

Choose one: Your opponent's Damage specials are removed from play, or you draw a page and your opponent's move does -2 damage.

GuitarShot.gac.name: Guitar Shot
GuitarShot.gac.text:
Play only if no one has played this move yet this match, and only in a Hardcore match.

Your opponent is stunned for the next two turns.

ChokeSlam.gac.name: Choke Slam
ChokeSlam.gac.text:
Big Superstars Trademark

Countered by Low Blow Kick and Back Elbow. If your opponent isn't stunned, this move stuns your opponent until the end of the next turn. If your opponent is stunned, there is a 25% chance he remains stunned next turn.

CornerSquash.gac.name: Corner Squash
CornerSquash.gac.text:
Play only in the ring. Counters behind opponent moves.

Your opponent takes 1 back damage, +2 back damage for each Strength you have.

StrengthTourn.gac.name: Strength
StrengthTourn.gac.text: Gain 1 Strength. Your opponent can't see this page.

StratusphereLE.gac.name: Stratusphere
StratusphereLE.gac.text:
Trish Stratus Trademark

Counters high risk moves. Play only if you have hit 2 moves in a row or as a counter. Your opponent is Staggered and you get Crowd Support.
(Counts as "Hurricanrana".)

JustBarelyCover.gac.name: Just Barely Cover
JustBarelyCover.gac.text: Play only when in control and you have less Hit Points than your opponent, and only if your opponent is on the mat. Your opponent draws "Get a Shoulder Up" (if there are any in his playbook). You attempt a pin with a +20% pin bonus. If the pin fails you stay in control and get a +5% pin bonus for the rest of the match.

ChokeSlam2.gac.name: Choke Slam To Hell
ChokeSlam2.gac.text:
Only Kane may play Choke Slam To Hell.

Counters mad rush and in close moves. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.
(Counts as "Chokeslam".)

CornerCharge.gac.name: Corner Charge
CornerCharge.gac.text:
Play this move only if you have hit three moves in a row and only in the ring. Countered by Turnbuckle Smash. 

This move does +1 damage for each Strength, Strike and Agility momentum you have. If countered, you're stunned until the end of the next turn.

fields.Damage_Bonus:
(block 
     (sett Strike (WAGetValue #superstar Strike_Momentum))
     (sett Strength (WAGetValue #superstar Strength_Momentum))
     (sett Agility (WAGetValue #superstar Agility_Momentum))
     (sett SS (add Strength Strike))
     (sett SS (add SS Agility))
     (WASetValue #move Damage_Bonus (add (WAGetValue #move Damage_Bonus) SS))
)

ElbowToTheBackOfTheHead.gac.name: Elbow to Back of the Head
ElbowToTheBackOfTheHead.gac.text:
Counters head down moves.

Your opponent takes 2 Head damage. 50% chance opponent loses 1 additional Momentum.

NeckbreakerEX2.gac.name: Neckbreaker
NeckbreakerEX2.gac.text: Choose a page in your hand. If this move connects that page is ditched.

HookTheLegX8.gac.name: Hook The Leg
HookTheLegX8.gac.text:
Play only if you are in control and if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.
Draw a page and Pin your opponent. If this pin attempt does not work you remain in Control, and your move string is broken.

EverythingHurts.gac.name: Everything Hurts
EverythingHurts.gac.text: All of your Strike moves do +1 damage for each of your opponent's damaged body parts. You can only have one Everything Hurts in play.

BubbaRayDudley.gac.name: Bubba Ray Dudley
BubbaRayDudley.gac.text:
You do +1 damage with Takedown moves.
Special: "Those Damn Dudleyz!"
Choose an Event or Unique page from your playbook. You draw that page. Use this ability twice per match.

SwandiveHeadbutt2E.gac.name: Swandive Headbutt
SwandiveHeadbutt2E.gac.text:
Chris Benoit Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat.
Your opponent stays on the mat and takes 2 to 8 arm and head damage. Your opponent's Specials in hand are buried.

ChokeLift.gac.name: Choke Lift
ChokeLift.gac.text:
Your opponent can't submit to this move.

Each turn this hold is applied you get 1 Warning and your opponent takes damage equal to your Strength.

TheSideEffect.gac.name: The Side Effect
TheSideEffect.gac.text:
Matt Hardy Trademark

Big Superstars can Autocounter this move for -3 pages, but take +8 damage from this move.

You draw a page.

TheHurricane.gac.name: The Hurricane
TheHurricane.gac.text:
Special: Super Powers

Choose a Move in your opponent's hand. You steal it and gain enough momentum to play it until end of turn (even breaking your limits). Use once per match, after turn 5.

DropOntoTheBarricade.gac.name: Drop Onto The Barricade
DropOntoTheBarricade.gac.text:
Play only at Ringside. Your opponent is put on the mat and you draw Set Up A Table or Spanish Announce Table from your playbook (randomly chosen if you have both).

(Counts as "Snake Eyes")

PowerfulClothesline.gac.name: Lariat
PowerfulClothesline.gac.text: Counters hit or miss and mad rush moves. When you play this move, name a move type (not Defensive). If this connects, your opponent buries a move of the chosen move type and is put on the mat.

fields.List_Values: Name a Move Type|arm extended|back to foe|behind opponent|head down|high risk|hit or miss|in close|leg extended|mad rush|standing above|victim below

Strike1.gac.name: Strike
Strike1.gac.text: Gain 1 Strike. Your opponent can't see this page.

Pedigree.gac.name: Pedigree
Pedigree.gac.text:
Triple H Finisher

Counters head down moves. If your opponent has less than 40 pages left in his playbook, this move does +1 damage for each page less (up to +20.)

WallsOfJericho2E.gac.name: Walls Of Jericho
WallsOfJericho2E.gac.text:
Chris Jericho Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat.
Each turn, your opponent takes 7 back damage, plus 1 back damage for each Momentum type you have (excluding Attitude).

InjuredArm.gac.name: Injured Arm
InjuredArm.gac.text: Whenever you connect with an arm extended, in close or mad rush move, there is a 50% chance that you ditch a random page.

150PoundsOfToughness.gac.name: 150 Pounds Of Toughness
150PoundsOfToughness.gac.text:
Spike Dudley Trademark

Choose a move that costs 1 or less from your playbook; you draw that page.
You can't be stunned when your opponent is in control.

HeyRefThatWasThree.gac.name: That Was Three!
HeyRefThatWasThree.gac.text:
Play while being pinned, and can be played while Stunned. The pin fails and you gain control.
(Face page: cannot be played if you have played a Heel page.
Event: can only be played once per match, and only three Events total.)

JustBringItEX2.gac.name: Just Bring It!
JustBringItEX2.gac.text:
The Rock Trademark

On turn four, your opponent can't play Holds. At the end of turn four, if your opponent has control you get control. Otherwise, you draw a page.
(Superstars may only play one Entrance, and only on turn one or two.)

PowerBombEX2.gac.name: Power Bomb
PowerBombEX2.gac.text: This move can't be played unless you have at least as much Strength as your opponent.

ClotheslineFromHell.gac.name: Clothesline From Hell
ClotheslineFromHell.gac.text:
Bradshaw Finisher

Your opponent is put on the mat. This move does +4 damage for each pair of Strength and Strike you have (up to +20).

JackknifePowerbomb.gac.name: Jackknife Powerbomb
JackknifePowerbomb.gac.text:
Kevin Nash Finisher

This move does +1 damage for each Strength move you have connected with more than your opponent. The first time you connect with this move, it stuns your opponent until the end of the next turn.

DoubleLegTakedownEX2.gac.name: Double Leg Takedown
DoubleLegTakedownEX2.gac.text: Counters arm extended and victim below moves.

LitasMoonsaultTourn.gac.name: Lita's Moonsault
LitasMoonsaultTourn.gac.text:
Lita Finisher

Play only while your opponent is on the mat in the ring. If your opponent is not stunned and you have more Attitude, this move does +5 damage and stuns your opponent until the end of the next turn.

(Counts as "Moonsault.")

ClotheslineOverTheRopes2E.gac.name: Clothesline Over The Ropes
ClotheslineOverTheRopes2E.gac.text:
Play this move only if both you and your opponent are in the ring. Countered by Back Body Drop To Ringside.

This move does up to +7 damage. Your opponent is moved to ringside.

LouTheszPressEX1.gac.name: Lou Thesz Press
LouTheszPressEX1.gac.text:
Stone Cold Trademark

Counters mad rush moves. If you have no Warnings, gain +1 Attitude. If you played a Damage Special this turn, Drop The Hammer is drawn from your playbook.

DDT.gac.name: DDT
DDT.gac.text:
Counters head down moves.

Your opponent's next 3 pages from playbook are ditched.

LeadPipe.gac.name: Lead Pipe
LeadPipe.gac.text: Special: The player in control does a "Lead Pipe Shot" as their move for the turn.

BrassKnuckles.gac.name: Brass Knuckles
BrassKnuckles.gac.text:
William Regal Trademark.
Your next move with the word "Punch", "Punches" or "Barrage" in the title does +7 damage, stuns your opponent until the end of the next turn, and if you're in control gives you up to 9 Warnings. If countered, Brass Knuckles is played on your opponent's side.

MountedPunches.gac.name: Mounted Punches
MountedPunches.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Each turn this Hold is applied, your opponent takes 1 damage for each Strike you have. This Hold can only be kept applied for 3 turns.

ShowstopperChokeslamTourn.gac.name: Showstopper Chokeslam
ShowstopperChokeslamTourn.gac.text:
Big Show Finisher

Does +10 damage if you have more Momentum than your opponent (not including Attitude). If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn.

(Counts as "Chokeslam".)

fields.Damage_Bonus:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett You (WAGetPlayedBy #this))
          (sett Opponent (WAGetOpponent You))
          (sett OppTotal (WAGetTotalMomentum Opponent))
          (sett OppAttitude (WAGetValue Opponent Generic_Momentum))
          (sett OppAbility (subtract OppTotal OppAttitude))
          (sett YourTotal (WAGetTotalMomentum You))
          (sett YourAttitude (WAGetValue You Generic_Momentum))
          (sett YourAbility (subtract YourTotal YourAttitude))
          (if ((greater YourAbility OppAbility)
               (sett Bonus 10)
              )
              (True
               (sett Bonus 0)
              )
          )
          (WASetValue #this Damage_Bonus (add (WAGetValue #this Damage_Bonus) Bonus))
     )
    )
)

DropTheHammer.gac.name: Drop The Hammer
DropTheHammer.gac.text:
Stone Cold Trademark

Play only when your opponent is on the mat in the ring. If you connected with Lou Thesz Press last turn, gain +1 Attitude. If you have any Warnings, this move does +5 damage.

Spineroonie.gac.name: Spinaroonie
Spineroonie.gac.text:
Booker T Trademark

Play only when your opponent is on the mat or stunned. Your opponent gets 3 Crowd Supports but ditches all Specials from hand at the end of the turn. You get 5 Attitude.

This page counts as 2 pages when you choose to ditch it.

fields.Page_Played:
(if ((eq #page #this)
     (block 
          (WAMessage -1 "Jim Ross: Oh God, not the 'Spinaroonie'...")
          (WAMessage -1 "Lawler: He's feeling it, Ross!")
          (WASetValue (WAGameMap) PlayedSpineroonie 1)
          (WASetValue 
               (WAGameMap)
               EventsPlayed
               (add 1
                    (WAGetValue (WAGameMap) EventsPlayed)
               )
          )
          (WASetValue #initiator Generic_Momentum (add 5 (WAGetValue #initiator Generic_Momentum)))
          (WAPutIntoHand #target (WACreatePageByUNID #target 227))
          (WAPutIntoHand #target (WACreatePageByUNID #target 227))
          (WAPutIntoHand #target (WACreatePageByUNID #target 227))
     )
    )
)

Superkick.gac.name: Thrust Kick
Superkick.gac.text:
To play, you must choose and ditch a page in hand.

Your opponent is put on the mat and Staggered, and you gain +2 Attitude.

HeadlockEX1.gac.name: Headlock
HeadlockEX1.gac.text:
Counters in close moves. Your opponent cannot submit to this move.

Each turn, If your opponent has 0 Attitude, a random Special from his hand is ditched. Otherwise, your opponent loses 1 Attitude.

RicFlairsChop.gac.name: Ric Flair's Chop
RicFlairsChop.gac.text:
Ric Flair Trademark

Choose a cost range (1-4, 5-8, 9-12). The next two pages in your opponent's playbook with that cost range are buried. Your opponent is put on the mat.

NewWorldOrder.gac.name: 4-Life
NewWorldOrder.gac.text:
nWo Trademark

When your opponent has 0 Attitude your non-Defensive moves do +2 damage.

RobVanDam.gac.name: Rob Van Dam
RobVanDam.gac.text:
Special: R-V-D
Use once per match after turn 10, while in control, and before you play a move. Draw 1 page and gain 1 Attitude for each move in a row you've connected with. You can't play more pages this turn.

SnapMareEX3.gac.name: Snap Mare
SnapMareEX3.gac.text: You get +1 Attitude. If your opponent has at least 2 Agility, he loses 1.

DropToeHold.gac.name: Drop Toe Hold
DropToeHold.gac.text:
Counters mad rush and hit or miss moves. Countered by standing above moves.
When played, you are put on the mat. This move may only be played offensively if you have played Irish Whip. If so, and this move connects and you have any Technical, your opponent ditches 4 pages from playbook.

KneeDropToTheFace.gac.name: Knee Drop To The Face
KneeDropToTheFace.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

One of your opponent's Gameplans in play are ditched. If there aren't any, gain +1 Attitude.

BigandNasty.gac.name: Big and Nasty
BigandNasty.gac.text:
Big Show Trademark

Your Strength moves do +2 damage. Your Strike moves that cost 4 or more have a 33% chance of stunning your opponent until the end of next turn. This page leaves play if you are hit with 3 moves in a row. You can only have one Big and Nasty in play.

TurnbuckleSmashEX3.gac.name: Turnbuckle Smash
TurnbuckleSmashEX3.gac.text:
Play only in the ring.

Strike Combo: Your opponent is Staggered.

UseTheRopesForLeverage.gac.name: Grab Ropes For Leverage
UseTheRopesForLeverage.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring and you are in control.

Draw a page and pin your opponent. Your opponent may not play special pages this turn.

Agility2E.gac.name: Agility
Agility2E.gac.text: Gain 1 Agility. Your opponent can't see this page.

TajiriLE.gac.name: Tajiri
TajiriLE.gac.text: Tajiri's Strike moves do +4 damage if you connected with a non-Strike move last turn.

StrongClothesline.gac.name: Strong Clothesline
StrongClothesline.gac.text:
Big Superstars Trademark

Counters mad rush moves. Your opponent is put on the mat. If you played Irish Whip with this move, you draw a page.

(Counts as "Clothesline.")

Break.gac.name: Break!
Break.gac.text:
Play if you have hit with two moves in a row, and only if you have not played a move this turn.

Gain 1 Attitude and draw two pages. Your opponent gets control.

BackBodyDropToRingside2E.gac.name: Back Body Drop to Ringside
BackBodyDropToRingside2E.gac.text:
Play only in the ring. Counters victim below moves.

Your opponent is moved to ringside. There is a 33% chance your opponent ditches the next page from his playbook.

O.gac.name: O
O.gac.text:
Scotty 2 Hotty Trademark

Your Technical moves do +1 damage for each WORM special you have in play, and ditch an additional page from the opponent's playbook. You may play another special page after you play this (on the same turn). You can only have one O in play.

AheadOfTheGame.gac.name: Ahead of The Game
AheadOfTheGame.gac.text:
Draw a page.

At the beginning of each turn, you are told how many pages are remaining in your and your opponent's playbooks. This page is removed from play when you are Stunned. You can only have one Ahead of The Game in play. If you ditch this page it counts as 2 pages.

fields.Begin_Move:
(block 
     (sett Superstar (WAGetPlayedBy #this))
     (sett Opponent (WAGetOpponent Superstar))
     (sett Player (WAGetOwner Superstar))
     (WAMessage Player "You have" (count (WAGetPlaybook Superstar)) "pages remaining in playbook.")
     (WAMessage Player "Your opponent has" (count (WAGetPlaybook Opponent)) "pages remaining in playbook.")
)

SlingshotPlancha.gac.name: Slingshot Plancha
SlingshotPlancha.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is at Ringside and you are in the Ring. When you play Slingshot Plancha, you go to Ringside.

If you have more pages left in your playbook than your opponent, draw two pages and gain two Momentum. If countered, you're stunned for the rest of the turn.

KevinNashEX3.gac.name: Kevin Nash
KevinNashEX3.gac.text:
nWo Superstar

Kevin Nash starts the match with 6 leg damage.

Your moves that cost 7 or more do +3 damage.

BellyToBellyToRingside.gac.name: Belly-to-Belly To Ringside
BellyToBellyToRingside.gac.text: Play only in the ring. Your opponent is moved to Ringside and has a 20% chance of being stunned until the end of next turn.

HeadScissors.gac.name: Head Scissors
HeadScissors.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Choose one: momentum, move or special. Each turn this move does 4 head damage and a random page in your playbook of that type is pushed.

RefBump.gac.name: Ref Bump
RefBump.gac.text: Play only if not in control and your opponent is playing a move that isn't a Hold. Counter that move and gain control. The referee is distracted for 4 to 10 turns (any Referee in play is ditched). Afterwards, you receive 1 to 7 Warnings or your opponent receives 1 to 4 Warnings. (This Event ends if a Referee is played.)

OneArmBulldog.gac.name: One Arm Bulldog
OneArmBulldog.gac.text:
Chris Jericho Trademark

Play only in the ring. A random high risk move is drawn from your playbook.

DuckTourn.gac.name: Duck
DuckTourn.gac.text:
This move can't be played offensively.

Counters arm extended and leg extended moves. Countered by behind opponent and mad rush moves. This move provides no Attitude.

OnceTooOften2E.gac.name: Once Too Often
OnceTooOften2E.gac.text: Counter your opponent's move. Use only if your opponent has already connected with that move this match, and only if you are not in control and not in a submission Hold. You may use this page even if you are stunned.

InjuredBack.gac.name: Injured Back
InjuredBack.gac.text: Whenever you connect with an in close, back to foe or victim below move, there is a 50% chance that you ditch a random page.

WilliamRegal.gac.name: William Regal
WilliamRegal.gac.text:
Special: "Besmirched"

Once per game, choose "Distract the Referee" or "Plead to the Ref" and that page is played.
(The play restrictions of those pages are ignored.)

TheBigShowEX1.gac.name: The Big Show
TheBigShowEX1.gac.text: The first 3 times you Autocounter without playing a Special that turn, you draw 3 pages.

ArmDragTakedownEX3.gac.name: Arm Drag Takedown
ArmDragTakedownEX3.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

Your opponent's next three pages are revealed to you. Choose one; the others are ditched.

SlowAndMethodical.gac.name: Working Stiff
SlowAndMethodical.gac.text: Each of your Strike moves get a random bonus of +1 to +4 damage, but not more than the base damage of the move. This page leaves play when you are Stunned. You can only have one Working Stiff in play.

WhipIntoSteelSteps.gac.name: Whip Into Steel Steps
WhipIntoSteelSteps.gac.text:
Play this move only when both you and your opponent are at Ringside.

Your opponent ditches two random pages and is put on the mat. You gain +1 Attitude.

SideBackBreaker.gac.name: Side Back Breaker
SideBackBreaker.gac.text:
Counters in close moves.

This move does 3 Back damage.

TargetTheArm.gac.name: Target The Arm
TargetTheArm.gac.text:
When you connect with a Strike move while in control, your opponent takes 1 Arm damage. When you connect with a Technical Hold that does Arm damage, your opponent ditches a random arm extended or in close move from hand.
You may only have one Target The Arm in play.

Knowledge2E.gac.name: Knowledge
Knowledge2E.gac.text: Gain 1 Knowledge. Your opponent can't see this page.

LookUnderTheRing.gac.name: Look Under The Ring
LookUnderTheRing.gac.text:
Play only in a Hardcore match, and only at Ringside. Draw two pages.

From 1 to 5 different random Weapon Specials are put into play. Each one has an equal chance of going on either side of the ring.

SwantonBombEX2.gac.name: Swanton Bomb
SwantonBombEX2.gac.text:
Jeff Hardy Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.

You attempt to pin your opponent with a +2% pin bonus for each turn that has passed in the match.

JeffHardy.gac.name: Jeff Hardy
JeffHardy.gac.text:
Member of Team Xtreme

Jeff Hardy can Autocounter for -1 page.

When Jeff Hardy plays a Drop move you draw a page.

ChokeslamToHellTourn.gac.name: Choke Slam To Hell
ChokeslamToHellTourn.gac.text:
Kane Finisher

Counters mad rush and in close moves. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

(Counts as "Chokeslam".)

CatchHimStunned2E.gac.name: Catch Him Stunned
CatchHimStunned2E.gac.text:
Play only if you are in control and your opponent is stunned.

Your opponent ditches three random pages and you attempt a pin.

Title-LH.gac.name: WWE With Authority! Light Heavyweight Champion
Title-LH.gac.text: Each Superstar draws a page for each Agility Momentum they have. This page counts for 4 pages when you choose to ditch it.

StoneColdStunnerEX1.gac.name: Stone Cold Stunner
StoneColdStunnerEX1.gac.text:
Stone Cold Finisher

Counters behind opponent moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat. This move does +1 damage for each Attitude or Warning you have (whichever is greater, up to +12).  If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

ThrustUppercut.gac.name: Thrust Uppercut
ThrustUppercut.gac.text: Counters head down moves. If this move connects and wasn't used as a counter, either Clothesline, Strong Clothesline or Drop Kick To The Floor (randomly chosen) is drawn from your playbook.

CornerCharge2E.gac.name: Corner Charge
CornerCharge2E.gac.text:
Play this move only if you have hit three moves in a row and only in the ring. Countered by Turnbuckle Smash.

This move does +1 damage for each Strength, Strike and Agility momentum you have. If countered, you are stunned until the end of the next turn.

fields.Damage_Bonus:
(block 
     (sett Strike (WAGetValue #superstar Strike_Momentum))
     (sett Strength (WAGetValue #superstar Strength_Momentum))
     (sett Agility (WAGetValue #superstar Agility_Momentum))
     (sett SS (add Strength Strike))
     (sett SS (add SS Agility))
     (WASetValue #move Damage_Bonus (add (WAGetValue #move Damage_Bonus) SS))
)

OffTheTopOfTheCage.gac.name: Off The Top Of The Cage
OffTheTopOfTheCage.gac.text: Play only if your opponent is on the mat during a Steel Cage match, and only with a high risk or hit or miss move that isn't a Finisher. That move can't be countered by moves and does +15 damage. If Autocountered, you are stunned for two turns and your opponent ditches 5 random pages.

LayingTheSmackDown2E.gac.name: Laying The Smack Down!
LayingTheSmackDown2E.gac.text:
The Rock Trademark

Play only in the ring and only if you haven't already connected with it this match. Your opponent either moves to ringside or is put on the mat (randomly chosen). You draw 3 pages and gain +2 Attitude, and your opponent ditches two random Strike moves from hand.

FlyingElbowDropSS2002.gac.name: Flying Elbow Drop
FlyingElbowDropSS2002.gac.text:
Shawn Michaels Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. You draw a page. The first time you connect with this move your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

RakeOnTheRopes.gac.name: Rake On The Ropes
RakeOnTheRopes.gac.text:
Play only in the ring.

Choose a move type (other than defensive). A random move in your opponent's hand that matches that move type is buried. You get 1 Warning.

fields.List_Values: Name a Move Type|arm extended|back to foe|behind opponent|head down|high risk|hit or miss|in close|leg extended|mad rush|standing above|victim below

AheadOfTheGame2E.gac.name: Ahead of The Game
AheadOfTheGame2E.gac.text:
Willpower 2 (This page counts as two pages for Autocountering.)
Draw a page. At the beginning of each turn, you are told how many pages are remaining in your and your opponent's playbooks. If you are stunned, this page leaves play.
You can only have one Ahead of The Game in play.

fields.Begin_Move:
(block 
     (sett Superstar (WAGetPlayedBy #this))
     (sett Opponent (WAGetOpponent Superstar))
     (sett Player (WAGetOwner Superstar))
     (WAMessage Player "You have" (count (WAGetPlaybook Superstar)) "pages remaining in playbook.")
     (WAMessage Player "Your opponent has" (count (WAGetPlaybook Opponent)) "pages remaining in playbook.")
)

AtomicDropEX1.gac.name: Inverted Atomic Drop
AtomicDropEX1.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

Choose one: Clothesline is drawn from your playbook or you gain +1 Attitude.

ChrisJericho.gac.name: Chris Jericho
ChrisJericho.gac.text:
Special: Jerichoholics
Lose 1 Attitude and choose a Momentum from your playbook. That page is drawn. Use this ability three times per match and only if you have at least 1 Attitude.

FrontFacelock2E.gac.name: Front Facelock
FrontFacelock2E.gac.text:
Counters head down moves. Countered by Northern Lights Suplex.

This move does 1 Head damage each turn, but can't cause submissions. When this move connects, and when you keep it applied, there is a 50% chance you draw Technical from your playbook.

WraparoundNeckbreakerEX1.gac.name: Wraparound Neckbreaker
WraparoundNeckbreakerEX1.gac.text:
William Regal Trademark

Counters arm extended moves.
Choose one: This move does 5 Arm and 5 Head damage, or you draw a random Special from your playbook.

fields.List_Values: Choose One:|Arm and Head damage|Draw a random Special

ToughGuy.gac.name: Tough Guy
ToughGuy.gac.text:
Play only if you don't have Tough Guy in play. The next time you would be Stunned, this page is removed from play instead.
You may play this page if you are stunned. If you do, you are no longer stunned and this remains in play.

HalfBostonCrab.gac.name: Half Boston Crab
HalfBostonCrab.gac.text:
Play only when your opponent is on the mat.
This move does 5 back damage, +5 for each turn this has been applied. This move may be Autocountered for -1 pages for each turn it has been applied.

Neckbreaker2E.gac.name: Neckbreaker
Neckbreaker2E.gac.text: If your opponent has no head damage you gain +1 Attitude. Otherwise, there is a 33% chance you draw a page.

EverythingHurts2E.gac.name: Everything Hurts
EverythingHurts2E.gac.text: All of your Strike moves do +1 damage for each of your opponent's damaged body parts. You can only have one Everything Hurts in play.

InsideCrescentKick.gac.name: Inside Crescent Kick
InsideCrescentKick.gac.text:
Play only if your Agility limit is 2 or more.

Strike Combo: Your opponent is Staggered.

MattHardy.gac.name: Matt Hardy
MattHardy.gac.text:
Member of Team Xtreme

Not including the first two moves in each move string, Matt Hardy gets Crowd Support when your opponent hits you with a move.

2ndRopeLegDrop2E.gac.name: 2nd Rope Leg Drop
2ndRopeLegDrop2E.gac.text: Play only if your opponent is on the mat and in the ring. He stays on the mat, and if not already stunned, is stunned until the end of the next turn. You get +1 Attitude. If countered, you are stunned until the end of the turn.

Overcast.gac.name: Overcast
Overcast.gac.text:
Hurricane Trademark

Play only in the ring. Choose an Action special in your playbook or opponent's hand. That page is moved to your hand.

HesCallingForIt2E.gac.name: He's Calling For It!
HesCallingForIt2E.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit three or more moves in a row, and only with a move you haven't connected with this match.

Your opponent can't play moves this turn.

SkinTheCat.gac.name: Skin The Cat
SkinTheCat.gac.text: Play only when in control, and only if you don't have Skin The Cat in play. Draw a page. If you are at ringside at the end of the turn, you move back into the ring and this page is ditched from play. (Hidden pages aren't seen by your opponent.)

Grounded.gac.name: Grounded
Grounded.gac.text:
This Superstar cannot play any Agility moves or momentum for five turns.

(Each Superstar may only have one copy of each Status in play.)

ScissorsKick.gac.name: Scissors Kick
ScissorsKick.gac.text:
Booker T Finisher

Play only in the ring. Countered by Dodge, not by Shove.

Your opponent is put on the mat. This move does +2 damage (up to +12) for each special that was in your hand and your opponent's hand when you played this move.

TheUndertaker2E.gac.name: The Undertaker
TheUndertaker2E.gac.text:
Special: Over a Decade

All Superstars lose 1 Attitude and the turn limit is extended by a turn. Use 11 times per match and only if you have any Attitude.

MacTerminator.gac.name: MacTerminator
MacTerminator.gac.text:
Shane McMahon Finisher

Play only when your opponent is on the mat in the ring, and only once per match.
Your opponent's Knowledge, Technical and Agility are reduced to 1. (If they have 0 of a given Momentum, that number isn't changed.)

Sleeper.gac.name: Sleeper
Sleeper.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves. Countered by Back Suplex.

This move does 2 Head damage per turn. Each turn, if your opponent has 0 Attitude, a random move from his hand is ditched. Otherwise, your opponent loses 1 Attitude.

Title-IC.gac.name: WWE With Authority! Intercontinental Champion
Title-IC.gac.text:
Play only while not in control. Choose one of the following abilities.

FACE: Draw 2 pages.

HEEL: Autocounter any move. You get 6 Warnings.

FlipOverCover.gac.name: Flip-Over Cover
FlipOverCover.gac.text:
Counters head down and victim below moves. 

If you have Knowledge, draw a page. You attempt to pin your opponent. If the pin fails you remain in control.

ClimbOutOfTheCage.gac.name: Climb Out Of The Cage
ClimbOutOfTheCage.gac.text:
Play only in a Steel Cage match. Counters "Climb Out Of The Cage."

If not used as a counter, this move costs +8 Momentum and if not countered, you win the match.
If this move is countered, a copy of it is shuffled into your playbook.

TreeOfWoe.gac.name: Tree Of Woe
TreeOfWoe.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.

If your move this turn is an Impact mad rush move, it does +7 damage and stuns your opponent until the end of the next turn.

Intelligence.gac.name: Intelligence
Intelligence.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Trademark

When you play a Knowledge momentum page, if your next page in your Playbook is a Special page, you draw it. Intelligence leaves play if you're hit with a move that does 7 damage or more. You can only have one Intelligence in play.

ElbowToTheBackOfTheHeadEX2.gac.name: Elbow to Back of the Head
ElbowToTheBackOfTheHeadEX2.gac.text: Counters head down moves. Can't be countered by Strength moves.

Velocity.gac.name: Velocity
Velocity.gac.text:
Play only after turn 10 and only twice per match.

Gain 3 Attitude. Your opponent draws a page.

Willpower 0

HookTheLegEX2.gac.name: Hook The Leg
HookTheLegEX2.gac.text: Play only if you are in control and if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. You attempt to pin your opponent. If you have attempted more pins than your opponent, the attempt gets a +15% pin chance bonus.

SweetChinMusic.gac.name: Sweet Chin Music
SweetChinMusic.gac.text:
Shawn Michaels Finisher

Your opponent is put on the mat. For every three pages left in your opponent's playbook, this move does +1 damage (up to +20). If your playbook is empty, this move does another +10 damage.

(Counts as "Thrust Kick".)

Leapfrog.gac.name: Leapfrog
Leapfrog.gac.text:
Play only in the ring. Counters mad rush moves. Countered by Punch and Power Slam. Can only be used offensively if played with Irish Whip. 
"Leapfrogged" is put into your hand.

Bulldog2E.gac.name: Bulldog
Bulldog2E.gac.text: Your opponent's next four pages from playbook are ditched.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

TombstonePiledriver.gac.name: Tombstone Piledriver
TombstonePiledriver.gac.text:
This move may only be played by Kane and may not be Autocountered.
Countered by Tombstone Piledriver.
This move does +1 damage for each Strength and Strike Momentum you have.

fields.Damage_Bonus:
(block 
     (sett Strike (WAGetValue #superstar Strike_Momentum))
     (sett Strength (WAGetValue #superstar Strength_Momentum))
     (sett SS (add Strength Strike))
     (WASetValue #move Damage_Bonus (add (WAGetValue #move Damage_Bonus) SS))
)

NeckbreakerEX1.gac.name: Neckbreaker
NeckbreakerEX1.gac.text: If your opponent has no Head damage you gain +1 Attitude. Otherwise, there is a 33% chance you draw a page.

GoldenGlobes.gac.name: Golden Globes
GoldenGlobes.gac.text:
Goldust Trademark

Play only in the ring and only if you have hit two moves in a row. Your opponent is Grounded and Insulted.

LitasTwistofFate.gac.name: Lita's Twist of Fate
LitasTwistofFate.gac.text:
Lita Trademark

Choose a Face page in your playbook. You draw that page from your playbook.

AnglesMoonsault2E.gac.name: Angle's Moonsault
AnglesMoonsault2E.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring, and only if you haven't connected with this move. This can't be countered by moves if you have Intelligence in play. Your opponent ditches all Gameplan Specials from play and all Specials from hand.

LowBlowLegDropEX2.gac.name: Low Blow Leg Drop
LowBlowLegDropEX2.gac.text:
Jeff Hardy Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat.
You get 1 Warning and Crowd Support. This move does +2 damage for each momentum your opponent has more than you.

AnglesMoonsault.gac.name: Angle's Moonsault
AnglesMoonsault.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring, and only if you haven't connected with this move. This can't be countered by moves if you have Intelligence in play. Your opponent ditches all Gameplan Specials from play and all Specials from hand.

BreakTheWallsDown.gac.name: Break The Walls Down
BreakTheWallsDown.gac.text:
Chris Jericho Trademark
Name a defensive move in your playbook.  If your opponent has no Agility limit, draw it. Otherwise, your first high risk move you do when you have 17 Momentum can't be countered by moves. (You may only play one Entrance, and only on turn one or two.)

FacePlant.gac.name: Face Plant
FacePlant.gac.text:
Edge Trademark

If you have 5 Attitude, draw two pages.

TheShowstopper.gac.name: The Showstopper!
TheShowstopper.gac.text:
Shawn Michaels Trademark

If you receive a Status, this page leaves play.

At the end of each turn, if you have "Crowd Support" in hand it is ditched and you draw a page.

StrengthEX2.gac.name: Strength
StrengthEX2.gac.text: Gain 1 Strength. Your opponent can't see this page.

AnglesAnkleLockTourn.gac.name: Angle's Ankle Lock
AnglesAnkleLockTourn.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Finisher

Play only when your opponent is on the mat. 

This move does 10 Leg damage per turn, or 14 Leg damage if you have Intensity in play.

3D.gac.name: Christmas Chaos
3D.gac.text:
Play only during the month of December, 2002.

Draw a page. Then, both players ditch 4 pages, draw 4 pages and take 4 damage.

fields.Page_Played:
(if ((eq #page #this)
     (block 
          (WASetValue (WAGameMap) PlayedChristmasChaos 1)
          (WASetValue 
               (WAGameMap)
               EventsPlayed
               (add 1
                    (WAGetValue (WAGameMap) EventsPlayed)
               )
          )
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (enum (WAGetPlayers) Playa
                (block 
                     (sett SS (WAGetActiveSuperstar Playa))
                     (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount SS) 0))
                     (sett NumDitched 0)
                     (loop (not Done)
                           (block 
                                (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount SS)))
                                (sett Card (item (WAGetHand SS) Ditch))
                                (WAMessage Playa (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
                                (WADitchPage SS (subtract Ditch 1))
                                (sett NumDitched (add NumDitched 1))
                                (if ((eq NumDitched 4)
                                     (sett Done True)
                                    )
                                    (True
                                     (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount SS) 0))
                                    )
                                )
                           )
                     )
                     (WADrawPage SS)
                     (WADrawPage SS)
                     (WADrawPage SS)
                     (WADrawPage SS)
                     (WADamage SS 4)
                )
          )
     )
    )
)

VerticalSuplexEX2.gac.name: Vertical Suplex
VerticalSuplexEX2.gac.text:
If your opponent has less than 2 Strength, this move does +4 damage.
If both you and your opponent have 4 or more Strength, this move does +7 damage.

DropKickOverTheRopes.gac.name: Drop Kick To The Floor
DropKickOverTheRopes.gac.text:
Play this move only if both you and your opponent are in the ring. 

Your opponent ditches a random page and is moved to Ringside. If countered, you lose up to an additional 2 Momentum.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WAMove #target (WAFindLocation '$Ringside))
          (WAMessage -1 "Jim Ross: A nasty tumble there!")
          (sett Done (lesser (WAGetHandCount #target) 1))
          (sett NumDitched 0)
          (sett StopNum 1)
          (loop (not Done)
                (block 
                     (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount #target)))
                     (sett Card (item (WAGetHand #target) Ditch))
                     (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #target) (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
                     (WADitchPage #target (subtract Ditch 1))
                     (sett NumDitched (add NumDitched 1))
                     (if ((eq NumDitched StopNum)
                          (sett Done True)
                         )
                         (True
                          (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount #target) 0))
                         )
                     )
                )
          )
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)
fields.Move_Countered:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Momentum (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
          (sett MLoss (WARandom 0 2))
          (sett Momentum (subtract Momentum MLoss))
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum Momentum)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

CripplerCrossFace.gac.name: Crippler Cross Face
CripplerCrossFace.gac.text:
Chris Benoit Finisher

Counters arm extended and in close moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat. This move does 9 arm and 9 head damage per turn.

RingVeteran2E.gac.name: Ring Veteran
RingVeteran2E.gac.text: Draw four pages. Each player may play this twice per match.

fields.Page_Played:
(if ((eq #page #this)
     (block 
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (WADrawPage #initiator)
          (WASetValue #initiator PlayedRingVeteran (add (WAGetValue #initiator PlayedRingVeteran) 1))
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

WestCoastPopLE.gac.name: West Coast Pop
WestCoastPopLE.gac.text:
Rey Mysterio Finisher

Play only in the ring. This move does extra damage equal to the number of pages you have in your hand less than 15. You attempt a pin and remain in control if the pin fails.

(If you have 5 pages in hand, this move does +10 damage.)

SlingshotLegDrop.gac.name: Slingshot Leg Drop
SlingshotLegDrop.gac.text:
Play only if you are at ringside. You can play this even if your opponent is in the ring. When played, you move into the ring and your opponent is put on the mat (and also moved into the ring, if needed).

You get +2 Attitude and your opponent stays on the mat.

Edgecution2E.gac.name: Edgecution
Edgecution2E.gac.text:
Edge Finisher

Counters head down moves.
This move does +1 damage for each Attitude you have (up to +10). You attempt to pin your opponent with a +1% pin chance for each different Agility and Technical move you've connected with this match. If the pin fails, you stay in control.

WithAuthorityFutbol.gac.text:
(Counts as With Authority!)
This page was given to all the players of With Authority! Futbol on July 28th, 2001.

Play only while in Control. This move does +4 damage and may not be Autocountered.
(If used with a Hold, it can be Autocountered after the first turn it is applied.)

SplitLeggedMoonsault.gac.name: Split-Legged Moonsault
SplitLeggedMoonsault.gac.text:
Rob Van Dam Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. You get +3 Attitude.

Title-Euro.gac.name: WWE With Authority! European Champion
Title-Euro.gac.text: You are told the contents of your opponent's hand, and draw a page. This page counts as 4 pages when you choose to ditch it.

fields.Page_Played:
(if ((eq #page #this)
     (block 
          (sett Victim #target)
          (sett Thug (WAGetPlayedBy #this))
          (sett NumStolen 0)
          (sett TheHand (WAGetHand Victim))
          (sett HandIndex (count TheHand))
          (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #initiator) "Your opponent has" HandIndex "pages in hand.")
          (loop (greater HandIndex 0)
                (block 
                     (sett MBC (item TheHand HandIndex))
                     (sett HandIndex (subtract HandIndex 1))
                     (sett PageInHand (WAGetName MBC))
                     (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #initiator) "Page in opponent's hand:" PageInHand)
                     (sett NumStolen (add NumStolen 1))
                )
          )
          (sett DrawnPage (WADrawPage #initiator))
          (if ((eq DrawnPage 0)
               (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #this) "Lawler: You are out of pages in your playbook!")
              )
              (True
               (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #this) "You drew" (cat (WAGetName DrawnPage) "."))
              )
          )
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

FistDrop2E.gac.name: Fist Drop
FistDrop2E.gac.text: Play this move only if your opponent is on the mat. If countered you lose up to an additional 2 Attitude.

fields.Move_Countered:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Momentum (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
          (sett MLoss (WARandom 0 2))
          (sett Momentum (subtract Momentum MLoss))
          (WASetValue #target Generic_Momentum Momentum)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

FiremansCarryEX2.gac.name: Fireman's Carry
FiremansCarryEX2.gac.text:
Counters arm extended and leg extended moves.

Your opponent loses 1 Attitude.

ShiningWizardKick.gac.name: Shining Wizard
ShiningWizardKick.gac.text:
Play only if you have an Agility limit of 2 or more and if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent stays on the mat. If played by The Hurricane, you steal your opponent's most expensive move from hand. Otherwise, you draw a page.

Ambush.gac.name: Ambush
Ambush.gac.text: If your opponent has a Face Entrance in play or in hand and it isn't a Trademark, he takes 10 damage. Otherwise, you draw a page and also draw a random Heel page from your playbook.

FigureFourEdgeLock.gac.name: Edge-cator
FigureFourEdgeLock.gac.text:
Edge Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

This move does 9 leg damage per turn, +1 leg damage (up to +5) for each Attitude you have.

SunsetFlip.gac.name: Sunset Flip
SunsetFlip.gac.text: Counters head down moves. Countered by standing above moves. You are put on the mat when you play this. Your opponent is put on the mat and you attempt a pin. If the pin fails, you remain in control and draw a page.

SuplexFromTheLadder.gac.name: Suplex From The Ladder
SuplexFromTheLadder.gac.text:
Play only if a Ladder is in play. Counters Climb The Ladder.

You get 5 Warnings and a +5% climb chance. If used as a counter without a Damage special, this move can't be countered.

LeadPipeShot.gac.name: Lead Pipe Shot
LeadPipeShot.gac.text: Your opponent is put on the mat and is Busted Wide Open. You get 7 Warnings and Lead Pipe is ditched from play.

MidnightSuplex.gac.name: Tiger Suplex
MidnightSuplex.gac.text: This move pins your opponent with +1% pin chance for each Head damage your opponent has.

Integrity.gac.name: Integrity
Integrity.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Trademark

Play only if you have hit 3 moves in a row. Your opponent may not play Special pages from hand. This leaves play when you are Stunned, you play a Special page or you get a Warning. You can only have one Integrity in play.

FiveStarFrogSplashEX2.gac.name: Five-Star Frog Splash
FiveStarFrogSplashEX2.gac.text:
Rob Van Dam Finisher

Play only when your opponent is on the mat in the ring. Choose a number from 0 to 15. You take that much damage, and this move does that much extra damage.

CrimsonMask.gac.name: Crimson Mask
CrimsonMask.gac.text:
Play when your opponent plays an Impact move and you don't have Crimson Mask in play. If you are Busted Wide Open, gain 2 Attitude and draw two pages. Otherwise, you become Busted Wide Open.

Your moves do +1 damage for the next four turns.

LeapingFrontKick.gac.name: Leaping Front Kick
LeapingFrontKick.gac.text:
Strike Combo: This move does +3 damage.
Leg Extended Combo: Gain +2 Attitude.

(If you just hit with a leg extended move that is Strike, you get both Combos.)

SpineroonieEX2.gac.name: Spinaroonie
SpineroonieEX2.gac.text:
Booker T Trademark

Play only when your opponent is on the mat or stunned. Your opponent gets 3 Crowd Supports but ditches all Specials from hand at the end of the turn. You get 5 Attitude.

This page counts as 2 pages when you choose to ditch it.

fields.Page_Played:
(if ((eq #page #this)
     (block 
          (WAMessage -1 "Jim Ross: Oh God, not the 'Spinaroonie'...")
          (WAMessage -1 "Lawler: He's feeling it, Ross!")
          (WASetValue (WAGameMap) PlayedSpineroonie 1)
          (WASetValue 
               (WAGameMap)
               EventsPlayed
               (add 1
                    (WAGetValue (WAGameMap) EventsPlayed)
               )
          )
          (WASetValue #initiator Generic_Momentum (add 5 (WAGetValue #initiator Generic_Momentum)))
          (WAPutIntoHand #target (WACreatePageByUNID #target 227))
          (WAPutIntoHand #target (WACreatePageByUNID #target 227))
          (WAPutIntoHand #target (WACreatePageByUNID #target 227))
     )
    )
)

InterviewWithMichaelCole.gac.name: Interview With Michael Cole
InterviewWithMichaelCole.gac.text:
Draw a page. Name a Momentum type (including Attitude). At the end of turns 15 and 20 both Superstars gain 1 of that type (not exceeding Momentum limits).

(Superstars may only play one Entrance, and only on turn one or two.)

NoHandsPlancha.gac.name: No Hands Plancha
NoHandsPlancha.gac.text: Play only if your opponent is at Ringside. You move to Ringside when this move is played. If you haven't connected with a high risk move this match, this move can't be countered.
