GarbageCanLidShot.gac.name: Garbage Can Lid Shot
GarbageCanLidShot.gac.text: Play only in a Hardcore match. Your opponent is put on the mat and loses 1 Technical. If he then has 0 Technical, you draw a page. This move does +4 damage if any Superstar connected with "Garbage Can Shot" this match.

PaulHeyman.gac.name: Paul Heyman
PaulHeyman.gac.text:
Gain 1 Knowledge. If this page leaves play, you lose 1 Knowledge.
Special: Counter your opponent's move. Your opponent draws two pages and this page is ditched from play. You can use this ability even while stunned. Only Brock Lesnar can use this ability.

HipToss.gac.name: Hip Toss
HipToss.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves. Countered by Hip Toss. 

Your opponent's next 2 pages from playbook are ditched.

ChairToTheBack2E.gac.name: Chair To The Back
ChairToTheBack2E.gac.text:
Play only if Steel Folding Chair is in play.

You get 4 Warnings from the referee. This move does 2 Back damage and an additional 3 Back damage for each Strike Momentum you have.

fields.Damage_Bonus:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Strike (WAGetValue #superstar Strike_Momentum))
          (sett SubDamage (WAGetValue #move Submission_Damage_Bonus))
          (sett SubDamage (add SubDamage (multiply Strike 3)))
          (WASetValue #move Submission_Damage_Bonus SubDamage)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

ChairToTheBackEX2.gac.name: Chair To The Back
ChairToTheBackEX2.gac.text:
Steel Folding Chair must be in play to play this move.

Your opponent both ditches a page from hand and draws a page for each two back damage he has. You get 3 Warnings.

TombstonePiledriver2E.gac.name: Tombstone Piledriver
TombstonePiledriver2E.gac.text:
Kane Finisher

Counters Tombstone Piledriver.

This move does +1 damage for each Strength and Strike Momentum you have.

fields.Damage_Bonus:
(block 
     (sett Strike (WAGetValue #superstar Strike_Momentum))
     (sett Strength (WAGetValue #superstar Strength_Momentum))
     (sett SS (add Strength Strike))
     (WASetValue #move Damage_Bonus (add (WAGetValue #move Damage_Bonus) SS))
)

FallawaySlam.gac.name: Fallaway Slam
FallawaySlam.gac.text:
This move can only be used as a counter if you have 4 Strength, and only counters hit or miss moves that aren't Drop moves.
This move does +1 damage for each Agility your opponent has.

HogansLegDrop2ELE.gac.name: Hogan's Leg Drop
HogansLegDrop2ELE.gac.text:
Hulk Hogan Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat. If you have 7 Knowledge and you haven't yet connected with this move this match, this move can't be countered.
(Counts as "Leg Drop")

WithAuthoritySummercon2002.gac.text: You choose a condition. Your opponent is told of your choice. The player who best meets this condition at the end of turn 25 draws three pages. (If tied, both players draw three pages. Counts as "With Authority!")

WillToWinEX2.gac.name: Will To Win
WillToWinEX2.gac.text:
Willpower 3 (This page counts as three for Autocountering.)

This page can't be played.

24KaretProduction.gac.name: Shattered Dreams Production
24KaretProduction.gac.text:
Goldust Trademark

Draw a page. Then, some random effect happens to one or both players based on a hidden, complex and bizarre formula.

MuleKick.gac.name: Low Blow Mule Kick
MuleKick.gac.text: Counters behind opponent moves. Your opponent is put on the mat and stunned next turn. You receive 4 Warnings from the referee. When used as a counter, there is a 90% chance that you receive only 1 Warning.

DropKickEX1.gac.name: Drop Kick
DropKickEX1.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves. Your opponent is put on the mat.

Choose one: Bounce Off The Ropes is drawn from your playbook or your opponent ditches a random page from hand.

fields.List_Values: Choose one|Opponent ditches a page|Draw Bounce Off The Ropes

RefBump2E.gac.name: Ref Bump
RefBump2E.gac.text: Play only if not in control and your opponent is playing a move that isn't a Hold. Counter that move and gain control. The referee is distracted for 4 to 10 turns (any Referee in play is ditched). Afterwards, you receive 1 to 7 Warnings or your opponent receives 1 to 4 Warnings. (This Event ends if a Referee is played.)

StephanieMcMahonHelmsley.gac.name: Stephanie McMahon-Helmsley
StephanieMcMahonHelmsley.gac.text:
Play only if Stephanie isn't in play. (You may only have one Support page in play.)
Special: Choose and ditch a page from hand. Your opponent ditches two pages at random and you draw the bottom page of your playbook. Use this ability once per match and only after turn 25.

Table.gac.name: Table
Table.gac.text:
The next Superstar hit with a Takedown move that costs 6 or more takes +15 damage and is Stunned until the end of the next turn. His opponent gets 8 Warnings. Table is then removed.

Special: The Superstar in control may pay 2 Attitude to remove Table from the game.

GreatPower.gac.name: Great Power
GreatPower.gac.text:
Play only if you have 1 Strength, 1 Strike and 2 Attitude. Your opponent sees this page when played.

Gain +1 Strength and +1 Strike Momentum, and lose 2 Attitude.

DropKickToTheKnee.gac.name: Drop Kick To The Knee
DropKickToTheKnee.gac.text: Your opponent is put on the mat and takes 4 leg damage. If your opponent has 7 leg damage or is a Big Superstar, you get Crowd Support.

RoundKickEX2.gac.name: Round Kick
RoundKickEX2.gac.text: Choose a page in your hand. If this move connects that page is ditched.

SpringboardDropKick.gac.name: Springboard Drop Kick
SpringboardDropKick.gac.text:
Play only in the ring. 

Your opponent is moved to ringside and is Staggered. If countered, you're Grounded.

HighCrossBody.gac.name: High Cross Body
HighCrossBody.gac.text:
Play only in the ring. Countered by Fallaway Slam. When you play this move, draw a page if your opponent is on the mat.
If this move connects, you try to pin your opponent. If not, you're stunned for the rest of the turn.

KneeDrop.gac.name: Knee Drop
KneeDrop.gac.text:
Play this move only if your opponent is on the mat. If this move is countered you lose up to an additional 2 Momentum.

Your opponent stays on the mat. Unless your opponent has less than 4 pages in hand, your opponent ditches 1 random page.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WASetOnMat #target 1)
          (sett Done (lesser (WAGetHandCount #target) 4))
          (sett NumDitched 0)
          (sett StopNum 1)
          (loop (not Done)
                (block 
                     (sett Ditch (WARandom 1 (WAGetHandCount #target)))
                     (sett Card (item (WAGetHand #target) Ditch))
                     (WAMessage (WAGetOwner #target) (WAGetName #this) "has forced you to ditch" (WAGetName Card))
                     (WADitchPage #target (subtract Ditch 1))
                     (sett NumDitched (add NumDitched 1))
                     (if ((eq NumDitched StopNum)
                          (sett Done True)
                         )
                         (True
                          (sett Done (eq (WAGetHandCount #target) 0))
                         )
                     )
                )
          )
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

WhipIntoSteelStepsEX2.gac.name: Whip Into Steel Steps
WhipIntoSteelStepsEX2.gac.text:
Play only when both you and your opponent are at ringside. Can't be countered by Strength moves.

You may choose to lose 1 Attitude. If you do, your opponent ditches a random Strength move from hand when this move connects.

CrowdSupport.gac.name: Crowd Support
CrowdSupport.gac.text:
Draw a page. If your move connects this turn, you get +1 Attitude Momentum.

When you choose to ditch Crowd Support, it counts for 2 ditches.

GargoyleSuplex.gac.name: Gargoyle Suplex
GargoyleSuplex.gac.text:
Can only be played by Tazz. Counters mad rush moves.

Two random pages in your opponent's hand are moved to your hand. Your opponent then draws a page.

VerticalSuplex.gac.name: Vertical Suplex
VerticalSuplex.gac.text: Counters in close moves. Countered by Up and Over.

HollywoodHulkHogan2E.gac.name: Hulk Hogan
HollywoodHulkHogan2E.gac.text: The first five times you play a Face special you gain 1 Knowledge.

WhateverItTakes.gac.name: Whatever It Takes
WhateverItTakes.gac.text:
Play only if you have more Warnings than your opponent.

Choose a Move in your playbook. It is drawn to your hand.

SuperMomentumLE.gac.name: Super Momentum
SuperMomentumLE.gac.text:
Hurricane Trademark

Play only after turn 18. Gain 1 Attitude, Agility and Technical. "Heat" is put into your opponent's hand.

ClotheslineOverTheRopesEX2.gac.name: Clothesline Over The Ropes
ClotheslineOverTheRopesEX2.gac.text: Play only in the ring. Your opponent is sent to ringside and is put on the mat.

Edgeomatic.gac.name: Edge-o-matic
Edgeomatic.gac.text:
Edge Trademark

Counters back to foe moves. Your opponent can't play Specials (except Once Too Often) until this move is countered. You get a +7% pin chance for the rest of the match.

fields.Move_Connected: (WASetValue #superstar AffectPinScore (add 7 (WAGetValue #superstar AffectPinScore)))

InvertedAtomicDropEX3.gac.name: Inverted Atomic Drop
InvertedAtomicDropEX3.gac.text:
Counters in close moves.

Technical Combo: +4 damage.

(If you connected with a Technical move last turn, this move does +4 damage.)

stsaEX1.gac.name: Stone Cold
stsaEX1.gac.text: You draw a page when you play a Damage special with a move that connects.

KaneTourn.gac.name: Kane
KaneTourn.gac.text: Kane ignores the first stun he receives. After turn 25 he does +2 damage with all Strength moves.

FrogSplashEX1.gac.name: Frog Splash
FrogSplashEX1.gac.text:
Eddie Guerrero Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.
This move does +1 damage for each move type you have connected with this match. Your opponent is stunned until the end of the turn and you attempt a pin. If the pin fails, you remain in control.

EdgecutionTourn.gac.name: Edgecution
EdgecutionTourn.gac.text:
Edge Finisher

Counters head down moves.
This move does +1 damage for each Attitude you have (up to +10). You attempt to pin your opponent with a +1% pin chance for each different Agility and Technical move you've connected with this match. If the pin fails, you stay in control.

ButtShot.gac.name: Stink Face
ButtShot.gac.text:
This move may only be played by Rikishi Phatu, and only if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent loses an additional 2 Momentum. This move is worth 2 Momentum.

HeSawThatComing.gac.name: He Saw That Coming...
HeSawThatComing.gac.text:
Draw a page.

Name a move that costs 6 or more to play.

If your opponent has that move in hand, all copies of it are buried.

fields.AI_PlayPage: (WASetValue #this AIScore 0)

InjuredLeg.gac.name: Injured Leg
InjuredLeg.gac.text: Whenever you connect with an leg extended, high risk or hit or miss move, there is a 50% chance that you ditch a random page.

HurricanranaEX1.gac.name: Hurricanrana
HurricanranaEX1.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit four moves in a row and only in the ring.

Your opponent can't play moves to counter this.

Lita.gac.name: Lita
Lita.gac.text:
Member of Team Xtreme, Diva Superstar

You get "Crowd Support" when you play a Face page. When you play "Crowd Support" your opponent loses 1 Attitude.

TurnbuckleSmash.gac.name: Turnbuckle Smash
TurnbuckleSmash.gac.text:
Play only in the ring. Countered by Turnbuckle Smash.

For each point of Strike momentum you have you do an additional 2 damage (up to +10.)

TakeItOutside.gac.name: Take It Outside
TakeItOutside.gac.text: Use this special only when your opponent is stunned and in the ring. Both you and your opponent go to Ringside, and you draw a page.

OverheadBellyToBellySuplexEX3.gac.name: Overhead Belly-to-Belly Suplex
OverheadBellyToBellySuplexEX3.gac.text:
Play only if you have a Technical limit of 5 or more (or none at all). Counters mad rush and high risk moves.

Strength Combo: Your opponent ditches two random pages from hand.

ItJustFeelsRight.gac.name: It Just Feels Right
ItJustFeelsRight.gac.text:
Lita Trademark

At the end of turn 5, you get Crowd Support and your opponent loses 2 Attitude.
(Superstars may only play one Entrance, and only on turn one or two.)

SlingshotIntoPost2E.gac.name: Slingshot Into Post
SlingshotIntoPost2E.gac.text:
Counters victim below moves. Can only be used offensively if your opponent is on the mat.
Your opponent is put on the mat. If played at ringside, your opponent is Busted Wide Open.

FallBrawl.gac.name: Fall Brawl
FallBrawl.gac.text:
Play only once per match.

Draw a page. Both players draw the next three pages of their opponent's playbook.

HBK.gac.name: HBK!
HBK.gac.text:
Shawn Michaels Trademark

Play only if "The Main Event" is in play or this is a Main Event match. Draw 3 pages, or 10 pages if "The Headliner!" and "The Showstopper!" are in play. Then, the rest of your playbook is removed from the game. Your moves can't be Autocountered.

ForearmSmash.gac.name: Forearm Smash
ForearmSmash.gac.text:
This move does up to +2 damage.

(Face page: cannot be played if you have played a Heel page.)

NipUp.gac.name: Kip Up
NipUp.gac.text:
Play only if you are on the mat and you are The Rock or Brock Lesnar or you have no Agility limit.

Choose a move in your playbook. It is put into your hand. If you don't use it by the end of the turn, it is ditched.

Block.gac.name: Block
Block.gac.text: Can't be used offensively. Counters arm extended, leg extended, in close, mad rush, back to foe and standing above moves that are Strike moves. Countered by arm extended, leg extended, and in close moves that are Strike moves. Your opponent can't counter this with a move he has already connected with.

fields.Counters: arm extended|leg extended|in close|mad rush|back to foe|standing above

ElbowDrop.gac.name: Elbow Drop
ElbowDrop.gac.text:
Play this move only if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent ditches 1 random page.

If this move is countered, lose up to an additional 2 Momentum.

ElbowToBackOfTheHead2E.gac.name: Elbow to Back of the Head
ElbowToBackOfTheHead2E.gac.text:
Counters head down moves.

Your opponent takes 2 head damage. 50% chance opponent loses +1 Attitude.

BackflipCounter.gac.name: Backflip Counter
BackflipCounter.gac.text:
This move can't be used offensively, and only if your opponent's move costs 5 or more.
Counters head down moves. Your opponent is Staggered and you get +2 Attitude.
Willpower 2

PowerSlam2E.gac.name: Power Slam
PowerSlam2E.gac.text:
Counters high risk and mad rush moves. This move does an additional +1 damage for each Strength you have (up to +5). 
If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

NWOCountry2E.gac.name: nWo Country
NWOCountry2E.gac.text:
nWo Trademark

Draw a random move, special and momentum from your playbook. Your opponent draws a page. Kevin Nash does commentary for the rest of the match.

BackSuplexEX2.gac.name: Back Suplex
BackSuplexEX2.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves.

Choose a page in your hand. If this move connects you ditch that page.

DragonSuplex.gac.name: Dragon Suplex
DragonSuplex.gac.text:
Counters back to foe moves.

After this move connects, you pin your opponent. If the pin does not work, you stay in control.

BustedWideOpen.gac.name: Busted Wide Open
BustedWideOpen.gac.text:
At the beginning of each turn this Superstar loses 1 Hit Point and the top page of his playbook is ditched.

(Each Superstar may only have one copy of each Status in play.)

EddieGuerrero2E.gac.name: Eddie Guerrero
EddieGuerrero2E.gac.text:
The first time you connect with a move in any Method after turn 5, you draw a page.
(This special ignores moves on the first five turns completely.)

RomerosSpecial.gac.name: Romero's Special
RomerosSpecial.gac.text:
Eddie Guerrero Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat. Each turn this hold does 7 back damage and your opponent ditches a random special from hand or play.

StealYourFinisher.gac.name: Steal Your Finisher
StealYourFinisher.gac.text: Play if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. If your opponent's Finisher is in his hand or playbook, you play it as your move this turn. If it connects, your opponent loses 10 Attitude. (If there is more than one, a random one is chosen.)

TheUndertakerTourn.gac.name: The Undertaker
TheUndertakerTourn.gac.text:
Special: Over a Decade

All Superstars lose 1 Attitude and the turn limit is extended by a turn. Use 11 times per match and only if you have any Attitude.

TheRock2EnoLE.gac.name: The Rock
TheRock2EnoLE.gac.text:
Special: The Great One

Draw a page. Use this ability when your opponent is on the mat after turn 5, and only six times per match.

DVonDudley.gac.name: D-Von Dudley
DVonDudley.gac.text:
Special: "D-Von! Get the..."
Choose a Weapon, Ringside Special, "Set Up A Table" or "Set Up A Ladder" from your playbook. You draw that page. Use this ability twice per match.

StrikeEX1.gac.name: Strike
StrikeEX1.gac.text: Gain 1 Strike. Your opponent can't see this page.

EddieGuerreroEX1.gac.name: Eddie Guerrero
EddieGuerreroEX1.gac.text: When you end a turn without playing a move (or keeping a Hold applied), you lose up to 4 Attitude Momentum.  When your opponent does this after turn 5, you draw a page.

Moonsault2E.gac.name: Moonsault
Moonsault2E.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat and in the ring. If countered, you are stunned until the end of the turn.
All specials in your opponent's hand are buried. Your opponent stays on the mat.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WASetOnMat #target 1)
          (sett Victim #target)
          (sett Thug #superstar)
          (sett NumStolen 0)
          (sett TheHand (WAGetHand Victim))
          (sett MatchName (WAStringGetValue #this User_Data))
          (sett HandIndex (count TheHand))
          (loop (greater HandIndex 0)
                (block 
                     (sett MBC (item TheHand HandIndex))
                     (sett HandIndex (subtract HandIndex 1))
                     (if ((WAIsSpecial MBC)
                          (block 
                               (sett PageTaken (WAMovePageFromHandToPlaybook Victim HandIndex -1))
                               (WAMessage -1 (WAGetName #superstar) "has buried" (cat (WAGetNAme #target) "'s") (WAGetName PageTaken))
                          )
                         )
                     )
                )
          )
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

SpinningPowerslam.gac.name: Spinning Powerslam
SpinningPowerslam.gac.text:
Brock Lesnar Trademark

This move does +1 damage for each Attitude you have (up to +5).

Spear2E.gac.name: Spear
Spear2E.gac.text:
Edge Trademark

Counters mad rush moves. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn and "Catch Him Stunned" is drawn from your playbook.

Insulted.gac.name: Insulted
Insulted.gac.text:
This Superstar has a -20% pin chance penalty for the rest of the match, but does +1 damage with all Impact moves.

(Each Superstar may only have one copy of each Status in play.)

AgilityEX3.gac.name: Agility
AgilityEX3.gac.text: Gain +1 Agility. Your opponent can't see this page.

RollUp2E.gac.name: Roll-up
RollUp2E.gac.text:
Counters leg extended moves. If this move connects as a counter your opponent ditches a random page.
Your opponent is put on the mat. You attempt a pin. If the pin fails you remain in control.

WithAuthoritySummercon2002W.gac.name: With Authority! (SummerCon 2002 Winner)
WithAuthoritySummercon2002W.gac.text: You choose a condition. Your opponent is told of your choice. The player who best meets this condition at the end of turn 25 draws three pages. (If tied, both players draw three pages. Counts as "With Authority!")

fields.List_Values: Choose a condition|Whoever has the most pages in hand|Whoever has the most Momentum pages remaining in playbook|Whoever is a Genetic Anomalies employee as of June 2, 2002|Whoever has connected with the most different moves (by name)|Whoever has connected with the least moves|Whoever has the lowest Momentum total

Trapped.gac.name: Trapped
Trapped.gac.text: You can't counter Strike moves or Drop Kick. This page leaves play at the end of the next turn.

GrabRopesForLeverage2E.gac.name: Grab Ropes For Leverage
GrabRopesForLeverage2E.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring and you are in control.

Draw a page. You attempt to pin your opponent, who can't play special pages this turn.

SideKick.gac.name: Side Kick
SideKick.gac.text:
Counters in close moves.

Strike Combo: You get Crowd Support.

TheRockTourn.gac.name: The Rock
TheRockTourn.gac.text:
Special: The Great One

Draw a page. Use this ability when your opponent is on the mat after turn 5, and only four times per match.

BarbedWireTwoByFour.gac.name: Barbed-Wire Two-by-Four
BarbedWireTwoByFour.gac.text:
Play only in a Hardcore match.

Special: The player in control may choose a page in hand. That page is ditched and that player loses 1 Strike. "Barbed-Wire 2x4 Shot" is played as your move this turn. (You must have 1 Strike to use this ability.)

TwoFingerSalute.gac.name: Two Finger Salute
TwoFingerSalute.gac.text:
Stone Cold Trademark

If your opponent has no Knowledge, your move can't be countered. Otherwise, your opponent loses 2 Knowledge if your move connects.

ChairShot2E.gac.name: Chair Shot
ChairShot2E.gac.text:
Play this move only if Steel Folding Chair is in play.

You get 4 Warnings. Your opponent is put on the mat, takes 5 head damage and is stunned until the end of the next turn.

KendoStickShot.gac.name: Kendo Stick Shot
KendoStickShot.gac.text:
Play only in a Hardcore match.
This move does +1 damage for each time either player has connected with Kendo Stick Shot. Kendo Stick is put into play (unless there is already one in play).

TellMeYouDidntJustSayThat.gac.name: Tell Me You Didn't Just Say That?!
TellMeYouDidntJustSayThat.gac.text:
Booker T Trademark

While in control, if any Superstar connects with a move they already connected with, all other copies of that page in their playbook and hand are buried. (Superstars may only play one Entrance, and only on turn one or two.)

AggressiveTechnical.gac.name: Aggressive Technical
AggressiveTechnical.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit two moves in a row and only after turn 5.

Gain +1 Technical and +1 Attitude.

ElbowToBackOfTheHeadEX3.gac.name: Elbow to Back of the Head
ElbowToBackOfTheHeadEX3.gac.text:
Counters head down moves. 

If your opponent has at least 2 Knowledge, he loses 1.

BackflipSplash.gac.name: Backflip Splash
BackflipSplash.gac.text: Play only when your opponent is on the mat. You gain +2 Attitude and attempt to pin your opponent.

TreeOfWoe2E.gac.name: Tree Of Woe
TreeOfWoe2E.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.

If your move this turn is an Impact mad rush move, it does +7 damage and stuns your opponent until the end of the next turn.

NeckVice.gac.name: Neck Vice
NeckVice.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Your opponent takes 2 Head damage per turn.
When this move connects, if you have any Knowledge Momentum, draw a page.

Duck2E.gac.name: Duck
Duck2E.gac.text:
This move can't be played offensively.

Counters arm extended and leg extended moves. Countered by behind opponent and mad rush moves. This move provides no Attitude.

ReyMysterioLE.gac.name: Rey Mysterio
ReyMysterioLE.gac.text:
Special: Cruiserweight Legend

Draw a page. Use this ability only if you have less than 6 pages in hand, and only if your opponent has at least 3 momentum.

AmazingEntrance.gac.name: Amazing Entrance
AmazingEntrance.gac.text:
Play only if you have 150 pages in your playbook.
Choose a Momentum. You lose control (if you have it). At the end of turn 4, you gain 2 Momentum of that type (up to your limit).
(Superstars may only play one Entrance, and only on turn one or two.)

DontTrustNobody.gac.name: Don't Trust Anybody
DontTrustNobody.gac.text: Choose Action, Gameplan, Support, Run In, or Referee. All specials of the chosen type in every Superstar's hand are buried.

LeavingTheGroundAttack.gac.name: Leaving The Ground
LeavingTheGroundAttack.gac.text: Play with a high risk move that isn't a finisher, and only if you haven't connected with a high risk move this match. This move can't be countered by moves and you gain +1 Attitude if it connects.

RunningPowerslamEX2.gac.name: Running Powerslam
RunningPowerslamEX2.gac.text:
Can't be played against Big Superstars.

If you have more pages in hand than your opponent, this move does +4 damage.

(Counts as Power Slam.)

MissileDropkickEX2.gac.name: Missile Dropkick
MissileDropkickEX2.gac.text: Play only in the ring if you have hit two moves in a row. Choose a page in your hand. If countered, you ditch a random page. Otherwise you ditch the chosen page, gain +2 Attitude and draw two pages.

BackRake.gac.name: Back Rake
BackRake.gac.text:
Hollywood Hulk Hogan Trademark

When you play this page, you see the specials in your opponent's hand. Choose one. If this move connects, that page is ditched and you get 1 Warning. Your opponent can't play Specials this turn unless this move is countered.

GoodOfficiating.gac.name: Good Officiating!
GoodOfficiating.gac.text:
You have a +5% pin chance bonus. The first time your opponent receives Warnings each turn, they get 4 more Warnings if there is a Referee in play. You may only have one "Good Officiating!" in play.

(Hidden pages aren't seen by your opponent.)

BrockLesnar.gac.name: Brock Lesnar
BrockLesnar.gac.text:
You may only play 3 Momentum pages. You may not play Amazing Entrance.

Every six turns you get +1 Strength. (At the start of turn six, twelve, and so on.)

Agility1.gac.name: Agility
Agility1.gac.text: Gain 1 Agility. Your opponent can't see this page.

SuperplexEX3.gac.name: Superplex
SuperplexEX3.gac.text:
Play only in the ring if you have hit two moves in a row and haven't connected with this move yet. Countered by Shove and not by Dodge.
Whip Into The Corner Combo: This move can't be countered.

HookTheLeg.gac.name: Hook The Leg
HookTheLeg.gac.text:
Play only if you are in control and if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.
Draw a page and Pin your opponent. If this pin attempt does not work you remain in Control, and your move string is broken.

ChairToTheBack.gac.name: Chair To The Back
ChairToTheBack.gac.text:
Play only if Steel Folding Chair is in play.

You get 4 Warnings from the referee. This move does 2 Back damage and an additional 3 Back damage for each Strike Momentum you have.

fields.Damage_Bonus:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett Strike (WAGetValue #superstar Strike_Momentum))
          (sett SubDamage (WAGetValue #move Submission_Damage_Bonus))
          (sett SubDamage (add SubDamage (multiply Strike 3)))
          (WASetValue #move Submission_Damage_Bonus SubDamage)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

AchillesHeel2E.gac.name: Achilles' Heel
AchillesHeel2E.gac.text: Whenever you apply a Hold, it does +2 to +6 submission damage (randomly chosen each time). This page is removed when you are Stunned. You can only have one Achilles' Heel in play.

CripplerCrossFaceTourn.gac.name: Crippler Cross Face
CripplerCrossFaceTourn.gac.text:
Chris Benoit Finisher

Counters arm extended and in close moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat. This move does 9 arm and 9 head damage per turn.

AbdominalStretch2E.gac.name: Abdominal Stretch
AbdominalStretch2E.gac.text:
Countered by Hip Toss.

This move does 6 back damage per turn. At the end of the turn there is a 25% chance that this hold is released. (Your opponent gets control.)

HeGotAllOfIt.gac.name: Got All Of It!
HeGotAllOfIt.gac.text:
Play only with a move that isn't defensive.

This move does +1 damage for each Strength you have (up to +14). Your opponent can't play Specials this turn unless the move is countered.

ArmbarEX3.gac.name: Armbar
ArmbarEX3.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

The turn this move connects, the next move in your opponent's playbook is ditched. Each turn it is applied it does 4 arm damage.

TheRock2E.gac.name: The Rock
TheRock2E.gac.text:
Special: The Great One

Draw a page. Use this ability when your opponent is on the mat after turn 5, and only six times per match.

24InchPythons.gac.name: 24 Inch Pythons
24InchPythons.gac.text:
Hollywood Hulk Hogan Trademark

Special: Lose 1 Attitude. If you connect with a Strength move this turn it does +4 damage.

KnockOverTheLadder.gac.name: Knock Over The Ladder
KnockOverTheLadder.gac.text: Play when your opponent is playing a move with the word "Ladder" in its title. The move is countered and you gain control. A Ladder is removed from play.

BounceOffTheRopes2E.gac.name: Bounce Off The Ropes
BounceOffTheRopes2E.gac.text: Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. If you have 3 Strike, a random Strike move is drawn from your playbook. If you play an Impact or Drop move and it connects, that move does +3 damage and you draw a page.

RollingThunder.gac.name: Rolling Thunder
RollingThunder.gac.text:
Rob Van Dam Trademark

Play only when your opponent is on the mat. Your opponent stays on the mat. If you have less Hit Points than your opponent, you gain +2 Attitude. Otherwise, this move does +2 damage.

SoloConchairto.gac.name: Solo Con-chair-to
SoloConchairto.gac.text:
Christian Trademark

Play only if Steel Folding Chair is in play and your opponent is on the mat, and only once per match.
You get 7 Warnings. Your opponent is stunned for the next two turns.

ShoulderBlock.gac.name: Shoulder Block
ShoulderBlock.gac.text: Counters leg extended moves. Countered by Shoulder Block.

BackBodyDropEX1.gac.name: Back Body Drop
BackBodyDropEX1.gac.text:
Counters victim below moves.

Choose one: Leg Drop is drawn from your playbook or your opponent's next three pages from playbook are ditched.

fields.List_Values: Choose one:|Draw Leg Drop|Ditch 3 from Playbook

NewWorldOrderEX3.gac.name: New World Order
NewWorldOrderEX3.gac.text:
nWo Trademark

Play with an Impact move.
For Kevin Nash, the move does +5 damage and can't be Autocountered. If countered, this page returns to your hand.
For others, "nWo Control" is put into play if you connect (and if one isn't already in play).

WillToWinTourn.gac.name: Will To Win
WillToWinTourn.gac.text:
Willpower 3 (This page counts as three for Autocountering.)

This page can't be played.

Integrity2E.gac.name: Integrity
Integrity2E.gac.text:
Kurt Angle Trademark

Play only if you have hit 3 moves in a row. Your opponent may not play Special pages from hand. This leaves play when you are stunned, you play a special or you get a Warning. You may only have one Integrity in play.

SpinningHeelKick.gac.name: Spinning Heel Kick
SpinningHeelKick.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat. Unless already stunned, he is stunned until the end of the next turn.

LowBlowPunch.gac.name: Low Blow Punch
LowBlowPunch.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.
To play this move you must choose and ditch a page from your hand. If this move connects you get 2 Warnings and your opponent ditches 2 random pages from hand.

TeamXtreme.gac.name: Team Xtreme
TeamXtreme.gac.text:
Team Xtreme Trademark

You lose 1 Attitude and gain 1 Agility, Strike and Technical. Your opponent draws a page (and sees this page played). This can't be in your Lead Off. Play only twice per match and only if you have at least 1 Attitude.

FlippingFaceSlam.gac.name: Flipping Face Slam
FlippingFaceSlam.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively. Counters victim below moves. Countered by Shove.

Your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn.

GreatStrategy.gac.name: Great Strategy
GreatStrategy.gac.text:
Play only if you have 1 Knowledge, 1 Technical and 2 Attitude. Your opponent sees this page when played.

Gain +1 Knowledge and +1 Technical Momentum, and lose 2 Attitude.

TripleHPromo.gac.name: Triple H
TripleHPromo.gac.text:
Special: Be The Game
Name a page. That page is drawn from your Playbook and put into your hand. Use this ability once per game.

RockBottom.gac.name: Rock Bottom
RockBottom.gac.text:
Only The Rock may play Rock Bottom. Counters arm extended and in close moves.
If your opponent is not stunned and has less pages in hand you do, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

KnowledgeEX2.gac.name: Knowledge
KnowledgeEX2.gac.text: Gain 1 Knowledge. Your opponent can't see this page.

SwandiveHeadbutt.gac.name: Swandive Headbutt
SwandiveHeadbutt.gac.text:
Only Chris Benoit may play Swandive Headbutt. Play only if your opponent is on the mat.
Your opponent stays on the mat and takes 2 to 8 Arm and Head damage. Your opponent's Specials in hand are buried.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WASetOnMat #target 1)
          (sett Victim #target)
          (sett Thug #superstar)
          (sett NumStolen 0)
          (sett TheHand (WAGetHand Victim))
          (sett MatchName (WAStringGetValue #this User_Data))
          (sett HandIndex (count TheHand))
          (loop (greater HandIndex 0)
                (block 
                     (sett MBC (item TheHand HandIndex))
                     (sett HandIndex (subtract HandIndex 1))
                     (if ((WAIsSpecial MBC)
                          (block 
                               (sett PageTaken (WAMovePageFromHandToPlaybook Victim HandIndex -1))
                               (WAMessage -1 (WAGetName #superstar) "has buried" (cat (WAGetNAme #target) "'s") (WAGetName PageTaken))
                          )
                         )
                     )
                )
          )
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

ThroatBreaker.gac.name: Throat Breaker
ThroatBreaker.gac.text:
Undertaker Trademark

Play only in a Hardcore match if there is a Steel Folding Chair in play, and only if you haven't connected with this move this match.

Your opponent ditches five pages, then draws two pages.

DontMessWithTexas.gac.name: Don't Mess With Texas!
DontMessWithTexas.gac.text:
Bradshaw Trademark

Draw a page. Except for Actions and Gameplans, specials can't be played by anyone. This page leaves play when anyone has 2 Knowledge or you get hit with a move that costs 10 or more.

LeapingSideKickEX2.gac.name: Leaping Side Kick
LeapingSideKickEX2.gac.text:
Booker T Trademark

Your opponent is put on the mat. If you played a Damage special with this move and it connects, you draw two random Drop moves. Otherwise, this does up to +4 damage.

WithAuthorityRelease.gac.name: With Authority! (Release Bonus Page)
WithAuthorityRelease.gac.text:
Play only while in Control. This move does +4 damage and may not be Autocountered.

(If used with a Hold, it can be autocountered after the first turn it is applied.)

LiftIntoPost.gac.name: Lift Into Post
LiftIntoPost.gac.text:
Play this move only if both you and your opponent are at Ringside.

Your opponent is put on the mat, ditches a random page and is Stunned until the end of the next turn.

SpineBreaker.gac.name: Spine Breaker
SpineBreaker.gac.text:
Christian Trademark

Your opponent is put on the mat and takes 3 to 7 back damage. The first time you play it, this move can't be countered if you have any Warnings. Other times, your opponent ditches a random Gameplan from play.

RoundKick.gac.name: Round Kick
RoundKick.gac.text: 33% chance your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

Bulldog.gac.name: Bulldog
Bulldog.gac.text: The next four pages from your opponent's playbook are ditched.

fields.Move_Connected:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          (WADitchFromPlaybook #target)
          True
     )
    )
    (True True)
)

DoublePowerbomb.gac.name: Double Powerbomb
DoublePowerbomb.gac.text:
This may only be played by Chris Jericho. Counters head down moves. 

This move does +2 damage for each type of Momentum you have.

SpinningHeelKickEX1.gac.name: Spinning Heel Kick
SpinningHeelKickEX1.gac.text: Your opponent is put on the mat. If you have any Technical your opponent loses 1 Strike.

SlamIntoAnnounceTable.gac.name: Slam Into Announce Table
SlamIntoAnnounceTable.gac.text: Play only at Ringside. All of your opponent's Gameplan Specials that are in play are ditched.

Wristlock.gac.name: Wristlock
Wristlock.gac.text: This move does 2 arm damage per turn, but can't cause submissions. At the end of the turn if there are any Specials in your opponent's hand, one is ditched (randomly chosen) and your opponent draws a page.

StunningBlow2E.gac.name: Stunning Blow
StunningBlow2E.gac.text:
Play only with an Impact move that is not a Finisher.

The move does +4 damage and if it connected your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

Ladder.gac.name: Ladder
Ladder.gac.text: Special: Use only when in the same location as your opponent. You lose 2 Attitude. A random page in your playbook with the word "Ladder" in the title is drawn to your hand. (You need 2 Attitude to use this ability.)

LowBlowStomp.gac.name: Low Blow Stomp
LowBlowStomp.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

You get 3 Warnings. For each Strike you have more than your opponent's Agility this move does +2 damage (up to +10).

SpikeDudley.gac.name: Spike Dudley
SpikeDudley.gac.text:
Spike Dudley can't play Strength moves offensively against non-Cruiserweights.

Whenever you are hit with a move that does 4 or more damage, you draw a page.

ChrisBenoitTourn.gac.name: Chris Benoit
ChrisBenoitTourn.gac.text: Each time an opponent's body part takes 7 damage, you draw a page. (This happens when that body part takes 14 damage, 21 damage, and so on.)

LowBlowLegDrop.gac.name: Low Blow Leg Drop
LowBlowLegDrop.gac.text:
Jeff Hardy Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat.
You get 1 Warning and Crowd Support. This move does +2 damage for each momentum your opponent has more than you.

FallawaySlamEX2.gac.name: Fallaway Slam
FallawaySlamEX2.gac.text:
Bradshaw Trademark

Counters hit or miss and mad rush moves. Your opponent loses +2 Attitude. You draw a random momentum page.

ShootingStarPress.gac.name: Shooting Star Press
ShootingStarPress.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring, and only if you haven't yet connected with this move this match.
You attempt to pin your opponent with a +5% pin chance. If the pin fails, you stay in control.

Dodge2E.gac.name: Dodge
Dodge2E.gac.text:
This move may not be used offensively.

Counters high risk, hit or miss, and standing above moves. Countered by victim below moves. This move provides no Attitude.

StrikeTourn.gac.name: Strike
StrikeTourn.gac.text: Gain 1 Strike. Your opponent can't see this page.

OverheadBellyToBellySuplex.gac.name: Overhead Belly-to-Belly Suplex
OverheadBellyToBellySuplex.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves. Your opponent loses 1 Agility. If you have 3 Technical you gain +1 Attitude.

(Counts as "Belly-to-Belly Suplex.")

dragonscrew.gac.name: Dragon Screw Leg Whip
dragonscrew.gac.text:
Counters leg extended moves.  This move does 1 Leg damage for each Technical you have.

If used as a counter, draw a page when this move connects.

ShawnMichaels.gac.name: Shawn Michaels
ShawnMichaels.gac.text:
Shawn Michaels can Autocounter for 3 less pages and starts the match with 6 back damage.
At the start of each turn, all pages in your hand with Willpower 2 or more (counts as two or more pages for Autocountering) are ditched.

HighSpot2E.gac.name: High Spot
HighSpot2E.gac.text:
Play only when your opponent is on the mat.

Name a move in your playbook that costs 6 or more and draw it. If your next move this turn is High Risk, you gain 1 Attitude.

TechnicalTourn.gac.name: Technical
TechnicalTourn.gac.text: Gain 1 Technical. Your opponent can't see this page.

SentonSplashEX1.gac.name: Senton Splash
SentonSplashEX1.gac.text:
Eddie Guerrero Trademark

Play only while your opponent is on the mat in the ring.
You gain +1 Attitude. If you have connected with more move types than your opponent, draw a page.

FrogSplash.gac.name: Frog Splash
FrogSplash.gac.text:
Eddie Guerrero Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.
This move does +1 damage for each move type you have connected with this match. Your opponent is stunned until the end of the turn and you attempt a pin. If the pin fails, you remain in control.

Backslide.gac.name: Backslide
Backslide.gac.text:
Counters arm extended moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat and you attempt a pin.

If the pin fails you remain in control, and if you have attempted more pins than your opponent you gain +1 Attitude and get a +5% pin bonus for the rest of the match.

BigBackBodyDrop.gac.name: Big Back Body Drop
BigBackBodyDrop.gac.text:
Counters mad rush moves.

Technical Combo: Get +1 Attitude.

(Counts as "Back Body Drop".)

ThrustKickEX2.gac.name: Storm's Thrust Kick
ThrustKickEX2.gac.text:
Lance Storm Finisher

Your opponent is put on the mat. This move does +3 damage for each pair of Strike and Technical you have. You draw a random Pin special from your playbook.

WhipIntoTheCorner.gac.name: Whip Into The Corner
WhipIntoTheCorner.gac.text:
Play only in the ring. Countered by Whip Into The Corner.

When played, if you have less Strength than your opponent, Whip Into The Corner is put into your opponent's hand.

If this connects, you draw a random mad rush move from your playbook.

SentonSplash.gac.name: Senton Splash
SentonSplash.gac.text:
Eddie Guerrero Trademark

Play only while your opponent is on the mat in the ring.
You gain +1 Attitude. If you have connected with more move types than your opponent, draw a page.

FlairFlip.gac.name: Flair Flip
FlairFlip.gac.text:
Ric Flair Trademark

Play only if your opponent played "Irish Whip" or has hit with two moves in a row. Counter your opponent's move. You lose 4 Attitude, move to ringside, and draw 3 pages.

ShowstopperChokeslamEX1.gac.name: Showstopper Chokeslam
ShowstopperChokeslamEX1.gac.text:
Big Show Finisher

Does +10 damage if you have more Ability Momentum than your opponent. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn.

(Counts as "Chokeslam".)

fields.Damage_Bonus:
(if ((eq #move #this)
     (block 
          (sett You (WAGetPlayedBy #this))
          (sett Opponent (WAGetOpponent You))
          (sett OppTotal (WAGetTotalMomentum Opponent))
          (sett OppAttitude (WAGetValue Opponent Generic_Momentum))
          (sett OppAbility (subtract OppTotal OppAttitude))
          (sett YourTotal (WAGetTotalMomentum You))
          (sett YourAttitude (WAGetValue You Generic_Momentum))
          (sett YourAbility (subtract YourTotal YourAttitude))
          (if ((greater YourAbility OppAbility)
               (sett Bonus 10)
              )
              (True
               (sett Bonus 0)
              )
          )
          (WASetValue #this Damage_Bonus (add (WAGetValue #this Damage_Bonus) Bonus))
     )
    )
)

BeautifulChainWrestling.gac.name: Hard To Stop
BeautifulChainWrestling.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit three moves in a row. Draw a page.

Opponents must pay an additional two pages to Auto Counter your moves.

ThatsGottaHurt.gac.name: That's Gotta Hurt
ThatsGottaHurt.gac.text:
Play if your opponent is on the mat at ringside, or if your last move did 9 or more damage last turn (and you are in control).
For the next seven turns (including this one), Strength moves do +3 damage to your opponent.

RockBottom2E.gac.name: Rock Bottom
RockBottom2E.gac.text:
The Rock Finisher

Counters arm extended and in close moves. If your opponent is not stunned and has less pages in hand than you, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

HardToStop2E.gac.name: Hard To Stop
HardToStop2E.gac.text:
Play only if you have hit three moves in a row. Draw a page.

Opponents must pay an additional two pages to Autocounter your moves.

Surfboard.gac.name: Surfboard
Surfboard.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

This move does 2 damage to each body part each turn. It can't be held for more than 3 turns.

VanDaminator.gac.name: Van Daminator
VanDaminator.gac.text:
Rob Van Dam Trademark

Counters "Chair Shot" and "Chair to the Back". Unless one is already in play, Steel Folding Chair is put into play when you play this move. If this move connects as a counter, your opponent is stunned until the end of next turn. Otherwise, you get 4 Warnings.

TheRock.gac.name: The Rock
TheRock.gac.text:
Special: The People
Draw two pages. Use this ability once per game.

HeSawThatComing2E.gac.name: He Saw That Coming...
HeSawThatComing2E.gac.text:
Draw a page.

Name a move that costs 6 or more to play. If your opponent has that move in hand, all copies of it are buried.

HipTossEX3.gac.name: Hip Toss
HipTossEX3.gac.text:
Counters behind opponent moves.
Your opponent's next three pages are revealed to you. Choose one; the others are ditched. (This can't be played if your opponent has no pages left.)

AbdominalStretchEX3.gac.name: Abdominal Stretch
AbdominalStretchEX3.gac.text:
Counters head down moves.
Choose one: move or special. Each turn, your opponent takes 4 back damage and a random page of the type you chose is ditched from your opponent's playbook.

FootOnTheRopes.gac.name: Foot On The Ropes
FootOnTheRopes.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.
You attempt to pin your opponent with +25% pin chance bonus. This move may be Autocountered for -5 pages. If it is, your opponent ditches 3 pages from hand.

RegalStretchEX1.gac.name: Regal Stretch
RegalStretchEX1.gac.text:
William Regal Finisher

Play only while your opponent is on the mat. Countered by Back Elbow.
This move does 1 Arm and 1 Back damage per turn for each Technical Momentum you have.

HelloNWO.gac.name: Hello!
HelloNWO.gac.text:
William Regal Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat and you have hit two moves in a row.

Name a Special in your deck, which is drawn to your hand.  Gain one Attitude.  (You can't play this if there are no Specials left in your playbook.)

LegSweep.gac.name: Leg Sweep
LegSweep.gac.text:
Counters in close and leg extended moves.

Your opponent is put on the mat.

FigureFour2E.gac.name: Figure Four
FigureFour2E.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat. 

The turn you play this move, it does 11 leg damage. Each other turn it does 7 leg damage.

ReverseChinlockEX3.gac.name: Reverse Chinlock
ReverseChinlockEX3.gac.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Each turn, a random special from your opponent's playbook is ditched. (Holds with no body damage cannot cause submissions.)

TheGuillotine.gac.name: The Guillotine
TheGuillotine.gac.text:
Only Steve Blackman may play The Guillotine.

For each Momentum your opponent has, this move does +1 damage. Unless already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

fields.Damage_Bonus:
(block 
     (sett Strike (WAGetValue #target Strike_Momentum))
     (sett Strength (WAGetValue #target Strength_Momentum))
     (sett Agility (WAGetValue #target Agility_Momentum))
     (sett Technical (WAGetValue #target Technical_Momentum))
     (sett Knowledge (WAGetValue #target Knowledge_Momentum))
     (sett Attitude (WAGetValue #target Generic_Momentum))
     (sett SS (add Strength
                   (add Strike
                        (add Agility
                             (add Technical (add Knowledge Attitude))
                        )
                   )
              )
     )
     (WASetValue #move Damage_Bonus (add (WAGetValue #move Damage_Bonus) SS))
)

KneeLiftEX3.gac.name: Knee Lift
KneeLiftEX3.gac.text: Counters head down moves. Can't be countered by Technical moves.

BellyToBellySuplex.gac.name: Belly-to-Belly Suplex
BellyToBellySuplex.gac.text: Counters in close and mad rush moves.

RicFlairEX3LE.gac.name: Ric Flair
RicFlairEX3LE.gac.text:
You can't play leg extended moves that cost 6 or more.
Special: The Man
If not in control, choose a Special in your hand (except "Once Too Often" or "Crowd Support"). Your opponent buries one page with that name from hand.

FiremansCarry.gac.name: Fireman's Carry
FiremansCarry.gac.text:
Counters leg extended and victim below moves.

50% chance your opponent both ditches the next playbook page and loses 1 additional Momentum.

ChokeslamToHell2E.gac.name: Choke Slam To Hell
ChokeslamToHell2E.gac.text:
Kane Finisher

Counters mad rush and in close moves. If not already stunned, your opponent is stunned until the end of the next turn.

(Counts as "Chokeslam".)

RicFlairsFigureFour.gac.name: Ric Flair's Figure Four
RicFlairsFigureFour.gac.text:
Ric Flair Finisher

Play only if your opponent is on the mat or as a counter. Counters Figure Four.
This move does 10 leg damage per turn. If your opponent has more leg damage than twice his Knowledge, this move can't be countered by moves the turn you play it. (Counts as "Figure Four.")

SnapSuplex2E.gac.name: Snap Suplex
SnapSuplex2E.gac.text:
Counters head down and in close moves.

This move does +1 damage (up to +5) for each Attitude you have.

CornerPostRack.gac.name: Corner Post Rack
CornerPostRack.gac.text:
This move can't counter any moves, and can only be countered by Punch, Shove and Eye Rake. Can't be played against Big Superstars.
Each turn this move gives you 3 Warnings and your opponent 5 Back damage.
